二维 Euler 方程的离散伴随：格点格式

Discrete adjoints for two-dimensional Euler: node-centred

本页先介绍二维可压缩 Euler 方程组和它的作用，再从二维标量的同一张混合网格出发，把一个标量换成四个守恒量，并接上拟一维 Euler 的热力学与特征边界。本页研究低马赫数、无激波的稳态绕流：逐面查看通量与导数，求解原始、前向和伴随方程，验证来流与物面坐标的压力载荷梯度，并在固定多边形的加密网格族上测量精度阶和伴随一致性。

After introducing the two-dimensional compressible Euler equations and what they are for, this page starts from the scalar example’s hybrid mesh, replaces one scalar by four conserved variables and extends quasi-one-dimensional Euler thermodynamics and characteristic boundaries. It studies low-Mach, shock-free steady flow: inspect face fluxes and derivatives, solve primal/tangent/adjoint equations, verify pressure-load gradients with respect to free-stream inputs and body coordinates, and measure the order of accuracy and adjoint consistency on a refined family with a fixed polygonal boundary.

第 1 节Section 1

方程：二维定常可压缩 Euler 方程组

The equations: steady two-dimensional compressible Euler

从守恒律到 Euler 方程组

From conservation laws to the Euler equations

在流体中任取一块固定的区域。区域里的质量、两个方向的动量和总能量，只能通过它的边界改变：流体穿过边界时把这些量带进带出，边界上的压力推动流体并对它做功。不计黏性和热传导时，这四条守恒律就是二维可压缩 Euler 方程组。

Take any fixed region of the fluid. The mass, the momentum in two directions and the total energy inside it can change only through its boundary: the fluid carries these quantities in and out as it crosses the boundary, and the pressure on the boundary pushes the fluid and does work on it. Without viscosity and heat conduction, these four conservation laws are the two-dimensional compressible Euler equations.

拟一维 Euler 的三分量状态现在多了一个横向动量。二维没有变截面积源项：几何直接进入每个面的面积向量（第 2 节）。采用理想气体 γ=1.4\gamma=1.4，ρE\rho E 是单位体积总能量，包含两个方向的动能；压力计算漏掉横向动能，就会破坏原始方程及所有导数。

The quasi-one-dimensional Euler state gains a transverse momentum component. There is no variable-area source: geometry enters through each face area vector (Section 2). Use an ideal gas with γ=1.4\gamma=1.4. The total energy per unit volume ρE\rho E includes kinetic energy in both directions; omitting the transverse kinetic energy corrupts both the primal equations and their derivatives.

U=(ρ,  ρu,  ρv,  ρE)T,p=(γ−1)(ρE−12ρ(u2+v2)),c=γp/ρ.U=(\rho,\;\rho u,\;\rho v,\;\rho E)^T,\qquad p=(\gamma-1)\Bigl(\rho E-\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2)\Bigr),\qquad c=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho}.
∂tU+∂xFx(U)+∂yFy(U)=0,Fx=[ρuρu2+pρuv(ρE+p)u],Fy=[ρvρuvρv2+p(ρE+p)v].\partial_tU+\partial_xF_x(U)+\partial_yF_y(U)=0,\qquad F_x=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u\\\rho u^2+p\\\rho uv\\(\rho E+p)u\end{bmatrix},\quad F_y=\begin{bmatrix}\rho v\\\rho uv\\\rho v^2+p\\(\rho E+p)v\end{bmatrix}.

第一行是质量守恒；第二、三行是两个方向的动量守恒，压力 pp 像通量一样出现在其中；第四行是能量守恒，能量通量 (ρE+p)𝒖(\rho E+p)\boldsymbol u 包括流体携带的总能量和压力所做的功。四个方程里有 ρ,u,v,E,p\rho,u,v,E,p 五个量，状态方程 p=(γ−1)(ρE−12ρ(u2+v2))p=(\gamma-1)\bigl(\rho E-\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2)\bigr) 把它们闭合；声速 c=γp/ρc=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho} 决定下面的特征速度。

The first row is conservation of mass; the second and third are conservation of momentum in the two directions, where the pressure pp appears like a flux; the fourth is conservation of energy, whose flux (ρE+p)𝒖(\rho E+p)\boldsymbol u holds the total energy carried by the fluid and the work done by the pressure. The four equations contain five quantities ρ,u,v,E,p\rho,u,v,E,p; the equation of state p=(γ−1)(ρE−12ρ(u2+v2))p=(\gamma-1)\bigl(\rho E-\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2)\bigr) closes them, and the speed of sound c=γp/ρc=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho} sets the characteristic speeds below.

对任意控制体 VV 积分，并用散度定理把通量散度的体积分变成边界积分，就得到积分形式。记 𝒏^=(n^x,n^y)\hat{\boldsymbol n}=(\hat n_x,\hat n_y) 为 VV 边界的单位外法向，un=𝒖⋅𝒏^u_n=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol n} 为法向速度，Fn^F_{\hat n} 是穿过边界的法向通量：

Integrating over any control volume VV, and turning the volume integral of the flux divergence into a boundary integral with the divergence theorem, gives the integral form. With 𝒏^=(n^x,n^y)\hat{\boldsymbol n}=(\hat n_x,\hat n_y) the outward unit normal of the boundary of VV and un=𝒖⋅𝒏^u_n=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol n} the normal velocity, Fn^F_{\hat n} is the normal flux through the boundary:

ddt∫VU dA+∮∂VFn^(U) ds=0,Fn^(U)=Fx(U) n^x+Fy(U) n^y=[ρunρu un+pn^xρv un+pn^y(ρE+p) un].\frac{d}{dt}\int_VU\,dA+\oint_{\partial V}F_{\hat n}(U)\,ds=0,\qquad F_{\hat n}(U)=F_x(U)\,\hat n_x+F_y(U)\,\hat n_y=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u\,u_n+p\hat n_x\\\rho v\,u_n+p\hat n_y\\(\rho E+p)\,u_n\end{bmatrix}.

本页只研究定常解。令 ∂tU=0\partial_tU=0，要离散的就是定常的积分形式：对计算域 Ω\Omega 中的每个控制体，穿过它边界的净通量为零。第 2 节把控制体取成网格的单元（格心）或中位对偶体（格点），第 3 节把边界积分写成各个面上的通量之和。

This page studies steady solutions only. With ∂tU=0\partial_tU=0, the equation to be discretised is the steady integral form: for every control volume in the domain Ω\Omega, the net flux through its boundary vanishes. Section 2 takes the control volumes to be the cells (cell-centred) or the median-dual volumes (node-centred) of a mesh, and Section 3 writes the boundary integral as a sum of fluxes over faces.

∮∂VFn^(U) ds=0,V⊂Ω.\oint_{\partial V}F_{\hat n}(U)\,ds=0,\qquad V\subset\Omega.

本页的来流马赫数低，绕流光滑、没有激波：第 3 节的一阶通量不需要限制器，第 14 节的复数步长也适用于整条计算链。激波及其伴随不在本页讨论。

The free-stream Mach number of this page is low and the flow past the body is smooth, without shocks: the first-order flux of Section 3 needs no limiter, and the complex step of Section 14 applies to the whole chain of computations. Shocks and their adjoints are not treated on this page.

图 1.1 把这个问题画在一张图上（基准状态 M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2、θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ，本页代码的收敛解，节点值；第 2 节起讲怎样算）。左边是计算域：物面八边形（琥珀色）与远场八边形（蓝色）之间的区域；每个控制体按当地马赫数 ∣𝒖∣/c|\boldsymbol u|/c 着色，短箭头是当地速度，远场的实线面是入流面，虚线面是出流面。来流从左下方流入：流体在物体上游一侧减速，在物体上下两侧加速；当地马赫数在 0.156 到 0.218 之间，最高值在物体上侧紧贴物面的控制体里，处处远小于 1。右边是物面压力：迎风一侧高于来流压力 p∞=1p_\infty=1，背风一侧低于它，流体在物体后面没有恢复压力。第 7 节说明这主要是本页固定数值耗散造成的离散误差，这里的阻力不为零也是因为它。

Figure 1.1 draws the problem in one picture (base state M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2, θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ; the converged solution of this page’s code, nodal values; Section 2 onwards shows how it is computed). On the left is the domain, the region between the body octagon (amber) and the far-field octagon (blue); every control volume is coloured by its local Mach number ∣𝒖∣/c|\boldsymbol u|/c, the short arrows are the local velocity, and the solid far-field faces are inflow faces, the dashed ones outflow faces. The free stream comes from the lower left: the fluid slows down on the upstream side of the body and speeds up above and below it; the local Mach number lies between 0.156 and 0.218, highest in a volume next to the wall on the upper side of the body, and far below 1 everywhere. On the right is the wall pressure: above the free-stream pressure p∞=1p_\infty=1 on the upstream side and below it on the downstream side, where the flow does not recover its pressure behind the body. Section 7 shows that this is mostly discretisation error caused by the page’s fixed numerical dissipation, which is also why the drag here is not zero.

特征速度：一个边界要给几个条件

Characteristic speeds: how many conditions a boundary takes

把法向通量 Fn^F_{\hat n} 对 UU 求导，得到 4×44\times4 的 Jacobian ∂Fn^/∂U\partial F_{\hat n}/\partial U。它有四个实特征值：

Differentiating the normal flux Fn^F_{\hat n} with respect to UU gives the 4×44\times4 Jacobian ∂Fn^/∂U\partial F_{\hat n}/\partial U. It has four real eigenvalues:

λ1=un−c,λ2=λ3=un,λ4=un+c.\lambda_1=u_n-c,\qquad \lambda_2=\lambda_3=u_n,\qquad \lambda_4=u_n+c.

它们是小扰动沿 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} 传播的速度：两个声波以 un±cu_n\pm c 传播，另外两个量（熵与切向速度）以流体的法向速度 unu_n 随流输运。第 4 节由 Riemann 不变量得到同样的四个速度；第 8 节在代码的通量 Jacobian 上核对它们的和与积。

They are the speeds at which small disturbances travel along 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n}: two sound waves move at un±cu_n\pm c, and two more quantities (the entropy and the tangential velocity) are carried with the normal velocity unu_n of the fluid. Section 4 finds the same four speeds from the Riemann invariants; Section 8 checks their sum and product on the flux Jacobian of the code.

在边界上取 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} 指向域外。速度为负的波从外部进入计算域，它携带的信息只能由边界提供；速度为正的波离开计算域，它的值由域内决定，若在边界上再指定它，问题就过定了。所以边界条件的个数等于负特征值的个数：

At a boundary take 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} pointing out of the domain. A wave with a negative speed enters the domain from outside, and the information it carries can only come from the boundary; a wave with a positive speed leaves the domain, its value is decided inside, and prescribing it at the boundary as well would over-determine the problem. The number of boundary conditions is therefore the number of negative eigenvalues:

  • 超声速入流（un<−cu_n<-c）：四个特征值都为负，给 4 个条件，即整个状态；
  • 亚声速入流（−c<un<0-c<u_n<0）：λ1,λ2,λ3<0\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\lambda_3<0，给 3 个条件；
  • 亚声速出流（0<un<c0<u_n<c）：只有 λ1<0\lambda_1<0，给 1 个条件；
  • 超声速出流（un>cu_n>c）：没有负特征值，不给条件；
  • 滑移壁面（un=0u_n=0）：只有 λ1=−c<0\lambda_1=-c<0，给 1 个条件，就是无穿透条件 un=0u_n=0 本身；λ2=λ3=0\lambda_2=\lambda_3=0 的两个量沿壁面输运。
  • supersonic inflow (un<−cu_n<-c): all four eigenvalues are negative; 4 conditions, the whole state;
  • subsonic inflow (−c<un<0-c<u_n<0): λ1,λ2,λ3<0\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\lambda_3<0; 3 conditions;
  • subsonic outflow (0<un<c0<u_n<c): only λ1<0\lambda_1<0; 1 condition;
  • supersonic outflow (un>cu_n>c): no negative eigenvalue; no condition;
  • slip wall (un=0u_n=0): only λ1=−c<0\lambda_1=-c<0; 1 condition, the no-penetration condition un=0u_n=0 itself; the two quantities with λ2=λ3=0\lambda_2=\lambda_3=0 travel along the wall.

图 1.2 在本页的收敛解上画出这些速度。上半部分是三个边界面：远场入流面 f=73f=73 的四个速度中有 3 个为负，出流面 f=66f=66 只有 un−cu_n-c 为负，物面 f=48f=48 上 un=0u_n=0，只有 −c-c 为负。下半部分把条件个数画成法向马赫数 un/cu_n/c 的函数：本页全部 16 个远场半面的 ∣un∣/c|u_n|/c 都不超过 0.19，远在亚声速带内。所以远场入流面从来流取 3 个条件，出流面取 1 个，物面只要 un=0u_n=0。第 4 节用 Riemann 不变量 r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1)、熵函数 S=p/ργS=p/\rho^\gamma 与切向速度 utu_t 实现远场的这种取舍，并把 un=0u_n=0 写成只含压力的壁面通量。

Figure 1.2 draws these speeds on this page’s converged solution. The upper part shows three boundary faces: on the far-field inflow face f=73f=73, 3 of the 4 speeds are negative; on the outflow face f=66f=66, only un−cu_n-c is; and on the wall face f=48f=48, un=0u_n=0 and only −c-c is negative. The lower part draws the number of conditions as a function of the normal Mach number un/cu_n/c: all 16 far-field half-faces of this page have ∣un∣/c|u_n|/c at most 0.19, far inside the subsonic band. A far-field inflow face therefore takes 3 conditions from the free stream, an outflow face 1, and the wall only un=0u_n=0. Section 4 implements this choice at the far field with the Riemann invariants r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1), the entropy function S=p/ργS=p/\rho^\gamma and the tangential velocity utu_t, and writes un=0u_n=0 as a wall flux that contains only the pressure.

本页的问题：绕物体的亚声速流动

The problem on this page: subsonic flow past a body

计算域是一个闭合物体与外边界之间的区域（图 1.1 左）。物体是一条光滑的闭曲线，外边界是半径 1.9 的圆；计算实际使用两条曲线上各 8 个网格节点连成的八边形，第 2 节给出物面曲线并构造网格。物面是滑移壁面；外边界是远场，在那里流动应当回到均匀的来流。

The domain is the region between a closed body and an outer boundary (left of Figure 1.1). The body is a smooth closed curve and the outer boundary a circle of radius 1.9; the computation uses the octagons through the 8 mesh nodes on each of the two curves, and Section 2 gives the body curve and builds the mesh. The body is a slip wall; the outer boundary is the far field, where the flow should return to the uniform free stream.

来流固定为 ρ∞=1\rho_\infty=1、p∞=1p_\infty=1，速度大小为 M∞γM_\infty\sqrt\gamma，方向为攻角 θ\theta。于是 c∞=γc_\infty=\sqrt\gamma，∣𝒖∞∣/c∞=M∞|\boldsymbol u_\infty|/c_\infty=M_\infty 正好是来流马赫数。每次原始求解都从所有控制体都等于 U∞U_\infty 的均匀流出发。第 7 节的目标值，以及第 10–14 节对 M∞M_\infty、θ\theta 的导数，都以这个无量纲化为准。

The free stream is fixed at ρ∞=1\rho_\infty=1 and p∞=1p_\infty=1, with speed M∞γM_\infty\sqrt\gamma in the direction of the incidence θ\theta. Hence c∞=γc_\infty=\sqrt\gamma and ∣𝒖∞∣/c∞=M∞|\boldsymbol u_\infty|/c_\infty=M_\infty is exactly the free-stream Mach number. Every primal solve starts from the uniform state U∞U_\infty in all volumes. The objective values of Section 7 and the derivatives with respect to M∞M_\infty and θ\theta in Sections 10–14 refer to this scaling.

U∞=(1,  M∞γcos⁡θ,  M∞γsin⁡θ,  1γ−1+γM∞22)T.U_\infty=\Bigl(1,\;M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\cos\theta,\;M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\sin\theta,\;\frac1{\gamma-1}+\frac{\gamma M_\infty^2}2\Bigr)^T.

设计变量是 D=(M∞,θ,X)D=(M_\infty,\theta,X)：两个来流参数，加上全部 24 个网格节点的坐标 XX（48 个数），共 50 个分量。按伴随优化文献的通常写法，设计变量记作 DD。移动物面节点改变物体的形状，移动远场节点改变外边界，移动其余节点只改变网格；它们都会改变离散解和目标。第 10 节给出这些分量的排列，第 12 节求对全部坐标的导数。

The design variables are D=(M∞,θ,X)D=(M_\infty,\theta,X): the two free-stream parameters and the coordinates XX of all 24 mesh nodes (48 numbers), 50 components in all. As is usual in the adjoint-optimization literature, the design variables are written DD. Moving a body node changes the shape of the body, moving a far-field node changes the outer boundary, and moving any other node changes only the mesh; each of them changes the discrete solution and the objective. Section 10 lists the components, and Section 12 differentiates with respect to all coordinates.

第 7 节给出设计的目的：目标 JJ 是流体作用在物体上的压力合力的一个分量，默认是 yy 分量 JyJ_y，页首可以改成 xx 分量 JxJ_x。它由物面压力（图 1.1 右）逐面求和得到；第 7 节还讨论在这些粗网格上，这个力有多少是物理的。

Section 7 states the purpose of the design: the objective JJ is one component of the pressure force that the fluid exerts on the body, by default the yy component JyJ_y; the header can switch it to the xx component JxJ_x. It is summed face by face from the wall pressures (right of Figure 1.1); Section 7 also discusses how much of this force is physics on these coarse meshes.

这组方程的作用

What these equations are for

在流体力学中，Euler 方程组描述不计黏性和热传导的可压缩流动。黏性只在物面附近的薄边界层和尾迹里起作用时，例如高雷诺数下的流线型物体，它给出其余区域的速度和压力；它包含声波，流速更高时还包含激波（本页不讨论）；它也是 Navier–Stokes 方程组去掉黏性应力和热传导后剩下的部分。无黏流中物体受的力全部来自物面压力；另一方面，稳态、亚声速、无激波的无黏绕流阻力为零（d'Alembert 佯谬，第 7 节），这提醒我们它没有描述什么。气动外形设计常先用 Euler 方程组计算压力载荷，再用伴随求载荷对大量外形参数的梯度，这正是本页的内容。

In fluid dynamics the Euler equations describe compressible flow without viscosity and heat conduction. Where viscosity matters only in thin boundary layers next to walls and in wakes, as for streamlined bodies at high Reynolds numbers, they give the velocity and the pressure everywhere else; they contain sound waves and, at higher speeds, shock waves (not treated here); and they are what remains of the Navier–Stokes equations without viscous stresses and heat conduction. In inviscid flow the force on a body comes entirely from the wall pressure; on the other hand, steady, subsonic, shock-free inviscid flow past a body has zero drag (d’Alembert’s paradox, Section 7), a reminder of what the equations leave out. Aerodynamic shape design often computes pressure loads with the Euler equations first and then uses an adjoint for the gradient of a load with respect to many shape parameters, which is the subject of this page.

在本课程中，这组方程把前面两类页面接在一起：

In this course the equations join the two earlier kinds of page:

  • 同一张网格：二维标量页的混合网格与面积向量（第 2 节）、面循环（第 5 节）原样沿用，每个控制体的未知量从 1 个变成 4 个；
  • 同样的热力学与特征边界：状态方程、声速与 Riemann 不变量来自拟一维 Euler，二维的新内容是在远场先把速度分解到面的法向与切向（第 4 节）；
  • 一个方程组：Jacobian 的每个非零元变成一个 4×44\times4 块（第 6 节），前向与伴随按块传播；
  • 几何也是设计变量：节点坐标进入面积向量、面长与单位法向，第 12 节对它们求导；
  • 一个光滑的小例子：96 个未知量，没有激波，每个导数都能用有限差分与复数步长核对（第 13、14 节）。
  • The same mesh. The hybrid mesh and the area vectors (Section 2) and the face loop (Section 5) of the 2-D scalar pages carry over unchanged; each control volume now holds 4 unknowns instead of 1.
  • The same thermodynamics and characteristic boundaries. The equation of state, the sound speed and the Riemann invariants come from quasi-1-D Euler; what is new in two dimensions is that the far field first splits the velocity into the normal and tangential components of a face (Section 4).
  • A system. Every nonzero entry of the Jacobian becomes a 4×44\times4 block (Section 6), and the tangent and the adjoint propagate blocks.
  • Geometry as design variables. The node coordinates enter the area vectors, face lengths and unit normals, and Section 12 differentiates through them.
  • A small, smooth example. 96 unknowns and no shocks, so every derivative can be checked with finite differences and complex steps (Sections 13 and 14).

图 1.3 把本页放在整个网站的路线上，每个方框都链接到那一页的第 1 节。每往右一步主要增加一类新内容：一维 Burgers 只有一个非线性对流方程；拟一维 Euler 换成质量、动量、能量三个方程，并引入压力和变截面积；本页增加第二个空间方向，面有了法向，网格坐标也成为设计变量；二维层流 N–S 再加入黏性应力和热传导，面上要用到梯度；二维 RANS–SA 再加一个湍流模型方程。每点的未知量从 1 个增加到 5 个，但每一页的残差仍由面循环组装，前向与伴随也沿同一个循环求导。另有两页与本页相邻：二维标量对流页用的是同一张网格（见它的第 2 节），一维层流 N–S 页在一维的 Euler 方程上加入黏性和热传导。

Figure 1.3 places this page on the route through the site; every box links to Section 1 of its page. Each step to the right mainly adds one kind of ingredient: 1-D Burgers has a single nonlinear convection equation; quasi-1-D Euler replaces it by three equations (mass, momentum and energy) and brings in the pressure and a varying cross-section; this page adds a second space direction, so faces have normals and the mesh coordinates become design variables; 2-D laminar N–S adds viscous stresses and heat conduction, which need gradients at the faces; 2-D RANS–SA adds one turbulence-model equation. The unknowns per point grow from 1 to 5, yet every page still assembles its residual with face loops, and the tangent and the adjoint differentiate the same loops. Two more pages sit next to this one: the 2-D scalar advection page uses the same mesh (see its Section 2), and the 1-D laminar N–S page adds viscosity and heat conduction to the Euler equations in one dimension.

本页要回答的问题

The question this page answers

本页假设读者熟悉微积分、矩阵运算、Newton 法和 Krylov 迭代（GMRES），最好读过二维标量对流页（同一张网格与面循环）和拟一维 Euler 页（同样的热力学与特征边界）；本页用到的内容都会重新给出。

This page assumes calculus, matrix algebra, Newton’s method and a Krylov solver (GMRES), and it helps to have read the 2-D scalar advection page (the same mesh and face loop) and the quasi-1-D Euler page (the same thermodynamics and characteristic boundaries); the parts this page uses are restated here.

本页只回答一个问题：设计变量 DD 改变一点，压力合力 JJ 改变多少？DD 有 50 个分量。前向（tangent）路线每个分量解一次线性方程，共 50 次；伴随路线只解一次转置方程，就得到全部分量（第 11 节）。页首的全页路线图把后面各节串成一条线。按页首默认设置实际计数，50 次前向求解共用 1997 次 GMRES 迭代，1 次伴随求解只用 44 次。

This page answers one question: how much does the pressure force JJ change when the design DD changes a little? DD has 50 components. The tangent (forward) route solves one linear system per component, 50 in all; the adjoint route solves a single transposed system and obtains every component (Section 11). The page roadmap at the top strings the later sections together. Counted with the default settings at the top of the page, the 50 tangent solves take 1997 GMRES iterations in total and the single adjoint solve only 44.

要在计算机上回答这个问题，先要把连续的方程组变成有限个未知量的代数方程。第 2 节沿用二维标量的网格，决定四个守恒量存放在哪里；第 3 节再把定常的积分形式写成各个面上的通量之和。

To answer it on a computer, the continuous equations must first become algebraic equations in finitely many unknowns. Section 2 reuses the mesh of the 2-D scalar pages and decides where the four conserved variables live; Section 3 then writes the steady integral form as a sum of fluxes over faces.

第 2 节Section 2

网格：沿用二维标量的混合 O 型网格

Mesh: the scalar example’s hybrid O-grid

第 1 节的方程组对计算域中的每一点都成立，计算机却只能存放有限个数。本节沿用二维标量页的网格，决定四个守恒量存放在哪里，以及每个面的面积向量怎样计算。

The equations of Section 1 hold at every point of the domain, but a computer stores finitely many numbers. This section reuses the mesh of the 2-D scalar pages and decides where the four conserved variables live and how the area vector of every face is computed.

基础网格的 24 个节点坐标、8 个四边形和 16 个三角形，逐点、逐单元与二维标量一致。节点分布在三圈上，每圈取 8 个角度 tj=2πj/8t_j=2\pi j/8：内圈取在下面的物面曲线上，外圈取在半径 1.9 的圆上，中圈按 0.45 的比例把两者线性混合。数组从 0 开始编号；边界的 R=−1R=-1 表示没有右控制体，绝不能拿它访问数组。

The 24 base nodes, 8 quadrilaterals and 16 triangles match the scalar example point for point and cell for cell. The nodes lie on three rings at the 8 angles tj=2πj/8t_j=2\pi j/8: the inner ring on the body curve below, the outer ring on the circle of radius 1.9, and the middle ring blends the two with weight 0.45. Arrays are zero-based. R=−1R=-1 marks an absent exterior control volume and must never be used as an array index.

x=0.1+r(t)cos⁡t,y=−0.04+r(t)sin⁡t,r(t)=0.55 (1+0.28cos⁡t+0.12sin⁡2t).x=0.1+r(t)\cos t,\quad y=-0.04+r(t)\sin t,\qquad r(t)=0.55\,\bigl(1+0.28\cos t+0.12\sin 2t\bigr).

图 2.1 把上式与三圈节点画在一起：虚线是曲线本身，实线是计算真正使用的多边形。

Figure 2.1 draws this curve together with the three rings of nodes: the dashed lines are the curves themselves, the solid lines the polygons the computation actually uses.

相邻节点用直线相连，所以计算中的物面是内接于这条曲线的八边形，远场是半径 1.9 的正八边形；本页所有导数都针对这两条多边形边界。第 15 节的加密网格保持这两个八边形不变。

Neighbouring nodes are joined by straight edges, so the computational body is an octagon inscribed in this curve and the far field is a regular octagon of radius 1.9. Every derivative on this page refers to these polygonal boundaries. The refined meshes of Section 15 keep both octagons unchanged.

每个原始节点保存四个守恒分量，中位对偶控制体由节点、边中点和原始单元中心围成。内部对偶面可能由两段组成，通量使用两段面积向量之和；物理边界边拆成两个半面。这里共有 24 个控制体、80 个面、96 个状态自由度。

Each original node stores four conserved components. Median-dual volumes join vertices, edge midpoints and cell centres. An interior dual face can contain two segments; its flux uses the summed area vector. Each physical boundary edge contributes two half-faces. There are 24 volumes, 80 faces and 96 state degrees of freedom.

图 2.2 左边给出这 24 个控制体的编号，右边给出它们在状态向量里的位置：控制体 ii 的四个分量占第 4i4i 到 4i+34i+3 个位置。残差 RR 和伴随 ψ\psi 按同样的顺序存放，所以三个向量的第 4i+k4i+k 个分量指同一个控制体、同一条守恒方程（k=0,1,2,3k=0,1,2,3 依次是质量、xx 动量、yy 动量、能量）。图 2.3 说明中位对偶控制体怎样由原始网格构造。

The left of Figure 2.2 numbers the 24 control volumes and the right shows where they sit in the state vector: the four components of volume ii occupy positions 4i4i to 4i+34i+3. The residual RR and the adjoint ψ\psi are stored in the same order, so component 4i+k4i+k of all three vectors refers to the same volume and the same conservation equation (k=0,1,2,3k=0,1,2,3: mass, xx momentum, yy momentum, energy). Figure 2.3 shows how the median-dual volumes are built from the original mesh.

𝒏f=(ye−ys,  −(xe−xs)),ℓf=∥𝒏f∥,𝒏^f=𝒏f/ℓf,∑f∈∂Vi𝒏if=0.\boldsymbol n_f=\bigl(y_e-y_s,\;-(x_e-x_s)\bigr),\quad \ell_f=\|\boldsymbol n_f\|,\quad \hat{\boldsymbol n}_f=\boldsymbol n_f/\ell_f,\quad \sum_{f\in\partial V_i}\boldsymbol n_{if}=0.

这里 (xs,ys)(x_s,y_s) 与 (xe,ye)(x_e,y_e) 是面的起点和终点（格点页的对偶面按各段相加）。面积向量 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f 已经包含面长；单位法向 𝒏^f\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f 只用于第 4 节的特征分解，两者不能混用。

Here (xs,ys)(x_s,y_s) and (xe,ye)(x_e,y_e) are the start and end points of the face (a dual face on the node page sums its segments). The area vector 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f already includes the face length; the unit normal 𝒏^f\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f is used only for the characteristic split of Section 4, and the two must not be mixed.

图 2.4 以一个控制体为例画出上面的约定。

Figure 2.4 illustrates this convention for one control volume.

逐步推导：每个控制体的面积向量之和为零

Step by step: the area vectors of every control volume sum to zero

第一步，对偶控制体的边界由若干线段首尾相接组成（物面或远场节点还包括两个半面），是一条闭合折线。沿逆时针方向依次取边界折线的顶点 𝒙1,𝒙2,…\boldsymbol x_1,\boldsymbol x_2,\dots，绕一圈后回到 𝒙1\boldsymbol x_1；第 kk 段从 𝒙k\boldsymbol x_k 到 𝒙k+1\boldsymbol x_{k+1}，它的外法向面积向量是把边向量顺时针转 90°：

Step 1, the boundary of a dual volume is a chain of segments joined end to end (for a wall or far-field node it includes two half-faces), i.e. a closed polygonal line. Take the vertices of its boundary counterclockwise, 𝒙1,𝒙2,…\boldsymbol x_1,\boldsymbol x_2,\dots, returning to 𝒙1\boldsymbol x_1 after one loop; segment kk runs from 𝒙k\boldsymbol x_k to 𝒙k+1\boldsymbol x_{k+1}, and its outward area vector is the edge vector turned clockwise by 90°:

𝒏k=(𝒙k+1−𝒙k)⊥,𝒅⊥=(dy, −dx).\boldsymbol n_k=(\boldsymbol x_{k+1}-\boldsymbol x_k)^{\perp},\qquad \boldsymbol d^{\perp}=(d_y,\,-d_x).

第二步，⊥\perp 是线性运算；绕一圈的边向量首尾相消，和为零：

Step 2, ⊥\perp is linear, and the edge vectors of one closed loop telescope to zero:

∑k𝒏k=(∑k(𝒙k+1−𝒙k))⊥=𝟎.\sum_{k}\boldsymbol n_k=\Bigl(\sum_{k}(\boldsymbol x_{k+1}-\boldsymbol x_k)\Bigr)^{\perp}=\boldsymbol 0.

第三步，代码按面存储 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f（从 LL 指向 RR），控制体 ii 的外法向是 𝒏if=ℬif𝒏f\boldsymbol n_{if}=\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f，符号与第 5 节的 ℬif\mathcal B_{if} 相同；一个对偶面的两段属于同一个面，它们的面积向量先相加。于是 ∑fℬif𝒏f=0\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f=0。物理通量对面积向量是线性的，所以均匀状态 UU 在每个不含边界面的控制体上给出 ∑fℬifF𝒏f(U)=F∑fℬif𝒏f(U)=0\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}F_{\boldsymbol n_f}(U)=F_{\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f}(U)=0，耗散项也因 UR−UL=0U_R-U_L=0 而为零：均匀状态在所有内部控制体上的残差都是零。第 6 节的对角块和第 7 节的压力合力都用到同一个事实。

Step 3, the code stores 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f per face (pointing from LL to RR); the outward vector of volume ii is 𝒏if=ℬif𝒏f\boldsymbol n_{if}=\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f, with the sign ℬif\mathcal B_{if} of Section 5; the two segments of one dual face belong to the same face, so their area vectors are added first. Hence ∑fℬif𝒏f=0\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f=0. The physical flux is linear in the area vector, so in every volume without boundary faces a uniform state UU gives ∑fℬifF𝒏f(U)=F∑fℬif𝒏f(U)=0\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}F_{\boldsymbol n_f}(U)=F_{\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f}(U)=0, and the dissipation vanishes because UR−UL=0U_R-U_L=0: a uniform state has zero residual in every interior volume. The diagonal blocks of Section 6 and the pressure force of Section 7 use the same fact.

核对：全部 24 个控制体上 ∣∑fℬif𝒏f∣|\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f| 的最大值为 2×10⁻¹⁶，而最长的面长为 0.778（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: the largest ∣∑fℬif𝒏f∣|\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f| over all 24 volumes is 2×10⁻¹⁶, while the longest face has length 0.778 (computed by this page’s code at build time).

控制体、面和面积向量都已确定，状态也按控制体排好了顺序。第 3 节把第 1 节的法向通量写到每个面上，得到四分量的数值通量。

The control volumes, the faces and their area vectors are now fixed, and the state is stored volume by volume. Section 3 writes the normal flux of Section 1 on every face and obtains the four-component numerical flux.

第 3 节Section 3

面上的四分量通量

The four-component flux on a face

第 1 节的积分形式要求每个控制体边界上的净通量为零。控制体的边界由面组成；第 2 节中面 ff 的面积向量 𝒏f=ℓf𝒏^f\boldsymbol n_f=\ell_f\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f 已经包含面长，所以面上的物理通量就是第 1 节的 Fn^F_{\hat n} 乘以面长：

The integral form of Section 1 asks for zero net flux through the boundary of every control volume. That boundary consists of faces, and the Section 2 area vector 𝒏f=ℓf𝒏^f\boldsymbol n_f=\ell_f\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f of face ff already includes its length, so the physical flux through a face is the Fn^F_{\hat n} of Section 1 times the face length:

Fn(U)=Fx(U) nx+Fy(U) ny=ℓ[ρunρu un+pn^xρv un+pn^y(ρE+p) un],un=un^x+vn^y.F_n(U)=F_x(U)\,n_x+F_y(U)\,n_y=\ell\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u\,u_n+p\hat n_x\\\rho v\,u_n+p\hat n_y\\(\rho E+p)\,u_n\end{bmatrix},\qquad u_n=u\hat n_x+v\hat n_y.

首版使用一阶分片常值重构与固定耗散系数 α=2\alpha=2 的 Rusanov 形式通量。固定 α\alpha 是本例明确选定的数值方法，因此它对状态的导数为零；不是对一个本应依赖状态的最大波速偷偷冻结导数。页面检查 ∣un∣+c<α|u_n|+c<\alpha。代价是耗散很强：M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2 时 α\alpha 是来流速度的 8.5 倍。第 7 节和第 15 节量化这对压力和载荷意味着什么。

This first version uses piecewise-constant reconstruction and a Rusanov-form flux with the fixed dissipation coefficient α=2\alpha=2. A constant α\alpha is part of the specified method, so its state derivative is zero; it is not an omitted derivative of a state-dependent maximum wave speed. The page checks ∣un∣+c<α|u_n|+c<\alpha. The price is strong dissipation: at M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2, α\alpha is 8.5 times the free-stream speed. Sections 7 and 15 quantify what this does to pressures and loads.

H(UL,UR,𝒏)=Fn(UL)+Fn(UR)2−αℓ2(UR−UL).H(U_L,U_R,\boldsymbol n)=\frac{F_n(U_L)+F_n(U_R)}2-\frac{\alpha\ell}2(U_R-U_L).

图 3.1 把上式拆成代码里的几步：两侧各自从守恒量算出原始变量和物理通量，再与只依赖 UR−ULU_R-U_L 的耗散项组合。图 3.2 在一个具体的面上给出两部分的数值。

Figure 3.1 splits this formula into the steps of the code: each side computes its primitive variables and physical flux from the conserved variables, which are then combined with a dissipation term that depends only on UR−ULU_R-U_L. Figure 3.2 gives the two parts on one particular face.

逐步推导：压力、声速与它们对 UU 的梯度

Step by step: pressure, sound speed and their gradients with respect to UU

第一步，把速度写成守恒量之比 u=(ρu)/ρu=(\rho u)/\rho、v=(ρv)/ρv=(\rho v)/\rho，动能就是 ((ρu)2+(ρv)2)/(2ρ)((\rho u)^2+(\rho v)^2)/(2\rho)。代入第 1 节的状态方程，压力是四个守恒量的显式函数（代码 prim() 算出的 p）：

Step 1, write the velocity as ratios of conserved variables, u=(ρu)/ρu=(\rho u)/\rho and v=(ρv)/ρv=(\rho v)/\rho; the kinetic energy is ((ρu)2+(ρv)2)/(2ρ)((\rho u)^2+(\rho v)^2)/(2\rho). Substituted into the equation of state of Section 1, the pressure is an explicit function of the four conserved variables (the p computed by prim() in the code):

p(U)=(γ−1)(ρE−(ρu)2+(ρv)22ρ).p(U)=(\gamma-1)\Bigl(\rho E-\frac{(\rho u)^2+(\rho v)^2}{2\rho}\Bigr).

第二步，对每个分量求偏导，其余三个固定。只有动能项依赖 ρ\rho、ρu\rho u、ρv\rho v：

Step 2, differentiate with respect to each component, holding the other three fixed. Only the kinetic energy depends on ρ\rho, ρu\rho u and ρv\rho v:

∂p∂ρ=(γ−1)(ρu)2+(ρv)22ρ2=γ−12(u2+v2),∂p∂(ρu)=−(γ−1)u,∂p∂(ρv)=−(γ−1)v,∂p∂(ρE)=γ−1,\frac{\partial p}{\partial\rho}=(\gamma-1)\frac{(\rho u)^2+(\rho v)^2}{2\rho^2}=\frac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2),\quad\frac{\partial p}{\partial(\rho u)}=-(\gamma-1)u,\quad\frac{\partial p}{\partial(\rho v)}=-(\gamma-1)v,\quad\frac{\partial p}{\partial(\rho E)}=\gamma-1,
∂p∂U=(γ−1)(12(u2+v2),  −u,  −v,  1).\frac{\partial p}{\partial U}=(\gamma-1)\Bigl(\tfrac12(u^2+v^2),\;-u,\;-v,\;1\Bigr).

这正是第 8 节 p˙\dot p 公式中各项的系数。第三步，声速 c=γp/ρc=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho}。对 c2=γp/ρc^2=\gamma p/\rho 两边求前向导数，2c c˙=γ(p˙/ρ−p ρ˙/ρ2)2c\,\dot c=\gamma(\dot p/\rho-p\,\dot\rho/\rho^2)，再用 γp/ρ=c2\gamma p/\rho=c^2：

These are exactly the coefficients of the p˙\dot p formula of Section 8. Step 3, the sound speed is c=γp/ρc=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho}. The forward derivative of c2=γp/ρc^2=\gamma p/\rho is 2c c˙=γ(p˙/ρ−p ρ˙/ρ2)2c\,\dot c=\gamma(\dot p/\rho-p\,\dot\rho/\rho^2), and with γp/ρ=c2\gamma p/\rho=c^2:

c˙=γ2ρc p˙−c2ρ ρ˙,∂c∂U=γ2ρc ∂p∂U−c2ρ (1,0,0,0).\dot c=\frac{\gamma}{2\rho c}\,\dot p-\frac{c}{2\rho}\,\dot\rho,\qquad \frac{\partial c}{\partial U}=\frac{\gamma}{2\rho c}\,\frac{\partial p}{\partial U}-\frac{c}{2\rho}\,(1,0,0,0).

第 4 节的壁面通量、第 7 节的目标函数、第 8 节的通量 Jacobian 和远场的 Riemann 不变量 r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1) 都要用这两个梯度。

The wall flux of Section 4, the objective of Section 7, the flux Jacobian of Section 8 and the far-field Riemann invariants r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1) all use these two gradients.

核对：第 4 节 riemann() 的计算图与残差共用同一个 prim()；由它给出的 ∂(r+−r−)/∂U\partial(r_+-r_-)/\partial U 与 ∂S/∂U\partial S/\partial U 按 c=γ−14(r+−r−)c=\tfrac{\gamma-1}4(r_+-r_-)、p=ργSp=\rho^\gamma S 换算出 ∂c/∂U\partial c/\partial U 与 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U，与上面两式在全部 24 个控制体的收敛状态上最大相差 4×10⁻¹⁶（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: the computation graph of riemann() in Section 4 shares prim() with the residual; its ∂(r+−r−)/∂U\partial(r_+-r_-)/\partial U and ∂S/∂U\partial S/\partial U, converted with c=γ−14(r+−r−)c=\tfrac{\gamma-1}4(r_+-r_-) and p=ργSp=\rho^\gamma S, give ∂c/∂U\partial c/\partial U and ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U, which differ from the two formulas above by at most 4×10⁻¹⁶ over the converged states of all 24 volumes (computed by this page’s code at build time).

# U = [rho, rho*u, rho*v, rho*E];  n = area vector (length l)
un_l = (U[1]*nx + U[2]*ny)/U[0]              # l*u_n
p = (gamma-1)*(U[3]-(U[1]**2+U[2]**2)/(2*U[0]))

内部面两侧都有控制体，ULU_L 与 URU_R 都是未知量。边界面只有一侧：物面外面是物体，远场外面没有网格。第 4 节给这两类面补上通量：物面只传递压力，远场按第 1 节的特征计数，从来流和域内各取一部分信息，重建外侧状态 UbU_b。

An interior face has a control volume on each side, and both ULU_L and URU_R are unknowns. A boundary face has only one: beyond the wall lies the body, and beyond the far field there is no mesh. Section 4 completes the flux on both kinds of face: the wall passes only the pressure, and the far field rebuilds an exterior state UbU_b from the free stream and the interior, taking from each as many pieces of information as the characteristic count of Section 1 allows.

第 4 节Section 4

边界：滑移壁面与亚声速特征远场

Boundaries: slip walls and subsonic characteristic far field

第 1 节按特征速度的符号数过条件：物面只要一个条件 un=0u_n=0，远场入流面要三个，出流面要一个。本节把它们写成边界面上的通量。

Section 1 counted the conditions by the signs of the characteristic speeds: the wall needs a single condition, un=0u_n=0, a far-field inflow face three and an outflow face one. This section turns them into fluxes on the boundary faces.

这里与二维标量最重要的区别在物面。无穿透只令质量和能量通量为零；压力仍传递两个方向的动量。壁面通量采用内侧压力 pLp_L，不需要把四个守恒量强行赋值。格心和格点都在边界面上弱施加这条通量规则；格点位于物面并不意味着可以把四行全换成 Dirichlet 约束。

The body boundary is the key difference from the scalar example. No penetration removes the mass and energy fluxes, but pressure still transfers momentum. The wall flux uses the interior pressure pLp_L without assigning all four conserved values. Both schemes impose this flux weakly; placing a node on the wall does not justify replacing all four equations by Dirichlet constraints.

Hwall=(0,  pLnx,  pLny,  0)T,H˙wall=(0,  nxp˙+p n˙x,  nyp˙+p n˙y,  0)T.H_{\mathrm{wall}}=(0,\;p_Ln_x,\;p_Ln_y,\;0)^T,\qquad \dot H_{\mathrm{wall}}=(0,\;n_x\dot p+p\,\dot n_x,\;n_y\dot p+p\,\dot n_y,\;0)^T.

上面的点表示前向（tangent）导数：x˙\dot x 是程序变量 xx 沿给定输入方向的导数，这里 p˙\dot p 来自状态，n˙x\dot n_x、n˙y\dot n_y 来自几何。反向（伴随）量写作 xˉ\bar x。第 8 节完整说明这套自动微分记号。

The dot marks a forward (tangent) derivative: x˙\dot x is the derivative of the program variable xx along a given input direction; here p˙\dot p comes from the state and n˙x\dot n_x, n˙y\dot n_y from the geometry. Reverse (adjoint) quantities are written xˉ\bar x. Section 8 sets out this algorithmic-differentiation notation in full.

逐步推导：壁面通量的 Jacobian 与它的转置

Step by step: the Jacobian of the wall flux and its transpose

第一步，壁面通量只通过压力依赖内侧状态，另外依赖面积向量（代码 flux() 中 bc 为 wall 的分支）：

Step 1, the wall flux depends on the interior state only through the pressure, and otherwise on the area vector (the wall branch of flux() in the code):

Hwall(UL,𝒏)=(0,  p(UL) nx,  p(UL) ny,  0)T.H_{\mathrm{wall}}(U_L,\boldsymbol n)=\bigl(0,\;p(U_L)\,n_x,\;p(U_L)\,n_y,\;0\bigr)^T.

第二步，用第 3 节的 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U 做链式法则。第 0 行与第 3 行恒为零，第 1、2 行是同一个行向量乘以 nxn_x、nyn_y，所以这个 4×44\times4 块的秩是 1：

Step 2, apply the chain rule with ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U from Section 3. Rows 0 and 3 are identically zero and rows 1 and 2 are the same row vector times nxn_x and nyn_y, so this 4×44\times4 block has rank one:

∂Hwall∂UL=[𝟎Tnx ∂p/∂Uny ∂p/∂U𝟎T]=(γ−1)[000012(u2+v2)nx−unx−vnxnx12(u2+v2)ny−uny−vnyny0000].\frac{\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}}{\partial U_L}=\begin{bmatrix}\boldsymbol 0^T\\ n_x\,\partial p/\partial U\\ n_y\,\partial p/\partial U\\ \boldsymbol 0^T\end{bmatrix}=(\gamma-1)\begin{bmatrix}0&0&0&0\\ \tfrac12(u^2+v^2)n_x&-un_x&-vn_x&n_x\\ \tfrac12(u^2+v^2)n_y&-un_y&-vn_y&n_y\\ 0&0&0&0\end{bmatrix}.

第三步，转置。反向扫描把面通量的伴随 Hˉ\bar H（四个分量）乘以这个块的转置；两行非零的块转置后只剩一个组合：

Step 3, transpose. The reverse sweep multiplies the adjoint Hˉ\bar H of the face flux (four components) by the transposed block; with two nonzero rows, only one combination survives:

(∂Hwall∂UL)THˉ=(∂p∂U)Tpˉ,pˉ=nxHˉρu+nyHˉρv:UˉL+=(∂p∂U)Tpˉ.\Bigl(\frac{\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}}{\partial U_L}\Bigr)^T\bar H=\Bigl(\frac{\partial p}{\partial U}\Bigr)^T\bar p,\qquad \bar p=n_x\bar H_{\rho u}+n_y\bar H_{\rho v}:\qquad \bar U_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Bigl(\frac{\partial p}{\partial U}\Bigr)^T\bar p.

质量和能量两个分量 Hˉρ\bar H_\rho、HˉρE\bar H_{\rho E} 根本不经过物面传回；经过物面的只有动量分量的伴随在法向上的投影 pˉ=nxHˉρu+nyHˉρv\bar p=n_x\bar H_{\rho u}+n_y\bar H_{\rho v}，也就是壁面压力的伴随，它再按 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U 分给四个守恒量。第 16 节的连续物面条件约束的正是同一个组合 λρun^x+λρvn^y\lambda_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\lambda_{\rho v}\hat n_y。第四步，几何导数：状态固定时 ∂Hwall/∂𝒏=p (𝒆ρu,𝒆ρv)\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial\boldsymbol n=p\,(\boldsymbol e_{\rho u},\boldsymbol e_{\rho v})，即上面的 H˙wall\dot H_{\mathrm{wall}} 公式中的 p n˙xp\,\dot n_x、p n˙yp\,\dot n_y 两项。

The mass and energy components Hˉρ\bar H_\rho and HˉρE\bar H_{\rho E} do not return through the wall at all; only the normal projection of the momentum adjoints, pˉ=nxHˉρu+nyHˉρv\bar p=n_x\bar H_{\rho u}+n_y\bar H_{\rho v}, passes: it is the adjoint of the wall pressure, and ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U distributes it over the four conserved variables. The continuous wall condition of Section 16 constrains exactly the same combination λρun^x+λρvn^y\lambda_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\lambda_{\rho v}\hat n_y. Step 4, the geometry derivative: at fixed state ∂Hwall/∂𝒏=p (𝒆ρu,𝒆ρv)\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial\boldsymbol n=p\,(\boldsymbol e_{\rho u},\boldsymbol e_{\rho v}), which are the terms p n˙xp\,\dot n_x and p n˙yp\,\dot n_y of the H˙wall\dot H_{\mathrm{wall}} formula above.

核对：在全部 16 个物面半面上，计算图对单位种子的前向结果与上面的矩阵最大相差 3×10⁻¹⁸；以伴随解 ψL\psi_L 作为 Hˉ\bar H 时，计算图的逆序结果与第三步的公式最大相差 2×10⁻¹⁸（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: on all 16 wall half-faces the forward results of the computation graph for unit seeds differ from the matrix above by at most 3×10⁻¹⁸; with the adjoint ψL\psi_L as Hˉ\bar H, the reversed graph differs from the formula of Step 3 by at most 2×10⁻¹⁸ (computed by this page’s code at build time).

远场：先旋转到法向与切向

Far field: rotate to normal and tangential components

设 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} 为指向域外的单位法向，𝒕^=(−n^y,n^x)\hat{\boldsymbol t}=(-\hat n_y,\hat n_x) 为切向。速度分解为 un=𝒖⋅𝒏^u_n=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol n} 与 ut=𝒖⋅𝒕^u_t=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol t}，反过来 𝒖=un𝒏^+ut𝒕^\boldsymbol u=u_n\hat{\boldsymbol n}+u_t\hat{\boldsymbol t}。

Let 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} be the unit normal pointing out of the domain and 𝒕^=(−n^y,n^x)\hat{\boldsymbol t}=(-\hat n_y,\hat n_x) the tangent. Split the velocity into un=𝒖⋅𝒏^u_n=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol n} and ut=𝒖⋅𝒕^u_t=\boldsymbol u\cdot\hat{\boldsymbol t}; conversely 𝒖=un𝒏^+ut𝒕^\boldsymbol u=u_n\hat{\boldsymbol n}+u_t\hat{\boldsymbol t}.

un=un^x+vn^y,ut=−un^y+vn^x;u=unn^x−utn^y,v=unn^y+utn^x.u_n=u\hat n_x+v\hat n_y,\quad u_t=-u\hat n_y+v\hat n_x;\qquad u=u_n\hat n_x-u_t\hat n_y,\quad v=u_n\hat n_y+u_t\hat n_x.

Riemann 不变量从哪里来

Where the Riemann invariants come from

在面附近只保留沿 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} 的变化（坐标记为 ξ\xi），得到一维 Euler 方程。对等熵流，dp=c2dρdp=c^2d\rho，而 c2=γp/ρc^2=\gamma p/\rho 给出 dc=γ−12 c dρ/ρdc=\tfrac{\gamma-1}2\,c\,d\rho/\rho，所以 dp/(ρc)=2 dc/(γ−1)dp/(\rho c)=2\,dc/(\gamma-1)。把连续方程乘 c/ρc/\rho 后与动量方程相加或相减，得到两个沿特征输运的量；熵函数 SS 与切向速度则以速度 unu_n 随流输运。

Near the face keep only variations along 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} (coordinate ξ\xi); this gives the one-dimensional Euler equations. For isentropic flow dp=c2dρdp=c^2d\rho, and c2=γp/ρc^2=\gamma p/\rho gives dc=γ−12 c dρ/ρdc=\tfrac{\gamma-1}2\,c\,d\rho/\rho, so dp/(ρc)=2 dc/(γ−1)dp/(\rho c)=2\,dc/(\gamma-1). Adding or subtracting c/ρc/\rho times the continuity equation to the momentum equation gives two quantities transported along characteristics; the entropy function SS and the tangential velocity move with the flow at speed unu_n.

(∂t+(un±c)∂ξ)r±=0,r±=un±2cγ−1;(∂t+un∂ξ)S=0,(∂t+un∂ξ)ut=0,S=pργ.\bigl(\partial_t+(u_n\pm c)\partial_\xi\bigr)r_\pm=0,\quad r_\pm=u_n\pm\frac{2c}{\gamma-1};\qquad (\partial_t+u_n\partial_\xi)S=0,\quad(\partial_t+u_n\partial_\xi)u_t=0,\quad S=\frac p{\rho^\gamma}.

亚声速时 un+c>0u_n+c>0，r+r_+ 总从域内来；un−c<0u_n-c<0，r−r_- 总从域外来。SS 与 utu_t 的速度是 unu_n：入流面（un<0u_n<0）从来流取，出流面（un>0u_n>0）从域内取。所以入流面从外部取三项信息、出流面只取一项，不能像标量那样把整个状态一起复制。这个闭合只在局部一维、等熵的意义下是特征关系，不宣称是精确无反射边界。

For subsonic flow un+c>0u_n+c>0, so r+r_+ always comes from inside; un−c<0u_n-c<0, so r−r_- always comes from outside. SS and utu_t move at unu_n: they come from the free stream at an inflow face (un<0u_n<0) and from inside at an outflow face (un>0u_n>0). An inflow face therefore takes three pieces of outside information and an outflow face only one; copying the whole state as for the scalar is inappropriate. The closure is characteristic only in the local one-dimensional, isentropic sense; it is not claimed to be exactly non-reflecting.

为什么入／出流分支冻结在基准来流

Why the inflow/outflow branch is frozen at the base free stream

入流还是出流是一个判断语句，在 un=0u_n=0 处不连续。如果每次计算残差都重新判断，RR 就不再是 UU 与设计变量的光滑函数，Newton、tangent、adjoint 和差分都可能跨过这个跳跃。本页在求解之前，用基准几何的法向和基准来流方向判断每个远场面（𝒏f⋅(cos⁡θ,sin⁡θ)<0\boldsymbol n_f\cdot(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)<0 为入流），然后在整个求解和全部求导中保持不变。这样 RR 在基准点附近是一个固定的光滑函数，对 θ\theta 求导也不会切换分支。页面再检查收敛后的 un,bu_{n,b} 与冻结的分支同号。若改变 M∞M_\infty、θ\theta 或几何使某个面接近掠入射，分支可能改变，就必须重新判断并重新求解，而不能外推当前的导数。下面的 θ\theta 滑块演示这一点。

Inflow versus outflow is an if-statement, discontinuous at un=0u_n=0. Re-deciding it at every residual evaluation would make RR a non-smooth function of UU and the design variables, and Newton, tangent, adjoint and finite differences could straddle the jump. Before the solve, this page classifies each far-field face with the base geometry normal and the base free-stream direction (𝒏f⋅(cos⁡θ,sin⁡θ)<0\boldsymbol n_f\cdot(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)<0 means inflow) and keeps that choice for the whole solve and every derivative. RR is then one fixed smooth function near the base point, and differentiating with respect to θ\theta never switches a branch. The page checks that the converged un,bu_{n,b} has the frozen sign. If M∞M_\infty, θ\theta or the geometry move a face towards grazing flow, the branch may change; then reclassify and re-solve instead of extrapolating the derivative. The θ\theta slider below shows this.

伴随怎样穿过边界状态

How the adjoint passes through the boundary state

远场面通量同时经由 ULU_L 与 Ub=G(UL)U_b=G(U_L) 依赖内侧状态。记 W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t) 为 Riemann 坐标，边界闭合就是 Wb=IoutWL+(I−Iout)W∞W_b=I_{\mathrm{out}}W_L+(I-I_{\mathrm{out}})W_\infty：对角矩阵 IoutI_{\mathrm{out}} 在出域特征（从域内取的量）处为 1、其余为 0，其余的量取自来流。于是：

A far-field flux depends on the interior state both through ULU_L and through Ub=G(UL)U_b=G(U_L). With the Riemann coordinates W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t), the closure is Wb=IoutWL+(I−Iout)W∞W_b=I_{\mathrm{out}}W_L+(I-I_{\mathrm{out}})W_\infty: the diagonal matrix IoutI_{\mathrm{out}} is 1 on the outgoing characteristics (taken from inside) and 0 elsewhere; the rest comes from the free stream. Hence:

∂H∂UL=HUL+HUbGU,HUL=12Fn,U(UL)+αℓ2I,HUb=12Fn,U(Ub)−αℓ2I,\frac{\partial H}{\partial U_L}=H_{U_L}+H_{U_b}G_U,\qquad H_{U_L}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I,\qquad H_{U_b}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_b)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I,
GU=∂U∂W∣UbIout ∂W∂U∣UL,Iout={diag(1,0,0,0),un<0diag(1,0,1,1),un>0,G_U=\frac{\partial U}{\partial W}\Big|_{U_b}I_{\mathrm{out}}\,\frac{\partial W}{\partial U}\Big|_{U_L},\qquad I_{\mathrm{out}}=\begin{cases}\mathrm{diag}(1,0,0,0),&u_n<0\\\mathrm{diag}(1,0,1,1),&u_n>0\end{cases},
(∂H∂UL)THˉ=HULTHˉ+GUT(HUbTHˉ):Uˉb=HUbTHˉ,UˉL+=HULTHˉ+GUTUˉb.\Bigl(\frac{\partial H}{\partial U_L}\Bigr)^T\bar H=H_{U_L}^T\bar H+G_U^T\bigl(H_{U_b}^T\bar H\bigr):\qquad \bar U_b=H_{U_b}^T\bar H,\quad \bar U_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_{U_L}^T\bar H+G_U^T\bar U_b.

这里 Fn,U=∂Fn/∂UF_{n,U}=\partial F_n/\partial U 是 4×44\times4 的局部通量 Jacobian，Hˉ\bar H 是该面通量 HH 的伴随（反向扫描交给这个面的种子，第 9 节）。反向时 Hˉ\bar H 先乘 HUbTH_{U_b}^T，得到边界状态的伴随 Uˉb\bar U_b，再经过 GUTG_U^T 加到 UˉL\bar U_L：因为 IoutI_{\mathrm{out}} 把来流分量置零，只有出域特征的分量能回到内侧状态。代码不手写这个矩阵，而是逆序执行 far() 的每个标量运算；附录 A 实测两者一致到舍入误差。

Here Fn,U=∂Fn/∂UF_{n,U}=\partial F_n/\partial U is the 4×44\times4 local flux Jacobian and Hˉ\bar H the adjoint of the face flux HH (the seed the reverse sweep hands to this face, Section 9). In reverse, Hˉ\bar H is first multiplied by HUbTH_{U_b}^T, giving the adjoint Uˉb\bar U_b of the boundary state, which then passes through GUTG_U^T into UˉL\bar U_L; because IoutI_{\mathrm{out}} zeroes the free-stream components, only outgoing characteristic components return to the interior state. The code never writes this matrix by hand: it reverses every scalar operation of far(), and Appendix A measures agreement to round-off.

交互面板：θ\theta 滑块（与页首无关）用新的来流方向重新判断远场面并重新求解。特征图画出所选入流面与出流面上的四个特征速度 un−cu_n-c、unu_n、unu_n、un+cu_n+c，箭头说明每个量来自域内还是域外。表中壁面行没有边界状态，所以不显示边界声速。下方的逐步表和 GUG_U 针对所选远场面现场计算，并把当前伴随解 ψL\psi_L 作为 Hˉ\bar H 展示两条反传路径。

Interactive panel: the θ\theta slider (independent of the header) reclassifies the far-field faces for the new free-stream direction and re-solves. The characteristic diagram draws the four speeds un−cu_n-c, unu_n, unu_n, un+cu_n+c at the selected inflow and outflow faces; arrows show whether each quantity comes from inside or outside. Wall rows have no boundary state, so they show no boundary sound speed. 残差：同一个面，两个相反贡献

Residual: one face, two opposite contributions

先固定离散问题与符号

Fix the discrete problem and its notation

本页每个节点存储 4 个未知量。以下用 𝐔\mathbf U 表示把所有位置、所有分量按代码顺序排成的列向量。它是一个有限维向量，不是连续函数。物理方程中的空间导数只用于说明模型；求离散伴随时，求导对象是本页实际装配的有限维函数。

Each node stores 4 unknowns. Below, 𝐔\mathbf U stacks all locations and components in code order. It is a finite-dimensional vector, not a continuous function. Spatial derivatives in the physical equations explain the model; discrete differentiation acts on the actual finite-dimensional functions assembled on this page.

𝐔∈ℝnu,D∈ℝna,\mathbf U\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad D\in\mathbb R^{n_a},
R:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝnu,J:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝ.R:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad J:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R.

DD 是本页全部设计变量排成的向量：来流马赫数 M∞M_\infty、攻角 θ\theta 与全部节点坐标 XX。第 11 节的 ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T 与 dJ/dD=JD+ψTRDdJ/dD=J_D+\psi^TR_D 就是下面方框里的两式（行、列只差一次转置）。局部通量 Jacobian（如 ∂Fn/∂U\partial F_n/\partial U）与全局残差 Jacobian AA 是不同的对象。每个位置的局部状态 UiU_i 是一个小列向量，全局的 𝐔\mathbf U 才是 Jacobian 的输入。

DD stacks all design variables of this page: the free-stream Mach number M∞M_\infty, the angle θ\theta and all node coordinates XX. The ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T and dJ/dD=JD+ψTRDdJ/dD=J_D+\psi^TR_D of Section 11 are the two boxed formulas below (row and column forms differ by one transpose). A local flux Jacobian such as ∂Fn/∂U\partial F_n/\partial U is a different object from the global residual Jacobian AA. A local state UiU_i is a small column vector; the global 𝐔\mathbf U is the input of the Jacobian.

A=∂R∂𝐔∈ℝnu×nu,RD=∂R∂D∈ℝnu×na,A=\frac{\partial R}{\partial \mathbf U}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_u},\quad R_D=\frac{\partial R}{\partial D}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_a},
JUT=(∂J∂𝐔)T∈ℝnu,JDT=(∂J∂D)T∈ℝna.J_U^T=\Big(\frac{\partial J}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad J_D^T=\Big(\frac{\partial J}{\partial D}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_a}.

这里 JUTJ_U^T、JDTJ_D^T 都是列向量，它们的转置才是偏导数行。求导采用自动微分（AD）的记号：程序变量 xx 上加点的 x˙\dot x 是前向（tangent）模式沿给定种子方向的导数，加横线的 xˉ\bar x 是反向（adjoint）模式累加到 xx 上的权重，例如 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 与 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U}。两者都是对本页有限维代码求导；变分符号 δ\delta 只用于第 16 节与附录 A 的连续伴随里连续函数的变分。

Both JUTJ_U^T and JDTJ_D^T are columns; their transposes are the derivative rows. Derivatives use the notation of automatic differentiation (AD): a dot x˙\dot x on a program variable xx is its forward (tangent) derivative along the chosen seed direction, and a bar xˉ\bar x is the weight accumulated into xx in reverse (adjoint) mode, for example 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U}. Both differentiate the finite-dimensional code of this page; the variation symbol δ\delta is kept for variations of continuous functions in the continuous adjoint of Section 16 and Appendix A.

一个控制体现在对应四条积分平衡方程。RiR_i 是四分量流出通量之和，稳态要求全部分量为零。内部面只计算一次 HH，并向左加、向右减。这使全域求和时内部贡献精确抵消，是几何导数和伴随也必须保留的计算结构。

Each volume now has four integrated balance equations. RiR_i sums its outward fluxes; steady state requires every component to vanish. An internal face computes HH once, adds it to the left and subtracts it from the right. Internal contributions cancel globally, a structure also preserved by geometry derivatives and adjoints.

Ri(U,D)=∑fℬifHf,ℬLf=+1,ℬRf=−1,R(U∗,D)=0.R_i(U,D)=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_f,\qquad \mathcal B_{Lf}=+1,\quad \mathcal B_{Rf}=-1,\qquad R(U^*,D)=0.

DD 是全部设计变量（来流 M∞M_\infty、θ\theta 与节点坐标）排成的向量，第 10 节给出它的内容。这里没有除以控制体体积。若写非定常方程，则是 Vi dUi/dt+Ri=0V_i\,dU_i/dt+R_i=0。当前 Newton 法求解的对象是积分残差，其 Jacobian、收敛阈值和伴随乘子都沿用这一约定。播放器逐面显示读取、通量、左累加、右累加，四个分量可以分别查看；“播放”按钮会自动逐步前进。

DD stacks all design variables (the free-stream M∞M_\infty, θ\theta and the node coordinates); Section 10 lists them. Residuals are not divided by volume. An unsteady equation would be Vi dUi/dt+Ri=0V_i\,dU_i/dt+R_i=0. Newton solves the integrated residual, so its Jacobian, tolerances and adjoint multipliers use that convention. The player exposes gather, flux, left scatter and right scatter for each face, with all four components selectable; the Play button steps automatically.

逐步推导：内部贡献在全域求和中相消

Step by step: interior contributions cancel in the global sum

第一步，把所有控制体的第 kk 个分量相加，并交换两个有限求和的次序：

Step 1, add component kk over all volumes and exchange the two finite sums:

∑iRi,k=∑i∑fℬifHf,k=∑fHf,k∑iℬif.\sum_iR_{i,k}=\sum_i\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{f,k}=\sum_fH_{f,k}\sum_i\mathcal B_{if}.

第二步，内部面的一列恰有 +1+1 和 −1-1 各一个，列和为零；边界面的一列只有一个 +1+1。第三步，于是全域残差之和只剩边界通量：

Step 2, an interior column holds one +1+1 and one −1-1 and sums to zero; a boundary column holds a single +1+1. Step 3, so the sum of all residuals keeps only the boundary fluxes:

∑iRi=∑f∈wall ∪ farHf.\sum_iR_i=\sum_{f\in\mathrm{wall}\,\cup\,\mathrm{far}}H_f.

这就是离散守恒：内部面的通量只在控制体之间搬运守恒量，不产生也不消灭。它依赖“每个面只算一次 HfH_f”：如果左右两侧各算一次通量（例如用了不同的边界状态），抵消就不再精确。稳态时两边都为零，所以核对取 Newton 的第一个迭代 U1U^1，那里残差不为零。

This is discrete conservation: interior fluxes only move conserved quantities between volumes, creating or destroying nothing. It relies on computing HfH_f once per face: if each side computed its own flux (for example with different boundary states), the cancellation would no longer be exact. At the steady state both sides vanish, so the check uses the first Newton iterate U1U^1, where the residual is not zero.

Check: at U1U^1, ∥R∥2=6.8×10−3\|R\|_2=6.8×10⁻³; the global sums of the four components are (1.2×10⁻³, −2.8×10⁻⁴, −5.2×10⁻⁴, 6.2×10⁻³) and differ from the sums of the boundary fluxes by at most 6×10⁻¹⁶ (computed by this page’s code at build time).

第 6 节Section 6

Jacobian、Newton 与 GS 预处理 GMRES

Jacobian, Newton and GS-preconditioned GMRES

标量 Jacobian 的一个非零数，现在变成一个 4×44\times4 状态块。内部通量把相邻两个控制体耦合；边界状态又引入内侧状态的链式导数。我们保持精确算子 matrix-free，用 Newton 解非线性残差，再由 GMRES 解每次线性修正。

A scalar Jacobian entry becomes a 4×44\times4 state block. Interior faces couple neighbouring volumes, while boundary states add chain-rule terms. The exact operator stays matrix-free. Newton solves the nonlinear residual and GMRES solves each linear correction.

A=∂R∂U,A(Uk) ΔU=−R(Uk),Uk+1=Uk+τ ΔU.A=\frac{\partial R}{\partial U},\qquad A(U^k)\,\Delta U=-R(U^k),\qquad U^{k+1}=U^k+\tau\,\Delta U.

GS 预处理只取固定数值耗散形成的图 Laplacian 近似：内部面给两侧对角加 αℓ/2\alpha\ell/2、相邻块加 −αℓI4/2-\alpha\ell I_4/2；边界只增加对角近似。取它的对角部分 diag⁡(P)\operatorname{diag}(P) 与严格下三角部分 NN，P=diag⁡(P)+NP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N，做一次前向 GS 三角求解；伴随用 PTP^T 的反向扫描。这个 PP 省略了压力和特征边界导数，仅负责加速，最终线性残差仍用完整的 AA 或 ATA^T 检查。

The GS preconditioner approximates only the numerical dissipation: internal faces add αℓ/2\alpha\ell/2 to both diagonals and −αℓI4/2-\alpha\ell I_4/2 to neighbouring blocks; boundaries add a diagonal approximation. With its diagonal part diag⁡(P)\operatorname{diag}(P) and strictly lower part NN, one forward GS solve applies the inverse of P=diag⁡(P)+NP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N. The adjoint uses a backward solve with PTP^T. Pressure and characteristic-boundary derivatives are omitted only from PP, not from the exact operator used to check convergence.

AP−1g=b,x=P−1g,ATP−Tg=b,x=P−Tg.AP^{-1}g=b,\quad x=P^{-1}g,\qquad A^TP^{-T}g=b,\quad x=P^{-T}g.

图 6.1 画出本页收敛解上 AA 的块结构与 PP 的块结构。

Figure 6.1 shows the block structure of AA at this page’s converged solution next to that of PP.

逐步推导：内部控制体的对角块正好是 PiiP_{ii}

Step by step: the diagonal block of an interior volume is exactly PiiP_{ii}

第一步，控制体 ii 的对角块收集它的每个面对 UiU_i 的导数，符号就是 ℬif\mathcal B_{if}：ii 是 LL 时取 HULH_{U_L}，是 RR 时取 −HUR-H_{U_R}。

Step 1, the diagonal block of volume ii collects the derivative of each of its faces with respect to UiU_i, with the sign ℬif\mathcal B_{if}: HULH_{U_L} where ii is LL, and −HUR-H_{U_R} where ii is RR.

Aii=∑f: L(f)=iHUL(f)−∑f: R(f)=iHUR(f).A_{ii}=\sum_{f:\,L(f)=i}H_{U_L}(f)-\sum_{f:\,R(f)=i}H_{U_R}(f).

第二步，代入第 8 节推导的线性化 HUL=12Fn,U(UL)+αℓf2IH_{U_L}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I、HUR=12Fn,U(UR)−αℓf2IH_{U_R}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_R)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I。两种情况都在 UiU_i 上求值，并且都可以用外法向 𝒏if=ℬif𝒏f\boldsymbol n_{if}=\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f 写成同一个形式（Fn,UF_{n,U} 对 𝒏\boldsymbol n 是线性的，−F𝒏,U=F−𝒏,U-F_{\boldsymbol n,U}=F_{-\boldsymbol n,U}）：

Step 2, insert the linearisation derived in Section 8, HUL=12Fn,U(UL)+αℓf2IH_{U_L}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I and HUR=12Fn,U(UR)−αℓf2IH_{U_R}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_R)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I. Both are evaluated at UiU_i, and both take the same form with the outward vector 𝒏if=ℬif𝒏f\boldsymbol n_{if}=\mathcal B_{if}\boldsymbol n_f (Fn,UF_{n,U} is linear in 𝒏\boldsymbol n, so −F𝒏,U=F−𝒏,U-F_{\boldsymbol n,U}=F_{-\boldsymbol n,U}):

Aii=∑f(12F𝒏if,U(Ui)+αℓf2I)=12F∑f𝒏if, U(Ui)+(∑fαℓf2)I.A_{ii}=\sum_f\Bigl(\tfrac12F_{\boldsymbol n_{if},U}(U_i)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I\Bigr)=\tfrac12F_{\sum_f\boldsymbol n_{if},\,U}(U_i)+\Bigl(\sum_f\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2\Bigr)I.

第三步，第 2 节证明了 ∑f𝒏if=0\sum_f\boldsymbol n_{if}=0，第一项消失；对不含边界面的控制体 ii，剩下的正是 GS 预处理的对角元：

Step 3, Section 2 showed ∑f𝒏if=0\sum_f\boldsymbol n_{if}=0; the first term vanishes, and for a volume ii without boundary faces what remains is exactly the diagonal of the GS preconditioner:

Aii=Pii=(∑f∋iαℓf2)I4.A_{ii}=P_{ii}=\Bigl(\sum_{f\ni i}\frac{\alpha\ell_f}2\Bigr)I_4.

第四步，边界控制体不同：它的物面面用第 4 节的 ∂Hwall/∂UL\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial U_L 代替 12Fn,U+αℓ2I\tfrac12F_{n,U}+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I，远场面多出 HUbGUH_{U_b}G_U，第二步的抵消不再成立，AiiA_{ii} 是满的 4×44\times4 块。第五步，非对角块 ALR=HUR=12Fn,U(UR)−αℓf2IA_{LR}=H_{U_R}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_R)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I：PP 只保留其中的耗散部分 −αℓf2I-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I，并且只放在下三角（编号较大的一行）。所以 PP 在内部控制体的对角上是精确的，非对角块只近似了耗散部分。

Step 4, boundary volumes differ: a wall face contributes ∂Hwall/∂UL\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial U_L of Section 4 instead of 12Fn,U+αℓ2I\tfrac12F_{n,U}+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I, and a far-field face adds HUbGUH_{U_b}G_U; the cancellation of Step 2 fails and AiiA_{ii} is a full 4×44\times4 block. Step 5, an off-diagonal block is ALR=HUR=12Fn,U(UR)−αℓf2IA_{LR}=H_{U_R}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_R)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I: PP keeps only its dissipation part −αℓf2I-\tfrac{\alpha\ell_f}2I, and only in the lower triangle (the row with the larger index). So PP is exact on the diagonal of interior volumes and approximates the off-diagonal blocks by their dissipation part.

核对：8 个内部控制体上 max⁡∣Aii−Pii∣=4×10−16\max|A_{ii}-P_{ii}|=4×10⁻¹⁶；其余 16 个边界控制体中差别最小的一个也有 0.499（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: over the 8 interior volumes max⁡∣Aii−Pii∣=4×10−16\max|A_{ii}-P_{ii}|=4×10⁻¹⁶; among the other 16 boundary volumes even the smallest difference is 0.499 (computed by this page’s code at build time).

逐步推导：GS 三角求解、它的转置与伴随中的 PTP^T

Step by step: the GS triangular solve, its transpose, and PTP^T in the adjoint

第一步，P=diag⁡(P)+NP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N 是块下三角矩阵（每块都是标量乘 I4I_4）。GMRES 每一步都要把 P−1P^{-1} 作用在一个向量 gg 上，也就是解 Px=gPx=g：按控制体编号从小到大做前向替换，这就是代码 precondition() 中不转置的分支：

Step 1, P=diag⁡(P)+NP=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N is block lower triangular (every block a scalar times I4I_4). Every GMRES step applies P−1P^{-1} to a vector gg, i.e. solves Px=gPx=g by forward substitution in increasing volume order, the non-transposed branch of precondition() in the code:

xi=Pii−1(gi−∑j<iNijxj),i=0,1,…,nu4−1.x_i=P_{ii}^{-1}\Bigl(g_i-\sum_{j<i}N_{ij}x_j\Bigr),\qquad i=0,1,\dots,\tfrac{n_u}4-1.

第二步，PT=diag⁡(P)+NTP^T=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N^T 是块上三角矩阵，PTx=gP^Tx=g 要按编号从大到小做后向替换。代码的转置分支先乘以 Pii−1P_{ii}^{-1}，再把 NijxiN_{ij}x_i 从所有 j<ij<i 的分量中减去，是同一个后向替换的“按列”写法：

Step 2, PT=diag⁡(P)+NTP^T=\operatorname{diag}(P)+N^T is block upper triangular, so PTx=gP^Tx=g needs backward substitution in decreasing order. The transposed branch of the code first applies Pii−1P_{ii}^{-1} and then subtracts NijxiN_{ij}x_i from every component j<ij<i, the column-oriented form of the same backward substitution:

xi=Pii−1(gi−∑j>iNjixj),i=nu4−1,…,1,0.x_i=P_{ii}^{-1}\Bigl(g_i-\sum_{j>i}N_{ji}x_j\Bigr),\qquad i=\tfrac{n_u}4-1,\dots,1,0.

第三步，右预处理的 GMRES 求解上面的 AP−1g=bAP^{-1}g=b、x=P−1gx=P^{-1}g。伴随方程的矩阵是 ATA^T；既然 P≈AP\approx A，就有 PT≈ATP^T\approx A^T，所以伴随用 P−TP^{-T}。AA 与 PP 都不对称，拿 P−1P^{-1} 去预处理 ATA^T 就是用错了矩阵。第四步，GS 定常迭代 x←x+P−1(b−Ax)x\leftarrow x+P^{-1}(b-Ax) 的误差每步乘以 I−P−1AI-P^{-1}A，只有它的谱半径小于 1 才收敛，而且收敛速度就由谱半径决定；GMRES 用同样的矩阵乘积，却在已生成的 Krylov 子空间里使残差最小。

Step 3, right-preconditioned GMRES solves the AP−1g=bAP^{-1}g=b, x=P−1gx=P^{-1}g above. The adjoint matrix is ATA^T; since P≈AP\approx A, also PT≈ATP^T\approx A^T, so the adjoint uses P−TP^{-T}. Neither AA nor PP is symmetric, and preconditioning ATA^T with P−1P^{-1} would use the wrong matrix. Step 4, the stationary GS iteration x←x+P−1(b−Ax)x\leftarrow x+P^{-1}(b-Ax) multiplies its error by I−P−1AI-P^{-1}A in every step; it converges only if the spectral radius of that matrix is below one, and the radius sets its speed. GMRES uses the same matrix products but minimises the residual over the Krylov space built so far.

核对：对两个固定的向量 gg、g′g'，⟨P−1g,g′⟩\langle P^{-1}g,g'\rangle 与 ⟨g,P−Tg′⟩\langle g,P^{-T}g'\rangle 的相对差为 2×10⁻¹⁶，所以代码的反向扫描正是 P−1P^{-1} 的转置；定常迭代的残差每步约乘以 0.918（Newton 方程）与 0.924（伴随方程），也就是每下降一个数量级约需 27 与 29 步（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: for two fixed vectors gg and g′g', ⟨P−1g,g′⟩\langle P^{-1}g,g'\rangle and ⟨g,P−Tg′⟩\langle g,P^{-T}g'\rangle differ by 2×10⁻¹⁶ relatively, so the backward sweep of the code is exactly the transpose of P−1P^{-1}; the stationary iteration multiplies the residual by about 0.918 per step (Newton system) and 0.924 (adjoint system), about 27 and 29 steps per decade (computed by this page’s code at build time).

图 6.2 把三种解法放在一起，都迭代到舍入误差的底部。

Figure 6.2 puts the three solvers side by side, each run to the round-off floor.

修正若使密度或压力失去正值，或离开本例设定的亚声速范围，就减小步长 τ\tau；同时要求残差下降。这个线搜索只用于找到收敛解。后面的稳态 tangent／adjoint 对 R(U∗)=0R(U^*)=0 求导，不是对接受了几次回退这一离散逻辑求导。下图的播放器逐次显示 Newton 迭代的流场：从均匀来流 U∞U_\infty 出发，每一步都同时修正整个流场。

A line search reduces the step τ\tau if density or pressure loses positivity, the state leaves the permitted subsonic range, or the residual fails to decrease. It only locates the converged solution. The steady tangent/adjoint differentiates R(U∗)=0R(U^*)=0, not the discrete history of accepted line-search decisions. 第 7 节Section 7

目标函数：物面压力合力

Objective: integrated pressure force on the body

从拟一维的推力目标推广到二维物面压力合力。𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f 指向流体域外、也就是物体内部，所以流体施加给物体的压力合力为 ∑p 𝒏f\sum p\,\boldsymbol n_f。页面可选固定坐标方向的 x 分量 JxJ_x 或 y 分量 JyJ_y（单位向量 𝒆d\boldsymbol e_d 取 𝒆x\boldsymbol e_x 或 𝒆y\boldsymbol e_y）；这里没有除以动压或参考长度，也不是随攻角旋转的气动升阻力系数。

Extend the quasi-one-dimensional thrust objective to the pressure force on the body. 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f points out of the fluid domain, into the body, so the pressure force of the fluid on the body is ∑p 𝒏f\sum p\,\boldsymbol n_f. Choose its fixed Cartesian x component JxJ_x or y component JyJ_y (unit vector 𝒆d\boldsymbol e_d equal to 𝒆x\boldsymbol e_x or 𝒆y\boldsymbol e_y). These are raw force integrals: they are not divided by the dynamic pressure or a reference length, and they are not lift or drag coefficients in axes rotated with the incidence.

J(U,D)=∑f∈wallp(UL(f)) 𝒏f⋅𝒆d,J˙=∑wall((𝒏f⋅𝒆d) p˙+p 𝒏˙f⋅𝒆d).J(U,D)=\sum_{f\in\mathrm{wall}}p\bigl(U_{L(f)}\bigr)\,\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d,\qquad \dot J=\sum_{\mathrm{wall}}\Bigl((\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)\,\dot p+p\,\dot{\boldsymbol n}_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d\Bigr).

第一项给状态偏导数 JUJ_U，第二项给固定状态下的直接几何偏导数 JDJ_D。遗漏第二项，会导致形状梯度即使求解器收敛也不正确。格点版本在每个边界半面用相应端点状态的压力，因此它和格心格式是两个明确不同的离散目标。若需要随来流旋转的阻力与升力，就把两个分量旋转到来流方向：

The first term gives the state derivative JUJ_U, the second the direct geometry derivative JDJ_D at fixed state. Omitting the latter gives an incorrect shape gradient even with fully converged solvers. The node scheme uses the associated endpoint pressure on each boundary half-face, so the two schemes define distinct discrete objectives. Drag and lift in the free-stream axes are the two components rotated into the free-stream direction:

J∥=Jxcos⁡θ+Jysin⁡θ,J⊥=−Jxsin⁡θ+Jycos⁡θ,J_\parallel=J_x\cos\theta+J_y\sin\theta,\qquad J_\perp=-J_x\sin\theta+J_y\cos\theta,

J∥J_\parallel 是沿来流方向的阻力，J⊥J_\perp 是垂直来流的升力；它们仍是每单位展长的力，而不是系数。

J∥J_\parallel is the drag along the free stream and J⊥J_\perp the lift normal to it; both are still forces per unit span, not coefficients.

图 7.1 画出 JJ 的每一项；图 7.2 按物面位置把这些项累加起来。

逐步推导：目标函数的偏导数 JUJ_U 与 JXJ_X

Step by step: the partial derivatives JUJ_U and JXJ_X of the objective

第一步，状态只通过物面节点的压力进入 JJ。对控制体 ii 的四个分量求偏导，用第 3 节的 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U：

Step 1, the state enters JJ only through the pressure of the wall nodes. Differentiate with respect to the four components of volume ii, using ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U of Section 3:

∂J∂Ui=(∑f∈wall, L(f)=i𝒏f⋅𝒆d)∂p∂U(Ui).\frac{\partial J}{\partial U_i}=\Bigl(\sum_{f\in\mathrm{wall},\,L(f)=i}\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d\Bigr)\frac{\partial p}{\partial U}(U_i).

所以 JUJ_U 只在 8 个物面控制体的行上非零，并且每一行都与 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U 成比例。第 11 节的伴随右端 −JUT-J_U^T 就是它。第二步，几何。面积向量 𝒏f=(𝒙e−𝒙s)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=(\boldsymbol x_e-\boldsymbol x_s)^{\perp}（𝒙s\boldsymbol x_s、𝒙e\boldsymbol x_e 是面的起点和终点；格点页的物面半面取所在物面边面积向量的一半，这里的 𝒙s\boldsymbol x_s、𝒙e\boldsymbol x_e 是那条边的端点，下面每个导数都要乘 12\tfrac12），所以 𝒏f⋅𝒆y=−(xe−xs)\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_y=-(x_e-x_s)、𝒏f⋅𝒆x=ye−ys\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_x=y_e-y_s。状态固定时：

So JUJ_U is nonzero only in the rows of the 8 wall volumes, and every such row is proportional to ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U; the adjoint right-hand side −JUT-J_U^T of Section 11 is exactly this. Step 2, the geometry. The area vector is 𝒏f=(𝒙e−𝒙s)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=(\boldsymbol x_e-\boldsymbol x_s)^{\perp} (𝒙s\boldsymbol x_s, 𝒙e\boldsymbol x_e the start and end points of the face; a wall half-face of the node page carries half the area vector of its wall edge, 𝒙s\boldsymbol x_s and 𝒙e\boldsymbol x_e are the endpoints of that edge, and every derivative below carries a factor 12\tfrac12), so 𝒏f⋅𝒆y=−(xe−xs)\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_y=-(x_e-x_s) and 𝒏f⋅𝒆x=ye−ys\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_x=y_e-y_s. At fixed state:

Jy: ∂J∂xs=pf,  ∂J∂xe=−pf,  ∂J∂ys=∂J∂ye=0;Jx: ∂J∂ys=−pf,  ∂J∂ye=pf,  ∂J∂xs=∂J∂xe=0.J_y:\ \frac{\partial J}{\partial x_s}=p_f,\ \ \frac{\partial J}{\partial x_e}=-p_f,\ \ \frac{\partial J}{\partial y_s}=\frac{\partial J}{\partial y_e}=0;\qquad J_x:\ \frac{\partial J}{\partial y_s}=-p_f,\ \ \frac{\partial J}{\partial y_e}=p_f,\ \ \frac{\partial J}{\partial x_s}=\frac{\partial J}{\partial x_e}=0.

第三步，每个物面节点恰好是一个物面边的终点、下一个物面边的起点，把两项加起来：对 JyJ_y，节点 kk 的直接形状导数 ∂J/∂xk\partial J/\partial x_k 就是它两侧物面边上平均压力之差，（格点页每条物面边的两个半面分别用两端节点的压力，相当于边上压力的梯形平均 12(ps+pe)\tfrac12(p_s+p_e)）∂J/∂yk=0\partial J/\partial y_k=0。图 12.3 中紫色的“直接部分”就是这个量。第四步，JJ 不显式依赖 M∞M_\infty 和 θ\theta，所以 JM∞=Jθ=0J_{M_\infty}=J_\theta=0：这两个导数完全来自状态的响应（第 10 节）。

Step 3, every wall node is the end point of one wall edge and the start point of the next, so the two terms add up: for JyJ_y, the direct shape derivative ∂J/∂xk\partial J/\partial x_k of node kk is the difference of the mean pressures on its two wall edges (on the node page the two half-faces of a wall edge use the pressures of its two end nodes, a trapezoidal mean 12(ps+pe)\tfrac12(p_s+p_e) along the edge), and ∂J/∂yk=0\partial J/\partial y_k=0. The violet “direct part” in Figure 12.3 is this quantity. Step 4, JJ has no explicit dependence on M∞M_\infty and θ\theta, so JM∞=Jθ=0J_{M_\infty}=J_\theta=0: these two derivatives come entirely from the state response (Section 10).

核对：计算图对 JyJ_y 反向一次（种子 Rˉ=0\bar R=0、Jˉ=1\bar J=1）得到的 JUJ_U 与第一步的公式最大相差 7×10⁻¹⁸，对全部节点坐标的 JXJ_X 与第二、三步的公式最大相差 1×10⁻¹⁶，JM∞J_{M_\infty}、JθJ_\theta 为 0（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: one reverse sweep of the graph for JyJ_y (seeds Rˉ=0\bar R=0, Jˉ=1\bar J=1) gives a JUJ_U that differs from the formula of Step 1 by at most 7×10⁻¹⁸, and a JXJ_X over all node coordinates that differs from Steps 2 and 3 by at most 1×10⁻¹⁶; JM∞J_{M_\infty} and JθJ_\theta are 0 (computed by this page’s code at build time).

这个力有多少是物理的

How much of this force is physics

来流动压 q∞=12ρ∞∣𝒖∞∣2=12γM∞2q_\infty=\tfrac12\rho_\infty|\boldsymbol u_\infty|^2=\tfrac12\gamma M_\infty^2，来流总压 p0∞=(1+γ−12M∞2)γ/(γ−1)p_{0\infty}=(1+\tfrac{\gamma-1}2M_\infty^2)^{\gamma/(\gamma-1)}；M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2 时分别为 0.028 与 1.0283。无损失（等熵）流中压力不可能超过总压，所以压力系数有上界：

The free-stream dynamic pressure is q∞=12ρ∞∣𝒖∞∣2=12γM∞2q_\infty=\tfrac12\rho_\infty|\boldsymbol u_\infty|^2=\tfrac12\gamma M_\infty^2 and the total pressure p0∞=(1+γ−12M∞2)γ/(γ−1)p_{0\infty}=(1+\tfrac{\gamma-1}2M_\infty^2)^{\gamma/(\gamma-1)}; at M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2 they are 0.028 and 1.0283. In loss-free (isentropic) flow the pressure can never exceed the total pressure, so the pressure coefficient has an upper bound:

Cp=p−p∞q∞≤Cp,0=p0∞−1q∞=1.010.C_p=\frac{p-p_\infty}{q_\infty}\le C_{p,0}=\frac{p_{0\infty}-1}{q_\infty}=1.010.

本页在 M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2、θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ 的收敛解里，物面最大压力为 1.144，即 Cp=5.15C_p=5.15，高于总压。节点 0 的速度为 0.194，按来流的等熵关系，这个速度对应的压力应为 1.009，实际却只有 0.828：总压损失了 18%。按 d'Alembert 佯谬，无激波、无粘性的稳态亚声速绕流阻力为零；这里的阻力却是 J∥=0.252J_\parallel=0.252。

In this page’s converged solution at M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2 and θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ, the largest wall pressure is 1.144, i.e. Cp=5.15C_p=5.15, above the total pressure. Also, node 0 moves at 0.194; isentropic flow from the free stream would give it the pressure 1.009, yet it has only 0.828: it has lost 18% of its total pressure. By d’Alembert’s paradox the steady, shock-free, inviscid subsonic flow around the body has zero drag, yet here the drag is J∥=0.252J_\parallel=0.252.

这些偏差来自固定耗散 α=2\alpha=2：它比来流速度大近一个数量级，相当于很大的数值粘性（第 15 节在加密网格上量化）。因此在本页这些网格上，力的数值主要是离散误差，不能当作物理载荷。但求导的对象就是这个离散目标 JJ 本身：第 10–14 节的 tangent、adjoint、差分与复数步长给出的，是离散 JJ 的精确导数，这正是本页要教的内容。离散 JJ 离物理有多远，是另一个由网格加密回答的问题。

These deviations come from the fixed dissipation α=2\alpha=2: it is almost an order of magnitude larger than the flow speed and acts like a large numerical viscosity (Section 15 quantifies it on refined meshes). On these meshes the forces are therefore mostly discretisation error and must not be read as physical loads. The derivatives, however, are taken of exactly this discrete objective JJ: the tangent, adjoint, finite differences and complex step of Sections 10–14 give the exact derivatives of the discrete JJ, which is what this page teaches. How far the discrete JJ is from physics is a separate question, answered by refinement.

图 7.3Figure 7.3

从离散目标得到伴随右端

From a discrete objective to the adjoint right-hand side

不能只对连续积分写一个形式导数就结束。先确定代码实际使用的求积点、权重、重构状态及边界值，再对这个标量表达式求导。一般的求积和及其链式法则是：

A formal derivative of a continuous integral is not enough. First identify the quadrature points, weights, reconstructed states and boundary values actually used by the code, then differentiate that scalar expression. A general quadrature sum and its chain rule are:

J=∑fωf(D) ϕf(𝐔,D),J=\sum_f\omega_f(D)\,\phi_f(\mathbf U,D),
J˙=∑f[ωf ϕ˙f+ϕf ω˙f].\dot J=\sum_f\left[\omega_f\,\dot\phi_f+\phi_f\,\dot\omega_f\right].

本页的压力合力 J=∑f∈wallp(UL(f)) (𝒏f⋅𝒆d)J=\sum_{f\in\mathrm{wall}}p(U_{L(f)})\,(\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d) 是这种加权和：ωf=1\omega_f=1，ϕf=p(UL(f)) (𝒏f⋅𝒆d)\phi_f=p(U_{L(f)})\,(\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)；面积向量 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f 随节点坐标变化，所以 ϕf\phi_f 同时依赖状态与设计变量。

The pressure force J=∑f∈wallp(UL(f)) (𝒏f⋅𝒆d)J=\sum_{f\in\mathrm{wall}}p(U_{L(f)})\,(\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d) of this page is such a weighted sum: ωf=1\omega_f=1 and ϕf=p(UL(f)) (𝒏f⋅𝒆d)\phi_f=p(U_{L(f)})\,(\boldsymbol n_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d); the area vector 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f moves with the node coordinates, so ϕf\phi_f depends on both the state and the design variables.

求 JUTJ_U^T 时固定所有设计变量；求 JDTJ_D^T 时固定全部离散状态槽位。固定解析目标函数并不一定意味着移动网格上的目标采样值不变：如果采样点随设计移动，还要保留该位置依赖；固定网格及固定采样值时，相应项才为零。目标中的体积权重已经进入 JUTJ_U^T，不应在伴随右端再乘一次体积。

Hold every design variable fixed for JUTJ_U^T, and every stored state entry fixed for JDTJ_D^T. A fixed analytic target function need not have fixed samples on a moving mesh: if the evaluation locations move with the design, keep that dependence; the corresponding terms vanish only when the mesh and samples are fixed. Objective volume weights already enter JUTJ_U^T and must not be multiplied into the adjoint right-hand side again.

伴随右端本身也可以由一次反向扫描得到：以 Jˉ=1\bar J=1 为种子，把上面的求积和逐项反过来执行，

The adjoint right-hand side is itself obtained by a reverse sweep: seed Jˉ=1\bar J=1 and run the terms of the quadrature sum above backwards,

Jˉ=1,ϕˉf=ωf Jˉ,𝐔ˉ+=(∂ϕf∂𝐔)Tϕˉf,\bar{J}=1,\qquad \bar\phi_f=\omega_f\,\bar{J},\qquad \bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial \phi_f}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^T\bar\phi_f,
Dˉ+=(∂ϕf∂D)Tϕˉf+ϕf(∂ωf∂D)TJˉ.\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial \phi_f}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar\phi_f+\phi_f\Big(\frac{\partial\omega_f}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar{J}.

从 𝐔ˉ←0\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0、Dˉ←0\bar D\leftarrow0 开始，扫完全部求积点后 𝐔ˉ=JUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J_U^T、Dˉ=JDT\bar D=J_D^T：一个状态被多个求积点读取，所以要先置零、再累加。前向的 J˙\dot J 与反向的这两个结果满足同一个对偶关系 Jˉ J˙=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar J\,\dot J=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D。

Starting from 𝐔ˉ←0\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0 and Dˉ←0\bar D\leftarrow0, after all quadrature points 𝐔ˉ=JUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J_U^T and Dˉ=JDT\bar D=J_D^T: a state is read by several quadrature points, so its adjoint is zeroed first and then accumulated. The forward J˙\dot J and these two reverse results satisfy one duality, Jˉ J˙=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar J\,\dot J=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D.

第 8 节Section 8

前向：从热力学到 matrix-free 乘积

Tangent: from thermodynamics to the matrix-free product

先对压力和速度求导，再对法向速度、物理通量和耗散项求导。给定任意状态切向量 U˙\dot U（前向模式的种子），不必逐列构造 AA；每个面只读取左右两侧的四分量切向量，按同一计算图传播，然后依原残差符号分发，得到 R˙=AU˙\dot R=A\dot U。U˙\dot U 的四个分量写作 U˙=(ρ˙,U˙ρu,U˙ρv,U˙ρE)\dot U=(\dot\rho,\dot U_{\rho u},\dot U_{\rho v},\dot U_{\rho E})。

Differentiate pressure and velocity first, then the normal velocity, the physical flux and the dissipation. For an arbitrary state tangent U˙\dot U (the forward-mode seed), no Jacobian columns need be assembled: gather the two four-component tangents, propagate them through the face computation and scatter with the residual signs, which gives R˙=AU˙\dot R=A\dot U. The four components of U˙\dot U are written U˙=(ρ˙,U˙ρu,U˙ρv,U˙ρE)\dot U=(\dot\rho,\dot U_{\rho u},\dot U_{\rho v},\dot U_{\rho E}).

记号：本页的前向（tangent）与伴随推导采用自动微分的写法。程序变量 xx 的前向导数（切向量）记为 x˙\dot x，伴随记为 xˉ\bar x；反向扫描用 xˉ+=…\bar x\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots 累加、用 xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0 清零，语句按与原始计算相反的次序执行。代码与播放器沿用 Tapenade 的命名：x_d 即 x˙\dot x，x_b 即 xˉ\bar x（例如 residual_d、residual_b）。变分符号 δ\delta 只出现在第 16 节与附录 A 的连续伴随里，表示连续函数的变分；点和横线是对离散代码的前向与反向求导。Newton 的修正量写作 ΔU\Delta U。

Notation: the tangent and adjoint derivations of this page use the notation of algorithmic differentiation. The forward derivative (tangent) of a program variable xx is x˙\dot x and its adjoint is xˉ\bar x; the reverse sweep accumulates with xˉ+=…\bar x\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots, clears with xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0, and runs its statements in the reverse order of the primal computation. Code listings and players use Tapenade’s names: x_d is x˙\dot x and x_b is xˉ\bar x (residual_d, residual_b). The variation symbol δ\delta appears only in the continuous adjoint of Section 16 and Appendix A, where it is the variation of a continuous function; the dot and the bar are forward- and reverse-mode derivatives of the discrete code. Newton corrections are written ΔU\Delta U.

p˙=(γ−1)[U˙ρE−u U˙ρu−v U˙ρv+u2+v22 ρ˙],u˙=U˙ρu−u ρ˙ρ,v˙=U˙ρv−v ρ˙ρ.\dot p=(\gamma-1)\Bigl[\dot U_{\rho E}-u\,\dot U_{\rho u}-v\,\dot U_{\rho v}+\tfrac{u^2+v^2}2\,\dot\rho\Bigr],\quad \dot u=\frac{\dot U_{\rho u}-u\,\dot\rho}{\rho},\quad \dot v=\frac{\dot U_{\rho v}-v\,\dot\rho}{\rho}.
ℓ u˙n=nxu˙+nyv˙,F˙n=[ℓun ρ˙+ρ ℓu˙nℓun U˙ρu+ρu ℓu˙n+nxp˙ℓun U˙ρv+ρv ℓu˙n+nyp˙ℓun (U˙ρE+p˙)+(ρE+p) ℓu˙n].\ell\,\dot u_n=n_x\dot u+n_y\dot v,\qquad \dot F_n=\begin{bmatrix}\ell u_n\,\dot\rho+\rho\,\ell\dot u_n\\\ell u_n\,\dot U_{\rho u}+\rho u\,\ell\dot u_n+n_x\dot p\\\ell u_n\,\dot U_{\rho v}+\rho v\,\ell\dot u_n+n_y\dot p\\\ell u_n\,(\dot U_{\rho E}+\dot p)+(\rho E+p)\,\ell\dot u_n\end{bmatrix}.
H˙=12(Fn,U(UL) U˙L+Fn,U(UR) U˙R)−αℓ2(U˙R−U˙L).\dot H=\tfrac12\bigl(F_{n,U}(U_L)\,\dot U_L+F_{n,U}(U_R)\,\dot U_R\bigr)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}{2}(\dot U_R-\dot U_L).

上式暂时固定几何（𝒏˙=0\dot{\boldsymbol n}=0），所以面积向量形式的法向速度 ℓun=unx+vny\ell u_n=un_x+vn_y 的切向量就是 ℓu˙n\ell\dot u_n。远场的 U˙R\dot U_R 就是第 4 节的 U˙b=GU U˙L\dot U_b=G_U\,\dot U_L，不能置零；壁面使用第 4 节的压力导数。当前实现把标量加、减、乘、除、幂和三角函数的局部偏导保存成计算图，再沿图向前传播；这是解析链式法则，不是有限差分，也不存全局 Jacobian。播放器可自动播放每个面的四个步骤。

These formulas hold geometry fixed (𝒏˙=0\dot{\boldsymbol n}=0), so the tangent of the normal velocity in area-vector form, ℓun=unx+vny\ell u_n=un_x+vn_y, is ℓu˙n\ell\dot u_n. At the far field U˙R\dot U_R is the U˙b=GU U˙L\dot U_b=G_U\,\dot U_L of Section 4, not zero; walls use the pressure derivative of Section 4. The implementation records local derivatives of scalar arithmetic, powers and trigonometric operations and propagates along that graph. This is analytic chain-rule differentiation, not finite differencing, and it stores no global Jacobian. The player can step through the four stages of every face automatically.

逐步推导：通量 Jacobian Fn,UF_{n,U} 的完整 4×44\times4 矩阵

Step by step: the full 4×44\times4 flux Jacobian Fn,UF_{n,U}

第一步，原始变量 Y=(ρ,u,v,p)TY=(\rho,u,v,p)^T 对守恒量的 Jacobian（代码 prim() 中的除法与第 3 节的 ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U）：

Step 1, the Jacobian of the primitive variables Y=(ρ,u,v,p)TY=(\rho,u,v,p)^T with respect to the conserved ones (the divisions in prim() and ∂p/∂U\partial p/\partial U of Section 3):

YU=∂Y∂U=[1000−u/ρ1/ρ00−v/ρ01/ρ0γ−12(u2+v2)−(γ−1)u−(γ−1)vγ−1].Y_U=\frac{\partial Y}{\partial U}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0&0\\-u/\rho&1/\rho&0&0\\-v/\rho&0&1/\rho&0\\\tfrac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2)&-(\gamma-1)u&-(\gamma-1)v&\gamma-1\end{bmatrix}.

第二步，用原始变量写物理通量。面积向量形式的法向速度记作 ℓun=unx+vny\ell u_n=un_x+vn_y，并利用 ρE+p=γγ−1p+12ρ(u2+v2)\rho E+p=\tfrac{\gamma}{\gamma-1}p+\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2)：

Step 2, write the physical flux in primitive variables, with the normal velocity in area-vector form ℓun=unx+vny\ell u_n=un_x+vn_y and ρE+p=γγ−1p+12ρ(u2+v2)\rho E+p=\tfrac{\gamma}{\gamma-1}p+\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2):

Fn=[ρ ℓunρu ℓun+p nxρv ℓun+p ny(γγ−1p+12ρ(u2+v2))ℓun],Fn,Y=[ℓunρnxρny0u ℓunρ ℓun+ρu nxρu nynxv ℓunρv nxρ ℓun+ρv nyny12(u2+v2) ℓunρu ℓun+(ρE+p) nxρv ℓun+(ρE+p) nyγγ−1ℓun].F_n=\begin{bmatrix}\rho\,\ell u_n\\\rho u\,\ell u_n+p\,n_x\\\rho v\,\ell u_n+p\,n_y\\\bigl(\tfrac{\gamma}{\gamma-1}p+\tfrac12\rho(u^2+v^2)\bigr)\ell u_n\end{bmatrix},\qquad F_{n,Y}=\begin{bmatrix}\ell u_n&\rho n_x&\rho n_y&0\\u\,\ell u_n&\rho\,\ell u_n+\rho u\,n_x&\rho u\,n_y&n_x\\v\,\ell u_n&\rho v\,n_x&\rho\,\ell u_n+\rho v\,n_y&n_y\\\tfrac12(u^2+v^2)\,\ell u_n&\rho u\,\ell u_n+(\rho E+p)\,n_x&\rho v\,\ell u_n+(\rho E+p)\,n_y&\tfrac{\gamma}{\gamma-1}\ell u_n\end{bmatrix}.

每一列是对一个原始变量求偏导；例如能量通量对 uu 的导数，来自 12ρu2ℓun\tfrac12\rho u^2\ell u_n 中的 ρu ℓun\rho u\,\ell u_n 与 ℓun\ell u_n 本身对 uu 的导数 nxn_x 乘以 ρE+p\rho E+p。第三步，链式法则 Fn,U=Fn,YYUF_{n,U}=F_{n,Y}Y_U，逐项相乘并化简（E+p/ρE+p/\rho 是单位质量的总焓）：

Each column is the partial derivative with respect to one primitive variable; for example, the derivative of the energy flux with respect to uu combines ρu ℓun\rho u\,\ell u_n from 12ρu2ℓun\tfrac12\rho u^2\ell u_n with the derivative nxn_x of ℓun\ell u_n itself times ρE+p\rho E+p. Step 3, the chain rule Fn,U=Fn,YYUF_{n,U}=F_{n,Y}Y_U, multiplied out and simplified (E+p/ρE+p/\rho is the total enthalpy per unit mass):

Fn,U=[0nxny0γ−12(u2+v2) nx−u ℓunℓun−(γ−2)u nxu ny−(γ−1)v nx(γ−1)nxγ−12(u2+v2) ny−v ℓunv nx−(γ−1)u nyℓun−(γ−2)v ny(γ−1)ny(γ−12(u2+v2)−E−pρ)ℓun(E+pρ)nx−(γ−1)u ℓun(E+pρ)ny−(γ−1)v ℓunγ ℓun].F_{n,U}=\begin{bmatrix}0&n_x&n_y&0\\\tfrac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2)\,n_x-u\,\ell u_n&\ell u_n-(\gamma-2)u\,n_x&u\,n_y-(\gamma-1)v\,n_x&(\gamma-1)n_x\\\tfrac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2)\,n_y-v\,\ell u_n&v\,n_x-(\gamma-1)u\,n_y&\ell u_n-(\gamma-2)v\,n_y&(\gamma-1)n_y\\\bigl(\tfrac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2)-E-\tfrac p\rho\bigr)\ell u_n&\bigl(E+\tfrac p\rho\bigr)n_x-(\gamma-1)u\,\ell u_n&\bigl(E+\tfrac p\rho\bigr)n_y-(\gamma-1)v\,\ell u_n&\gamma\,\ell u_n\end{bmatrix}.

第四步，两个自检。每个元素都对 (nx,ny)(n_x,n_y) 线性，所以 Fn,UF_{n,U} 对面积向量是线性的（第 6 节用到）；Euler 通量是 UU 的一次齐次函数：对任意标量 μ\mu，Fn(μU)=μFn(U)F_n(\mu U)=\mu F_n(U)，对 μ\mu 求导得 Fn,U(U) U=Fn(U)F_{n,U}(U)\,U=F_n(U)。

Step 4, two self-checks. Every entry is linear in (nx,ny)(n_x,n_y), so Fn,UF_{n,U} is linear in the area vector (used in Section 6); and the Euler flux is homogeneous of degree one in UU: for any scalar μ\mu, Fn(μU)=μFn(U)F_n(\mu U)=\mu F_n(U), whose derivative with respect to μ\mu gives Fn,U(U) U=Fn(U)F_{n,U}(U)\,U=F_n(U).

核对：在全部 80 个面的两侧状态上，上面的矩阵与代码 fluxJacobian()（对 physical() 的计算图逐列求前向导数）最大相差 4×10⁻¹⁶（矩阵元素最大为 2.70），与 Fn,YYUF_{n,Y}Y_U 的乘积最大相差 9×10⁻¹⁶，齐次关系 Fn,UU−FnF_{n,U}U-F_n 最大为 2×10⁻¹⁶；sympy 另外做了符号核对（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: on both side states of all 80 faces, the matrix above differs from the code's fluxJacobian() (column-wise forward derivatives of the graph of physical()) by at most 4×10⁻¹⁶ (largest entry 2.70), from the product Fn,YYUF_{n,Y}Y_U by at most 9×10⁻¹⁶, and the homogeneity relation Fn,UU−FnF_{n,U}U-F_n is at most 2×10⁻¹⁶; sympy checks the same symbolically (computed by this page’s code at build time).

逐步推导：数值通量的线性化与它的特征值

Step by step: linearising the numerical flux, and its eigenvalues

第一步，固定几何，对 H=12(Fn(UL)+Fn(UR))−αℓ2(UR−UL)H=\tfrac12(F_n(U_L)+F_n(U_R))-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(U_R-U_L) 分别对 ULU_L、URU_R 求导：

Step 1, at fixed geometry, differentiate H=12(Fn(UL)+Fn(UR))−αℓ2(UR−UL)H=\tfrac12(F_n(U_L)+F_n(U_R))-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(U_R-U_L) with respect to ULU_L and URU_R:

HUL=12Fn,U(UL)+αℓ2I,HUR=12Fn,U(UR)−αℓ2I.H_{U_L}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I,\qquad H_{U_R}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_R)-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I.

α\alpha 是格式中的常数，所以没有 ∂α/∂U\partial\alpha/\partial U 项，也没有需要冻结的开关。若改用随状态变化的 max⁡(∣un∣+c)\max(|u_n|+c)，就要对 max 在哪一侧取得作分支选择，那个分支在两侧相等处不可微。第二步，Fn,UF_{n,U} 的特征值是法向的四个特征速度乘以面长：

α\alpha is a constant of the scheme, so there is no ∂α/∂U\partial\alpha/\partial U term and no switch to freeze. A state-dependent max⁡(∣un∣+c)\max(|u_n|+c) would require choosing on which side the max is attained, a branch that is not differentiable where both sides are equal. Step 2, the eigenvalues of Fn,UF_{n,U} are the four characteristic speeds in the normal direction times the face length:

eig⁡Fn,U={ℓun,  ℓun,  ℓ(un+c),  ℓ(un−c)},tr⁡Fn,U=4ℓun,det⁡Fn,U=ℓ4un2(un2−c2).\operatorname{eig}F_{n,U}=\{\ell u_n,\;\ell u_n,\;\ell(u_n+c),\;\ell(u_n-c)\},\qquad\operatorname{tr}F_{n,U}=4\ell u_n,\qquad\det F_{n,U}=\ell^4u_n^2(u_n^2-c^2).

第三步，加上 ±αℓ2I\pm\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I 只把每个特征值平移同一个量。于是 HULH_{U_L} 的特征值是 ℓ2(un+α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n+\alpha)、ℓ2(un±c+α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n\pm c+\alpha)，HURH_{U_R} 的是 ℓ2(un−α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n-\alpha)、ℓ2(un±c−α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n\pm c-\alpha)。页面检查的 α>∣un∣+c\alpha>|u_n|+c 恰好保证前者全为正、后者全为负：增大左侧状态使流出 LL 的通量增大，增大右侧状态使它减小，这是迎风思想的离散形式，也是第 6 节中耗散部分能主导对角块的原因。

Step 3, adding ±αℓ2I\pm\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I shifts every eigenvalue by the same amount. The eigenvalues of HULH_{U_L} are ℓ2(un+α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n+\alpha) and ℓ2(un±c+α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n\pm c+\alpha), those of HURH_{U_R} are ℓ2(un−α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n-\alpha) and ℓ2(un±c−α)\tfrac\ell2(u_n\pm c-\alpha). The page’s check α>∣un∣+c\alpha>|u_n|+c guarantees exactly that the former are all positive and the latter all negative: raising the left state increases the flux out of LL, raising the right state decreases it. This is the discrete form of upwinding, and the reason why the dissipation can dominate the diagonal blocks in Section 6.

核对：在全部 80 个面的两侧状态上，迹的相对偏差最大 9×10⁻¹⁷，行列式的相对偏差最大 9×10⁻¹⁵；α−max⁡(∣un∣+c)=0.559\alpha-\max(|u_n|+c)=0.559，面积向量方向上的所有特征速度都在 α\alpha 以内；两个块与计算图对单位种子的前向结果最大相差 2×10⁻¹⁶（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: on both side states of all 80 faces the trace deviates by at most 9×10⁻¹⁷ relatively and the determinant by at most 9×10⁻¹⁵; α−max⁡(∣un∣+c)=0.559\alpha-\max(|u_n|+c)=0.559, so every characteristic speed normal to a face stays below α\alpha; the two blocks differ from the forward results of the graph for unit seeds by at most 2×10⁻¹⁶ (computed by this page’s code at build time).
