逐步推导：通量 Jacobian 的特征向量与 Riemann 坐标

Step by step: the eigenvectors of the flux Jacobian, and the Riemann coordinates

第一步，右特征向量。取单位法向 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n}（Fn,U=ℓFn^,UF_{n,U}=\ell F_{\hat n,U}：特征向量相同，特征值乘以 ℓ\ell），记 ut=−un^y+vn^xu_t=-u\hat n_y+v\hat n_x 为第 4 节的切向速度。四个特征速度的右特征向量排成矩阵 Φ\Phi 的四列：

Step 1, the right eigenvectors. Take the unit normal 𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} (Fn,U=ℓFn^,UF_{n,U}=\ell F_{\hat n,U}: the same eigenvectors, the eigenvalues times ℓ\ell) and write ut=−un^y+vn^xu_t=-u\hat n_y+v\hat n_x for the tangential velocity of Section 4. The right eigenvectors of the four characteristic speeds are the four columns of Φ\Phi:

Fn^,U Φ=Φ diag⁡(un−c,  un,  un,  un+c),Φ=[1101u−cn^xu−n^yu+cn^xv−cn^yvn^xv+cn^yE+pρ−cun12(u2+v2)utE+pρ+cun].F_{\hat n,U}\,\Phi=\Phi\,\operatorname{diag}(u_n-c,\;u_n,\;u_n,\;u_n+c),\qquad\Phi=\begin{bmatrix}1&1&0&1\\u-c\hat n_x&u&-\hat n_y&u+c\hat n_x\\v-c\hat n_y&v&\hat n_x&v+c\hat n_y\\E+\frac p\rho-cu_n&\tfrac12(u^2+v^2)&u_t&E+\frac p\rho+cu_n\end{bmatrix}.

每一列都可以用本节开头的 p˙\dot p、u˙\dot u、v˙\dot v 与 F˙n\dot F_n 公式验证：把这一列当作 U˙\dot U 代入。第三列（剪切波）给出 ρ˙=0\dot\rho=0、u˙=−n^y/ρ\dot u=-\hat n_y/\rho、v˙=n^x/ρ\dot v=\hat n_x/\rho，于是 p˙=(γ−1)(ut+un^y−vn^x)=0\dot p=(\gamma-1)(u_t+u\hat n_y-v\hat n_x)=0、u˙n=0\dot u_n=0，F˙n^=un (0,−n^y,n^x,ut)T\dot F_{\hat n}=u_n\,(0,-\hat n_y,\hat n_x,u_t)^T，正是 unu_n 乘这一列。第一、四列（两道声波）给出 p˙=c2\dot p=c^2、u˙n=∓c/ρ\dot u_n=\mp c/\rho；第二列（熵波）给出 p˙=0\dot p=0、u˙n=0\dot u_n=0，只改变密度。

Each column can be checked with the p˙\dot p, u˙\dot u, v˙\dot v and F˙n\dot F_n formulas at the start of this section: insert the column as U˙\dot U. The third column (shear wave) gives ρ˙=0\dot\rho=0, u˙=−n^y/ρ\dot u=-\hat n_y/\rho, v˙=n^x/ρ\dot v=\hat n_x/\rho, hence p˙=(γ−1)(ut+un^y−vn^x)=0\dot p=(\gamma-1)(u_t+u\hat n_y-v\hat n_x)=0, u˙n=0\dot u_n=0 and F˙n^=un (0,−n^y,n^x,ut)T\dot F_{\hat n}=u_n\,(0,-\hat n_y,\hat n_x,u_t)^T, which is unu_n times the column. The first and fourth columns (the two sound waves) give p˙=c2\dot p=c^2 and u˙n=∓c/ρ\dot u_n=\mp c/\rho; the second (entropy wave) gives p˙=0\dot p=0 and u˙n=0\dot u_n=0, a change of density only.

第二步，左特征向量。Φ−1\Phi^{-1} 的四行把任意切向量 U˙\dot U 分解成四个波各自携带的量（p˙\dot p、u˙n=u˙n^x+v˙n^y\dot u_n=\dot u\hat n_x+\dot v\hat n_y、u˙t=−u˙n^y+v˙n^x\dot u_t=-\dot u\hat n_y+\dot v\hat n_x 都由 YUU˙Y_U\dot U 得到）：

Step 2, the left eigenvectors. The four rows of Φ−1\Phi^{-1} split any tangent U˙\dot U into the amounts the four waves carry (p˙\dot p, u˙n=u˙n^x+v˙n^y\dot u_n=\dot u\hat n_x+\dot v\hat n_y and u˙t=−u˙n^y+v˙n^x\dot u_t=-\dot u\hat n_y+\dot v\hat n_x all follow from YUU˙Y_U\dot U):

Φ−1U˙=(p˙−ρc u˙n2c2,  ρ˙−p˙c2,  ρ u˙t,  p˙+ρc u˙n2c2)T.\Phi^{-1}\dot U=\Bigl(\frac{\dot p-\rho c\,\dot u_n}{2c^2},\;\dot\rho-\frac{\dot p}{c^2},\;\rho\,\dot u_t,\;\frac{\dot p+\rho c\,\dot u_n}{2c^2}\Bigr)^T.

把第一步的四列逐一代入，这四个组合依次给出单位向量：例如沿第一列 p˙=c2\dot p=c^2、u˙n=−c/ρ\dot u_n=-c/\rho，第一个组合为 (c2+c2)/(2c2)=1(c^2+c^2)/(2c^2)=1，其余三个为 0。所以 Φ−1Φ=I\Phi^{-1}\Phi=I，并且 Fn^,U=Φdiag⁡(un−c,un,un,un+c)Φ−1F_{\hat n,U}=\Phi\operatorname{diag}(u_n-c,u_n,u_n,u_n+c)\Phi^{-1}。第三步，数值通量的两个块与 Fn,UF_{n,U} 共用这组特征向量：

Inserting the four columns of Step 1 one by one, the four combinations give the unit vectors in turn: along the first column, for instance, p˙=c2\dot p=c^2 and u˙n=−c/ρ\dot u_n=-c/\rho, so the first combination is (c2+c2)/(2c2)=1(c^2+c^2)/(2c^2)=1 and the other three vanish. Hence Φ−1Φ=I\Phi^{-1}\Phi=I and Fn^,U=Φdiag⁡(un−c,un,un,un+c)Φ−1F_{\hat n,U}=\Phi\operatorname{diag}(u_n-c,u_n,u_n,u_n+c)\Phi^{-1}. Step 3, the two blocks of the numerical flux share these eigenvectors with Fn,UF_{n,U}:

HUL=12Fn,U(UL)+αℓ2I=ΦL ℓ2diag⁡(un−c+α,  un+α,  un+α,  un+c+α) ΦL−1,H_{U_L}=\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I=\Phi_L\,\tfrac\ell2\operatorname{diag}\bigl(u_n-c+\alpha,\;u_n+\alpha,\;u_n+\alpha,\;u_n+c+\alpha\bigr)\,\Phi_L^{-1},

其中 ΦL\Phi_L 在 ULU_L 上求值；HURH_{U_R} 相同，只是 +α+\alpha 换成 −α-\alpha、在 URU_R 上求值。上一段推导的特征值就是这里的对角元；固定的 α\alpha 只平移特征值，不改变特征向量。第四步，Riemann 坐标。第 4 节的远场用 W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t)。由 p=Sργp=S\rho^\gamma 得 p˙=ργS˙+c2ρ˙\dot p=\rho^\gamma\dot S+c^2\dot\rho，再用第 3 节的 c˙\dot c，r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1) 的切向量是：

with ΦL\Phi_L evaluated at ULU_L; HURH_{U_R} is the same with −α-\alpha for +α+\alpha, evaluated at URU_R. The eigenvalues of the previous derivation are the diagonal entries here; the fixed α\alpha shifts the eigenvalues and leaves the eigenvectors alone. Step 4, the Riemann coordinates. The far field of Section 4 uses W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t). From p=Sργp=S\rho^\gamma, p˙=ργS˙+c2ρ˙\dot p=\rho^\gamma\dot S+c^2\dot\rho; with the c˙\dot c of Section 3, the tangents of r±=un±2c/(γ−1)r_\pm=u_n\pm2c/(\gamma-1) are:

r˙±=u˙n±2c˙γ−1=u˙n±(p˙ρc+ργ−1(γ−1)c S˙),S˙=p˙−c2ρ˙ργ.\dot r_\pm=\dot u_n\pm\frac{2\dot c}{\gamma-1}=\dot u_n\pm\Bigl(\frac{\dot p}{\rho c}+\frac{\rho^{\gamma-1}}{(\gamma-1)c}\,\dot S\Bigr),\qquad\dot S=\frac{\dot p-c^2\dot\rho}{\rho^\gamma}.

u˙n±p˙/(ρc)\dot u_n\pm\dot p/(\rho c) 正是第二步中那道声波的组合，而 S˙=−c2ρ−γ(ρ˙−p˙/c2)\dot S=-c^2\rho^{-\gamma}(\dot\rho-\dot p/c^2) 只含熵波：r±r_\pm 除了自己的声波，还带着一部分熵波。Fn^,UF_{\hat n,U} 把每个波乘以它自己的速度，所以 (∂W/∂U)Fn^,UU˙(\partial W/\partial U)F_{\hat n,U}\dot U 的 r+r_+ 分量是

u˙n±p˙/(ρc)\dot u_n\pm\dot p/(\rho c) is exactly the combination of that sound wave in Step 2, while S˙=−c2ρ−γ(ρ˙−p˙/c2)\dot S=-c^2\rho^{-\gamma}(\dot\rho-\dot p/c^2) holds the entropy wave only: besides its own sound wave, r±r_\pm carries part of the entropy wave. Fn^,UF_{\hat n,U} multiplies every wave by its own speed, so the r+r_+ component of (∂W/∂U)Fn^,UU˙(\partial W/\partial U)F_{\hat n,U}\dot U is

(un+c)(u˙n+p˙/(ρc))+unργ−1S˙/((γ−1)c)=(un+c) r˙+−ργ−1S˙/(γ−1),(u_n+c)\bigl(\dot u_n+\dot p/(\rho c)\bigr)+u_n\rho^{\gamma-1}\dot S/((\gamma-1)c)=(u_n+c)\,\dot r_+-\rho^{\gamma-1}\dot S/(\gamma-1),

r−r_- 分量同理。在 WW 坐标下：

and likewise for r−r_-. In the coordinates WW:

∂W∂U Fn^,U(∂W∂U)−1=[un+c0−ργ−1γ−100un−c−ργ−1γ−1000un0000un].\frac{\partial W}{\partial U}\,F_{\hat n,U}\Bigl(\frac{\partial W}{\partial U}\Bigr)^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}u_n+c&0&-\frac{\rho^{\gamma-1}}{\gamma-1}&0\\0&u_n-c&-\frac{\rho^{\gamma-1}}{\gamma-1}&0\\0&0&u_n&0\\0&0&0&u_n\end{bmatrix}.

第五步，这对远场意味着什么。第 3 列的两个非零元说明：只有当 SS 均匀（等熵流）时，r±r_\pm 才是纯粹的特征变量，第 4 节的闭合才严格按特征取舍。本页收敛解上 SS 在 1.0018 到 1.0126 之间（来流为 1），第 3 列的元素在 −2.59 到 −2.36 之间：数值耗散在物体附近产生熵，随流带到下游（图 8.3 下），所以这个闭合只是近似的特征闭合。这正是第 4 节说它“只在局部一维、等熵的意义下是特征关系”的量化。近似的是边界条件本身，不是它的导数：代码对这个闭合求出的 GUG_U 与它的转置是精确的（附录 A 实测）。

Step 5, what this means at the far field. The two nonzero entries of column 3 say that only when SS is uniform (isentropic flow) are r±r_\pm pure characteristic variables and does the closure of Section 4 select exactly by characteristics. On this page’s converged solution SS lies between 1.0018 and 1.0126 (1 in the free stream) and the entries of column 3 between −2.59 and −2.36: the numerical dissipation makes entropy near the body and the flow carries it downstream (bottom of Figure 8.3), so the closure is characteristic only approximately. This quantifies Section 4’s “characteristic only in the local one-dimensional, isentropic sense”. What is approximate is the boundary condition itself, not its derivative: the GUG_U the code computes for this closure, and its transpose, are exact (measured in Appendix A).

局部导数怎样组成全局 Jacobian

How local derivatives form the global Jacobian

固定网格和当前可微分支，把一个面的所有输入记为 zfz_f；它包括两侧的状态、面的几何（面积向量与面长）与边界数据。令 TfT_f、KfK_f 分别是 zfz_f 对存储状态和设计变量的导数，Hz,fH_{z,f} 是局部通量 Jacobian。于是每个残差行的导数按同一个有向面关联矩阵 ℬ\mathcal B 装配，这里的求和包括相应的边界通量映射。本页没有被替换的行，边界条件全部在边界面的通量里。前向模式按计算顺序传播切向量，状态种子是 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}，设计种子是 D˙\dot D：

At fixed mesh and differentiable branch, let zfz_f collect all face inputs: the two states, the face geometry (the area vector and the face length) and the boundary data. Let TfT_f and KfK_f be the derivatives of zfz_f with respect to the stored states and the design variables, and Hz,fH_{z,f} the local flux Jacobian. Assemble each residual derivative with the same oriented face incidence ℬ\mathcal B, including the boundary flux maps. This page replaces no rows: every boundary condition sits in a boundary-face flux. Forward mode carries the tangents in the order of the computation, with the state seed 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and the design seed D˙\dot D:

z˙f=Tf 𝐔˙+KfD˙,H˙f=Hz,fz˙f,\dot z_f=T_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}+K_f\dot D,\quad\dot H_f=H_{z,f}\dot z_f,
R˙i=∑fℬifH˙f−Q˙i,\dot R_i=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\dot H_f-\dot Q_i,
(A)ij=∑fℬifHz,f(Tf)j−∂Qi∂Uj,(A)_{ij}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(T_f)_j-\frac{\partial Q_i}{\partial U_j},
(RD)ik=∑fℬifHz,f(Kf)k−∂Qi∂Dk.(R_D)_{ik}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(K_f)_k-\frac{\partial Q_i}{\partial D_k}.

无体源项时 Qi=0Q_i=0。面长度和法向量随节点坐标变化，它们的设计依赖属于 zfz_f，不能只对状态求导。本页是一阶格式，TfT_f 只连接面两侧的状态；matrix-free 仍只需依次执行这些局部乘积，不必存储全局矩阵。

Set Qi=0Q_i=0 when there is no volume source. Face lengths and normals move with the node coordinates; that design dependence belongs in zfz_f, so differentiating the states alone is insufficient. This page is first order, so TfT_f connects only the two states of a face. Matrix-free evaluation performs these local products without storing the global matrix.

从程序到切向量：面循环的四条语句逐条线性化

From program to tangent: linearise the four statements of the face loop one by one

上面的 z˙f\dot z_f、H˙f\dot H_f 与 R˙i\dot R_i 来自同一段短程序：残差代码对每个面依次执行四条语句。设 𝒮f\mathcal S_f 是面 ff 读取的存储位置（两侧的 LL、RR，以及重构需要时它们的邻居），把这些位置上的状态排成 𝐔f\mathbf U_f：

The z˙f\dot z_f, H˙f\dot H_f and R˙i\dot R_i above come from one short program: the residual code runs four statements on every face. Let 𝒮f\mathcal S_f be the stored locations that face ff reads (its two sides LL and RR, and their neighbours when the reconstruction needs them), and stack the states stored there as 𝐔f\mathbf U_f:

(1)𝐔f=𝒢f 𝐔,(1)\quad \mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\,\mathbf U,
(2)zf=zf(D,𝐔f),(2)\quad z_f=z_f(D,\mathbf U_f),
(3)Hf=H(zf),(3)\quad H_f=H(z_f),
(4)R+=ℬ:,f Hf.(4)\quad R\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_f.

（1）取值：𝒢f\mathcal G_f 的每一行只有一个 1，从全局数组里挑出 𝒮f\mathcal S_f 上的状态；（2）重构：由这些状态和设计变量算出面的全部输入 zfz_f，在本页是两侧状态 ULU_L、URU_R，加上面积向量 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f 与面长 ℓf\ell_f（一阶时对状态 Zf=IZ_f=I）；（3）通量：Hf=H(zf)H_f=H(z_f)；（4）分发：ℬ:,f\mathcal B_{:,f} 是有向关联矩阵 ℬ\mathcal B 的第 ff 列，在第 LL 行为 +1+1、第 RR 行为 −1-1，即 RL+=HfR_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f、RR-=HfR_R\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f（边界面只写一行）；本页每个位置有 4 个分量，±1\pm1 代表 ±I\pm I。这四条语句是残差代码的骨架；本页代码里的每一条语句（含边界面与源项）都在本节里逐句写出，并附各自的切向量语句。

(1) Gather: each row of 𝒢f\mathcal G_f holds a single 1 and picks one state of 𝒮f\mathcal S_f out of the global array. (2) Reconstruct: the states and the design give all inputs zfz_f of the face, on this page the two states ULU_L, URU_R, plus the area vector 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f and the face length ℓf\ell_f (at first order Zf=IZ_f=I on the states). (3) Flux: Hf=H(zf)H_f=H(z_f). (4) Scatter: ℬ:,f\mathcal B_{:,f} is column ff of the oriented incidence ℬ\mathcal B, +1+1 in row LL and −1-1 in row RR, that is RL+=HfR_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f and RR-=HfR_R\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f (a boundary face writes one row); with 4 components per location, ±1\pm1 stands for ±I\pm I. These four statements are the skeleton of the residual code; every statement of this page's code, boundary faces and sources included, is written out with its tangent statement in this section.

前向模式对每条语句用一次链式法则：每条语句输出的切向量是它输入的切向量的线性组合，每个中间变量都有自己的切向量：

Forward mode applies the chain rule once per statement: the tangent of each output is a linear combination of the tangents of the statement's inputs, and every intermediate variable gets a tangent of its own:

(1)𝐔˙f=𝒢f 𝐔˙,(1)\quad \dot{\mathbf U}_f=\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U},
(2)z˙f=Zf 𝐔˙f+Kf D˙,(2)\quad \dot z_f=Z_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}_f+K_f\,\dot D,
(3)H˙f=Hz,f z˙f,(3)\quad \dot H_f=H_{z,f}\,\dot z_f,
(4)R˙+=ℬ:,f H˙f,(4)\quad \dot R\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}\,\dot H_f,
Zf=∂zf∂𝐔f,Kf=∂zf∂D,Hz,f=∂H∂zf.Z_f=\frac{\partial z_f}{\partial \mathbf U_f},\qquad K_f=\frac{\partial z_f}{\partial D},\qquad H_{z,f}=\frac{\partial H}{\partial z_f}.

取值与分发都是线性的，它们的切向量就是同样的取值与分发作用在切向量上；只有重构与通量两条语句带来依赖当前状态的局部导数 ZfZ_f、KfK_f 与 Hz,fH_{z,f}。把（1）代入（2），（2）代入（3），（3）代入（4），对所有面求和，再减去体源项的切向量 Q˙\dot Q，就逐条语句得到 R˙=A𝐔˙+RDD˙\dot R=A\dot{\mathbf U}+R_D\dot D：

Gather and scatter are linear: their tangents are the same gather and scatter applied to the tangents. Only the reconstruct and flux statements bring local derivatives that depend on the current state: ZfZ_f, KfK_f and Hz,fH_{z,f}. Substituting (1) into (2), (2) into (3) and (3) into (4), summing over all faces and subtracting the tangent Q˙\dot Q of the volume source assembles R˙=A𝐔˙+RDD˙\dot R=A\dot{\mathbf U}+R_D\dot D statement by statement:

R˙=∑fℬ:,fHz,f(Zf𝒢f 𝐔˙+KfD˙)−Q˙\dot R=\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}\big(Z_f\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}+K_f\dot D\big)-\dot Q
=(∑fℬ:,fHz,fZf𝒢f−∂Q∂𝐔⏟A)𝐔˙=\Big(\underbrace{\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}Z_f\mathcal G_f-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial \mathbf U}}_{A}\Big)\dot{\mathbf U}
+(∑fℬ:,fHz,fKf−∂Q∂D⏟RD)D˙.+\Big(\underbrace{\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}K_f-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial D}}_{R_D}\Big)\dot D.

上面的 TfT_f 就是 Zf𝒢fZ_f\mathcal G_f；一阶重构不改变取出的状态，ZfZ_f 在状态上是单位阵，TfT_f 就是取值。所以一个面对 AA 的贡献是四个初等 Jacobian 的乘积

The TfT_f above is Zf𝒢fZ_f\mathcal G_f; first-order reconstruction leaves the gathered states unchanged, so ZfZ_f is the identity on the states and TfT_f is the gather. One face therefore contributes to AA the product of four elementary Jacobians,

Af=ℬ:,f Hz,f Zf 𝒢f,A_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,Z_f\,\mathcal G_f,
Af𝐔˙=ℬ:,f(Hz,f(Zf(𝒢f 𝐔˙))).A_f\dot{\mathbf U}=\mathcal B_{:,f}\Big(H_{z,f}\Big(Z_f\big(\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}\big)\Big)\Big).

它从右往左作用在 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 上，与程序执行的顺序相同：先取值，再重构、通量，最后分发。𝒮f\mathcal S_f 只有几个位置，所以 AfA_f 只有一小块非零，matrix-free 乘积就是按面执行这几次局部运算，不存储任何全局矩阵。图 8.5 按这四条语句逐条播放本页一个面的数值。

It acts on 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} from right to left, in the order in which the program runs: gather first, then reconstruct and flux, scatter last. 𝒮f\mathcal S_f holds only a few locations, so AfA_f has a small nonzero block, and the matrix-free product runs these local operations face by face without storing any global matrix. Figure 8.5 plays the four statements with the numbers of one face of this page.

第 9 节Section 9

伴随：转置同一个计算图

Adjoint: transpose the same computation graph

给残差一个四分量的伴随种子 Rˉ\bar R（反向模式的种子，可以任意给定），内部面通量的伴随就是 Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R。再分别乘左右通量导数的转置，累加到状态的伴随 Uˉ\bar U。标量页里的一次乘法变成块转置，但收集、计算、分发的顺序没有变，只是整体反过来执行。

Give the residual a four-component adjoint seed Rˉ\bar R (the reverse-mode seed, arbitrary); an internal face flux then has the adjoint Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R. Apply the transposed left and right flux derivatives and accumulate into the state adjoint Uˉ\bar U. Scalar multiplications become block transposes, while the gather/compute/scatter structure remains the same, only run in reverse.

Uˉ←0;∀f:  Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR,UˉL+=HULTHˉf,UˉR+=HURTHˉf(R=−1: RˉR≔0);Uˉ=ATRˉ.\bar U\leftarrow0;\qquad \forall f:\ \ \bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R,\quad \bar U_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_{U_L}^T\bar H_f,\quad \bar U_R\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_{U_R}^T\bar H_f\quad(R=-1:\ \bar R_R\coloneqq0);\qquad \bar U=A^T\bar R.

为什么语句要倒序执行，为什么伴随量要先清零、每一项贡献又都用“+=”累加，见本节末尾用面循环四条语句的转置所作的推导；本页里，对边界面（R=−1R=-1），式中的 HULH_{U_L} 是第 4 节该面的完整导数 ∂Hf/∂UL\partial H_f/\partial U_L：物面为 ∂Hwall/∂UL\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial U_L，远场为 HUL+HUbGUH_{U_L}+H_{U_b}G_U，外侧状态的伴随 Uˉb\bar U_b 经过 GUTG_U^T 回到内侧；几何和来流参数的反传也不能丢掉。保存运算图后逆序访问每个算子，能自动完成这些汇合。

Why the statements run in reverse, and why the adjoints are cleared first and every contribution accumulates with +=, is explained with the transpose of the four face statements in the derivation at the end of this section; on this page, for a boundary face (R=−1R=-1), the HULH_{U_L} of the formula is that face’s complete derivative ∂Hf/∂UL\partial H_f/\partial U_L of Section 4: ∂Hwall/∂UL\partial H_{\mathrm{wall}}/\partial U_L at a wall and HUL+HUbGUH_{U_L}+H_{U_b}G_U at the far field, where the adjoint Uˉb\bar U_b of the exterior state returns through GUTG_U^T to the interior. Geometry and free-stream paths also remain. Reversing the recorded scalar operations handles these merges directly.

逐步推导：逆序转置一个内部面

Step by step: transposing one interior face in reverse order

第一步，一个内部面对 R˙=AU˙\dot R=A\dot U 的贡献分三步：取出两侧的切向量 U˙L\dot U_L、U˙R\dot U_R，乘局部导数 HULH_{U_L}、HURH_{U_R}，再按 ℬ\mathcal B 分发（行 LL 加、行 RR 减）。转置时，行与列交换，求和的次序也交换：

Step 1, one interior face contributes to R˙=AU˙\dot R=A\dot U in three steps: take the two tangents U˙L\dot U_L and U˙R\dot U_R, multiply by the local derivatives HULH_{U_L} and HURH_{U_R}, and scatter with ℬ\mathcal B (add in row LL, subtract in row RR). Transposition swaps rows and columns, and with them the order of the sums:

R˙i=∑fℬif(HUL(f) U˙L(f)+HUR(f) U˙R(f)),Uˉj=∑f: L(f)=jHUL(f)THˉf+∑f: R(f)=jHUR(f)THˉf,Hˉf=∑iℬifRˉi=RˉL−RˉR.\dot R_i=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\bigl(H_{U_L}(f)\,\dot U_{L(f)}+H_{U_R}(f)\,\dot U_{R(f)}\bigr),\qquad\bar U_j=\sum_{f:\,L(f)=j}H_{U_L}(f)^T\bar H_f+\sum_{f:\,R(f)=j}H_{U_R}(f)^T\bar H_f,\qquad\bar H_f=\sum_i\mathcal B_{if}\bar R_i=\bar R_L-\bar R_R.

第二步，转置把三步的次序倒过来：先按 ℬ\mathcal B 收集面通量的伴随 Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R，再乘两个转置块，最后把结果加回两侧（+=）。第三步，块内部也要倒序：Fn,U=Fn,YYUF_{n,U}=F_{n,Y}Y_U 的转置是 YUTFn,YTY_U^TF_{n,Y}^T。平均运算把 Fˉn=12Hˉf\bar F_n=\tfrac12\bar H_f 交给一侧的物理通量，先乘 Fn,YTF_{n,Y}^T 得到原始变量的伴随 Yˉ=(ρˉ,uˉ,vˉ,pˉ)\bar Y=(\bar\rho,\bar u,\bar v,\bar p)，再乘 YUTY_U^T（即第 8 节 YUY_U 的转置，逐项写出）：

Step 2, transposition reverses the three steps: first collect the adjoint of the face flux, Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R, with ℬ\mathcal B, then multiply by the two transposed blocks, and finally add the results back into the two sides (+=). Step 3, inside a block the order is reversed too: the transpose of Fn,U=Fn,YYUF_{n,U}=F_{n,Y}Y_U is YUTFn,YTY_U^TF_{n,Y}^T. The average hands Fˉn=12Hˉf\bar F_n=\tfrac12\bar H_f to the physical flux of one side; Fn,YTF_{n,Y}^T comes first and gives the primitive adjoints Yˉ=(ρˉ,uˉ,vˉ,pˉ)\bar Y=(\bar\rho,\bar u,\bar v,\bar p), followed by YUTY_U^T (the transpose of YUY_U from Section 8, written out):

Fˉn=12Hˉf,Yˉ=Fn,YTFˉn,\bar F_n=\tfrac12\bar H_f,\qquad\bar Y=F_{n,Y}^T\bar F_n,
Uˉρ=ρˉ−u uˉ+v vˉρ+γ−12(u2+v2) pˉ,Uˉρu=uˉρ−(γ−1)u pˉ,Uˉρv=vˉρ−(γ−1)v pˉ,UˉρE=(γ−1) pˉ.\begin{gathered}\bar U_\rho=\bar\rho-\frac{u\,\bar u+v\,\bar v}{\rho}+\tfrac{\gamma-1}2(u^2+v^2)\,\bar p,\qquad\bar U_{\rho u}=\frac{\bar u}{\rho}-(\gamma-1)u\,\bar p,\\\bar U_{\rho v}=\frac{\bar v}{\rho}-(\gamma-1)v\,\bar p,\qquad\bar U_{\rho E}=(\gamma-1)\,\bar p.\end{gathered}

第四步，加上耗散项的转置：UˉL\bar U_L 再加 αℓ2Hˉf\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2\bar H_f，UˉR\bar U_R 再减 αℓ2Hˉf\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2\bar H_f（II 的转置还是 II）。第五步，Uˉ=ATRˉ\bar U=A^T\bar R 是所有面贡献之和：先 Uˉ←0\bar U\leftarrow0，再逐面 UˉL+=…\bar U_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots、UˉR+=…\bar U_R\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots；面的访问次序不影响求和；为什么每个伴随量都要先清零、再用 += 累加，见本节末尾的推导。物面半面的转置已在第 4 节给出，远场面的转置在第 4 节的 GUTG_U^T 部分。

Step 4, add the transpose of the dissipation: UˉL\bar U_L gains αℓ2Hˉf\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2\bar H_f and UˉR\bar U_R loses αℓ2Hˉf\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2\bar H_f (the transpose of II is II). Step 5, Uˉ=ATRˉ\bar U=A^T\bar R is the sum of all face contributions: first Uˉ←0\bar U\leftarrow0, then UˉL+=…\bar U_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots and UˉR+=…\bar U_R\mathrel{\text{+=}}\dots face by face; the order of the faces does not change the sum; why every bar is cleared first and accumulates with += is explained in the derivation at the end of this section. The transpose of a wall half-face is given in Section 4, that of a far-field face in the GUTG_U^T part of Section 4.

核对：以 JyJ_y 的伴随解为种子 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi，即 Hˉf=ψL−ψR\bar H_f=\psi_L-\psi_R，在全部 48 个内部面上，第三、四步的两段公式与计算图逆序（faceVjp）的结果最大相差 3×10⁻¹⁷（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: with the seed Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi of the adjoint for JyJ_y, i.e. Hˉf=ψL−ψR\bar H_f=\psi_L-\psi_R, the two-stage formulas of Steps 3 and 4 differ from the reversed graph (faceVjp) by at most 3×10⁻¹⁷ on all 48 interior faces (computed by this page’s code at build time).

Step 5, how to read it. The far field’s UˉL\bar U_L has two sources: the flux’s direct HULTHˉH_{U_L}^T\bar H, and the path back through Uˉb\bar U_b to r+r_+ (and at an outflow face to SS and utu_t), which together is the GUTUˉbG_U^T\bar U_b of Section 4. At an inflow face Sˉb\bar S_b and uˉt,b\bar u_{t,b} go to the free stream Uˉ∞\bar U_\infty and on to Mˉ∞\bar M_\infty and θˉ\bar\theta; rˉ−\bar r_- always goes to the free stream. Every row only transposes the coefficients of the corresponding tangent row, in reverse order and with +=. In the letters of the derivation at the end of this section, the path through GUTG_U^T belongs to the ZfTZ_f^T of a far-field face and the paths to the design to KfTK_f^T.

第三步，一个面上的对偶。把第 8 节这两个面的前向值与这里的伴随值配对，每个面单独满足对偶恒等式：

Step 3, the duality on one face. Pairing the tangent values of the two faces in Section 8 with the adjoint values here, each face satisfies the duality identity by itself:

HˉTH˙=−0.02665=UˉLTU˙L⏟8.684×10−4+UˉRTU˙R⏟−0.00287+𝒏ˉT𝒏˙⏟−0.02465,HˉTH˙+JˉJ˙f=0.3813=UˉLTU˙L⏟2.237×10−4+𝒏ˉT𝒏˙⏟0.381.\bar H^T\dot H=−0.02665=\underbrace{\bar U_L^T\dot U_L}_{8.684×10⁻⁴}+\underbrace{\bar U_R^T\dot U_R}_{−0.00287}+\underbrace{\bar{\boldsymbol n}^T\dot{\boldsymbol n}}_{−0.02465},\qquad\bar H^T\dot H+\bar J\dot J_f=0.3813=\underbrace{\bar U_L^T\dot U_L}_{2.237×10⁻⁴}+\underbrace{\bar{\boldsymbol n}^T\dot{\boldsymbol n}}_{0.381}.

第四步，对全部面求和。左边相加是 ψTR˙+J˙\psi^T\dot R+\dot J：U˙\dot U 满足前向方程，R˙=AU˙+RDD˙=0\dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D=0（数值上 ∥R˙∥=7×10−13\|\dot R\|=7×10⁻¹³，ψTR˙=5×10−14\psi^T\dot R=5×10⁻¹⁴），所以左边就是 J˙=−0.07529413\dot J=−0.07529413。右边相加是 UˉTU˙+DˉTD˙\bar U^T\dot U+\bar D^T\dot D：ψ\psi 满足伴随方程，Uˉ=ATψ+JUT=0\bar U=A^T\psi+J_U^T=0（最大 2×10⁻¹³），所以右边就是 Dˉk=−0.07529413\bar D_k=−0.07529413。前向与伴随给出同一个导数，因为它们是同一批乘积按两种次序求和。

Step 4, sum over all faces. The left sides add up to ψTR˙+J˙\psi^T\dot R+\dot J: U˙\dot U solves the tangent equation, so R˙=AU˙+RDD˙=0\dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D=0 (numerically ∥R˙∥=7×10−13\|\dot R\|=7×10⁻¹³ and ψTR˙=5×10−14\psi^T\dot R=5×10⁻¹⁴), and the left side is J˙=−0.07529413\dot J=−0.07529413. The right sides add up to UˉTU˙+DˉTD˙\bar U^T\dot U+\bar D^T\dot D: ψ\psi solves the adjoint equation, so Uˉ=ATψ+JUT=0\bar U=A^T\psi+J_U^T=0 (at most 2×10⁻¹³), and the right side is Dˉk=−0.07529413\bar D_k=−0.07529413. The tangent and the adjoint give the same derivative because they sum the same products in two orders.

前向与反向由对偶（点积）恒等式联系在一起：对任意种子 U˙\dot U、D˙\dot D 与 Rˉ\bar R，

The forward and reverse modes are tied together by the duality (dot-product) identity: for any seeds U˙\dot U, D˙\dot D and Rˉ\bar R,

RˉTR˙=UˉTU˙+DˉTD˙,R˙=AU˙+RDD˙,Uˉ=ATRˉ,Dˉ=RDTRˉ.\bar R^T\dot R=\bar U^T\dot U+\bar D^T\dot D,\qquad \dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D,\quad \bar U=A^T\bar R,\quad \bar D=R_D^T\bar R.

它的状态部分与设计部分就是两个点积测试：

Its state and design parts are the two dot tests:

RˉT(AU˙)=U˙T(ATRˉ),RˉT(RDD˙)=D˙T(RDTRˉ).\bar R^T(A\dot U)=\dot U^T(A^T\bar R),\qquad \bar R^T(R_D\dot D)=\dot D^T(R_D^T\bar R).

点积测试检查转置实现是否相互一致，但不能单独证明 AA 是所需残差的导数：两边若犯同一个错误，测试仍会通过。因此还要做残差方向差分、独立复数运算和全链路目标差分。下面的面板现场给出三个检查，都使用同一组确定的种子 U˙\dot U、D˙\dot D、Rˉ\bar R：状态块与参数／几何块的点积测试（给出两个内积本身及相对误差），以及残差方向中心差分的相对误差随 ε\varepsilon 的变化：

A dot test checks that the two implementations are transposes of each other, but it cannot alone establish that AA differentiates the intended residual: the same mistake on both sides would still pass. Residual directional differences, independent complex arithmetic and full objective reruns provide the other checks. The panel below computes three checks live, all with one fixed set of seeds U˙\dot U, D˙\dot D, Rˉ\bar R: the dot tests of the state block and of the parameter/geometry block (both inner products and their relative difference), and the relative error of the residual directional central difference as a function of ε\varepsilon:

eFD(ε)=∥[R(U+ε U˙,D+ε D˙)−R(U−ε U˙,D−ε D˙)]/(2ε)−R˙∥∥R˙∥,R˙=AU˙+RDD˙.e_{\mathrm{FD}}(\varepsilon)=\frac{\bigl\|\bigl[R(U+\varepsilon\,\dot U,D+\varepsilon\,\dot D)-R(U-\varepsilon\,\dot U,D-\varepsilon\,\dot D)\bigr]/(2\varepsilon)-\dot R\bigr\|}{\|\dot R\|},\qquad \dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D.

eFDe_{\mathrm{FD}} 先随 ε2\varepsilon^2 下降（截断误差），再因舍入误差回升；中间存在一段很小的平台，才说明 AA 与 RDR_D 确实是这个残差的导数。播放器可查看某个面的反传如何累加到各控制体。

eFDe_{\mathrm{FD}} first falls like ε2\varepsilon^2 (truncation) and then rises again with round-off; a small plateau in between shows that AA and RDR_D really are the derivatives of this residual. The player shows how a selected face accumulates reverse contributions into its volumes.

图 9.4 用第 8、9 节的逐条语句构造了两种错误的伴随，把上面说的道理画出来：点积测试不能单独证明 AA 是所需残差的导数。漏掉一条反传路径的伴随立刻被点积测试抓住；前向和伴随犯同一个错误（都把远场状态当作常数），点积测试就检查不出来，只有差分能发现。

Figure 9.4 builds two wrong adjoints from the statements of Sections 8 and 9 and draws the point made above, that a dot test alone cannot prove that AA differentiates the intended residual. An adjoint that loses one return path is caught by the dot test at once; a tangent and an adjoint that make the same mistake (both treat the far-field state as a constant) pass it, and only the difference check finds the error.

为什么反向累加给出矩阵转置

Why reverse accumulation gives the matrix transpose

把所有残差和状态分量展平后，下面只是交换两个有限求和的次序。残差种子 Rˉ\bar R 是任意给定的，尚未求解伴随方程；只有选择满足第 11 节线性方程的 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi，才得到该目标对应的离散伴随解。取 D˙=0\dot D=0，前向得到 R˙=A 𝐔˙\dot R=A\,\dot{\mathbf U}；以 Rˉ\bar R 为种子反向扫描，得到 𝐔ˉ=ATRˉ\bar{\mathbf U}=A^T\bar R。下式就是 AD 的对偶（点积）恒等式：

After flattening all residual and state components, the following simply exchanges two finite sums. The residual seed Rˉ\bar R is arbitrary and has not solved an adjoint equation; only Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi satisfying Section 11 gives the discrete adjoint solution for the chosen objective. With D˙=0\dot D=0 the forward sweep gives R˙=A 𝐔˙\dot R=A\,\dot{\mathbf U}; the reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ\bar R gives 𝐔ˉ=ATRˉ\bar{\mathbf U}=A^T\bar R. The identity below is the duality (dot-product) identity of AD:

RˉTR˙=RˉT(A 𝐔˙)=∑r=1nu∑j=1nuRˉr∂Rr∂UjU˙j\bar R^T\dot R=\bar R^T(A\,\dot{\mathbf U})=\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}\bar R_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}\dot U_j
=∑j=1nuU˙j(∑r=1nu∂Rr∂UjRˉr)=𝐔˙T(ATRˉ)=𝐔˙T𝐔ˉ.=\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}\dot U_j\left(\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}\bar R_r\right)=\dot{\mathbf U}^T(A^T\bar R)=\dot{\mathbf U}^T\bar{\mathbf U}.

内部面通量向左加、向右减，所以先把这两条路径合并成通量的伴随 Hˉf\bar H_f；之后按通量、重构、原始状态的相反依赖顺序传播。反向语句中的 += 很重要：同一状态会被多个面和多个求积点读取，这些贡献必须累加。这里没有分部积分，也没有另行猜测连续伴随边界条件。

An interior flux is added on the left and subtracted on the right, so combine those two paths into its adjoint Hˉf\bar H_f before reversing fluxes, reconstruction and stored states. The += is essential: multiple faces and quadrature points read the same state, and their contributions must accumulate. There is no integration by parts and no separately guessed continuous adjoint boundary condition.

RL+=Hf, RR-=HfR_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f,\ R_R\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f
⟹Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR,\Longrightarrow\quad\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R,
z˙f=∑j∈𝒮f(Tf)j U˙j+KfD˙\dot z_f=\sum_{j\in\mathcal S_f}(T_f)_j\,\dot U_j+K_f\dot D
⟹Uˉj+=(Tf)jT zˉf.\Longrightarrow\quad\bar U_j\mathrel{\text{+=}}(T_f)_j^T\,\bar z_f.

第 8 节局部链里的每个切向量都有对应的伴随。反向语句按与前向相反的顺序执行，每个输入的横线量都用 += 累加：

Every tangent of the local chain of Section 8 has its adjoint. The reverse statements run in the opposite order of the forward ones, and the bar of every input accumulates with +=:

𝐔ˉ←0, Dˉ←0;Hˉf=∑iℬifRˉi,\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0,\ \bar D\leftarrow0;\quad \bar H_f=\sum_i\mathcal B_{if}\bar R_i,
Qˉi=−Rˉi,zˉf=Hz,fTHˉf,\bar Q_i=-\bar R_i,\quad \bar z_f=H_{z,f}^T\bar H_f,
𝐔ˉ+=TfTzˉf+(∂Q∂𝐔)TQˉ,\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}T_f^T\bar z_f+\Big(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^T\bar Q,
Dˉ+=KfTzˉf+(∂Q∂D)TQˉ.\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}K_f^T\bar z_f+\Big(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar Q.

本页没有被替换的残差行：边界条件都在边界面的通量里，所以上面的面循环转置就是完整的 ATA^T。

This page replaces no residual rows: the boundary conditions all sit in boundary-face fluxes, so the transposed face loop above is the complete ATA^T.

从切向量到伴随：转置把语句顺序反过来

From tangent to adjoint: the transpose runs the statements backwards

一个面的切向量是四个初等 Jacobian 的乘积。乘积的转置等于各个因子的转置按相反的顺序相乘：

The tangent of one face is the product of four elementary Jacobians. The transpose of a product is the product of the transposes in the reverse order:

AfT=(ℬ:,f Hz,f Zf 𝒢f)T=𝒢fT ZfT Hz,fT ℬ:,fT,A_f^T=\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,Z_f\,\mathcal G_f\big)^T=\mathcal G_f^T\,Z_f^T\,H_{z,f}^T\,\mathcal B_{:,f}^T,
(ℬ:,f Hz,f Kf)T=KfT Hz,fT ℬ:,fT.\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,K_f\big)^T=K_f^T\,H_{z,f}^T\,\mathcal B_{:,f}^T.

仍从右往左读，这就是反向扫描的语句顺序：程序最后执行的分发最先处理，最先执行的取值最后处理。先把所有伴随置零，再以 Rˉ\bar R 为种子逐条执行：

Read again from right to left, this is the order of the reverse sweep: the scatter, which the program ran last, comes first, and the gather, which it ran first, comes last. Zero every adjoint, seed with Rˉ\bar R, and run:

(0)𝐔ˉ←0,  Dˉ←0,(0)\quad \bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0,\ \ \bar D\leftarrow0,
(4′)Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉ=RˉL−RˉR,(4')\quad \bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R=\bar R_L-\bar R_R,
(3′)zˉf=Hz,fT Hˉf,(3')\quad \bar z_f=H_{z,f}^T\,\bar H_f,
(2′)𝐔ˉf=ZfT zˉf,Dˉ+=KfT zˉf,(2')\quad \bar{\mathbf U}_f=Z_f^T\,\bar z_f,\quad \bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}K_f^T\,\bar z_f,
(1′)𝐔ˉ+=𝒢fT 𝐔ˉf.(1')\quad \bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal G_f^T\,\bar{\mathbf U}_f.

面循环结束后，源项的一对也按同样的规则反过来：Qˉi=−Rˉi\bar Q_i=-\bar R_i，𝐔ˉ+=(∂Q/∂𝐔)TQˉ\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial Q/\partial \mathbf U)^T\bar Q，Dˉ+=(∂Q/∂D)TQˉ\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial Q/\partial D)^T\bar Q。本页代码里每一条语句的伴随语句（顺序与前向相反）也都在本节里逐句写出。

After the face loop the source is reversed by the same rule: Qˉi=−Rˉi\bar Q_i=-\bar R_i, 𝐔ˉ+=(∂Q/∂𝐔)TQˉ\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial Q/\partial \mathbf U)^T\bar Q, Dˉ+=(∂Q/∂D)TQˉ\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial Q/\partial D)^T\bar Q. The adjoint statement of every statement of this page's code, in the reverse order, is written out in this section as well.

分发与取值互为转置。分发 R+=ℬ:,fHfR\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}H_f 把一个面通量写进两行；它的转置 Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉ\bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R 从这两行读回一个数，是一次取值。取值 𝐔f=𝒢f𝐔\mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\mathbf U 从全局数组读出几个状态；它的转置 𝒢fT\mathcal G_f^T 把它们的伴随加回原来的位置，是一次带累加的分发。

Scatter and gather are transposes of each other. The scatter R+=ℬ:,fHfR\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}H_f writes one face flux into two rows; its transpose Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉ\bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R reads those two rows back into one number: a gather. The gather 𝐔f=𝒢f𝐔\mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\mathbf U reads a few states out of the global array; its transpose 𝒢fT\mathcal G_f^T adds their adjoints back into their places: a scatter with accumulation.

为什么要先置零、再用 += 累加：程序里的一次扇出（一个值被多处读取）在反向扫描里变成扇入。一个存储状态属于它每个相邻面的 𝒮f\mathcal S_f，设计变量也进入许多面与源项；链式法则对变量的每一次使用各给出一项，xˉ\bar x 是所有这些项的和：

Why zero first and then +=: a fan-out of the program (one value read in several places) becomes a fan-in of the reverse sweep. A stored state belongs to the 𝒮f\mathcal S_f of every neighbouring face, and the design enters many faces and the sources; the chain rule gives one term per use of a variable, and xˉ\bar x is the sum of all these terms:

Uˉj=∑f: j∈𝒮f(𝒢fT 𝐔ˉf)j+(∂Q∂Uj)TQˉ.\bar U_j=\sum_{f:\ j\in\mathcal S_f}\big(\mathcal G_f^T\,\bar{\mathbf U}_f\big)_j+\Big(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial U_j}\Big)^T\bar Q.

xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0 让这个和从零开始，每个 += 加上一次使用的贡献。反过来，程序里的扇入（RLR_L 收集它各个面的通量）在反向扫描里变成扇出：RˉL\bar R_L 只被读取，不需要累加。

xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0 starts this sum at zero, and each += adds the term of one use. Conversely, a fan-in of the program (RLR_L collecting the fluxes of all its faces) becomes a fan-out of the reverse sweep: RˉL\bar R_L is only read and needs no accumulation.

对偶恒等式的逐步证明，以及它的数值形式：点积测试

The duality identity step by step, and its numerical form: the dot-product test

把同一个面的前向语句与反向语句配对。每一步只用一次转置的定义 ⟨xˉ,ℰx˙⟩=⟨ℰTxˉ,x˙⟩\langle\bar x,\mathcal E\dot x\rangle=\langle\mathcal E^T\bar x,\dot x\rangle，把一个初等 Jacobian 从内积的右边移到左边，所以内积在每一级都相同：

Pair the forward and reverse statements of the same face. Each step uses the definition of the transpose once, ⟨xˉ,ℰx˙⟩=⟨ℰTxˉ,x˙⟩\langle\bar x,\mathcal E\dot x\rangle=\langle\mathcal E^T\bar x,\dot x\rangle, to move one elementary Jacobian from the right of the inner product to the left, so the inner product is the same at every stage:

RˉT(ℬ:,f H˙f)=(ℬ:,fTRˉ)TH˙f=HˉfTH˙f,\bar R^T\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,\dot H_f\big)=\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R\big)^T\dot H_f=\bar H_f^T\dot H_f,
HˉfTH˙f=HˉfTHz,f z˙f=(Hz,fTHˉf)Tz˙f=zˉfTz˙f,\bar H_f^T\dot H_f=\bar H_f^TH_{z,f}\,\dot z_f=\big(H_{z,f}^T\bar H_f\big)^T\dot z_f=\bar z_f^T\dot z_f,
zˉfTz˙f=zˉfT(Zf𝐔˙f+KfD˙)\bar z_f^T\dot z_f=\bar z_f^T\big(Z_f\dot{\mathbf U}_f+K_f\dot D\big)
=𝐔ˉfT𝐔˙f+(KfTzˉf)TD˙,=\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\dot{\mathbf U}_f+\big(K_f^T\bar z_f\big)^T\dot D,
𝐔ˉfT𝐔˙f=𝐔ˉfT𝒢f 𝐔˙=(𝒢fT𝐔ˉf)T𝐔˙.\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\dot{\mathbf U}_f=\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}=\big(\mathcal G_f^T\bar{\mathbf U}_f\big)^T\dot{\mathbf U}.

对所有面求和，再加上源项的一对 QˉTQ˙\bar Q^T\dot Q（Qˉ=−Rˉ\bar Q=-\bar R），右边的两项正好累加成反向扫描的输出 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 与 Dˉ\bar D：

Summed over all faces, with the pair of the source added (QˉTQ˙\bar Q^T\dot Q with Qˉ=−Rˉ\bar Q=-\bar R), the two terms on the right accumulate exactly into the outputs 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and Dˉ\bar D of the reverse sweep:

RˉTR˙=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙.\bar R^T\dot R=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D.

这就是 AD 的点积测试：任取种子 (𝐔˙,D˙)(\dot{\mathbf U},\dot D) 与 Rˉ\bar R，前向扫描算出 R˙\dot R，反向扫描算出 (𝐔ˉ,Dˉ)(\bar{\mathbf U},\bar D)，两边之差应在舍入误差量级；只要有一条反向语句的转置写错，差就是 O(1)O(1) 的。本页在构建时用它自己的 matrix-free 前向与反向乘积（nu=96n_u=96 个分量的确定性种子，设计方向取下面算例的 DkD_k）做了这个测试：RˉTR˙=17.9237415812\bar R^T\dot R=17.9237415812，𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙=17.9237415812\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D=17.9237415812，相对差 2×10−162\times10^{-16}。

This is the dot-product test of AD: take any seeds (𝐔˙,D˙)(\dot{\mathbf U},\dot D) and Rˉ\bar R, run the forward sweep for R˙\dot R and the reverse sweep for (𝐔ˉ,Dˉ)(\bar{\mathbf U},\bar D); the two sides must agree to round-off, and a single wrong transpose in the reverse statements gives an O(1)O(1) difference. This page ran the test on its own matrix-free forward and reverse products at build time (deterministic seeds with nu=96n_u=96 components, the design direction the DkD_k of the example below): RˉTR˙=17.9237415812\bar R^T\dot R=17.9237415812 and 𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙=17.9237415812\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D=17.9237415812, a relative difference of 2×10−162\times10^{-16}.

第 10 节Section 10

前向求解：输入改变后状态如何响应

Tangent solve: state response to a design input

设计变量向量是 D=(M∞,θ,X)D=(M_\infty,\theta,X)，XX 是全部节点坐标按节点编号排成的向量。把稳态残差沿 DD 求导，得到 A UD=−RDA\,U_D=-R_D（UD=dU/dDU_D=dU/dD 的第 kk 列是对 DkD_k 的状态响应）。右端必须包括远场参数或网格变化对数值残差的直接影响。用与原始 Newton 相同的 GMRES／GS 算法求解，但基准流场保持不动。

The design vector is D=(M∞,θ,X)D=(M_\infty,\theta,X), where XX stacks all node coordinates in node order. Differentiating the steady residual with respect to DD gives A UD=−RDA\,U_D=-R_D (column kk of UD=dU/dDU_D=dU/dD is the state response to DkD_k). The right-hand side includes the direct effect of free-stream or mesh changes. Solve with the same GMRES/GS as Newton, at the fixed converged base state.

A UD=−RD,dJdD=JU UD+JD.A\,U_D=-R_D,\qquad \frac{dJ}{dD}=J_U\,U_D+J_D.

前向模式一次只沿一个设计方向 D˙\dot D 求导：状态的切向量 U˙=UDD˙\dot U=U_D\dot D 满足下面的方程，J˙\dot J 是目标的方向导数。取 D˙=ek\dot D=e_k，U˙\dot U 就是 UDU_D 的第 kk 列 UDek=dU/dDkU_D e_k=dU/dD_k，J˙=dJ/dDk\dot J=dJ/dD_k。前向求解的结果 U˙\dot U 就是代码 tangent() 返回的解数组 x。

The forward mode differentiates along one design direction D˙\dot D at a time: the state tangent U˙=UDD˙\dot U=U_D\dot D solves the equation below, and J˙\dot J is the directional derivative of the objective. With D˙=ek\dot D=e_k, U˙\dot U is column kk of UDU_D, UDek=dU/dDkU_D e_k=dU/dD_k, and J˙=dJ/dDk\dot J=dJ/dD_k. The result U˙\dot U of the tangent solve is the solution array x that tangent() returns in the code.

A U˙=−RD D˙,J˙=JU U˙+JD D˙.A\,\dot U=-R_D\,\dot D,\qquad \dot J=J_U\,\dot U+J_D\,\dot D.

逐步推导：来流参数的导数

Step by step: derivatives with respect to the free-stream parameters

第一步，第 1 节的来流状态（ρ∞=p∞=1\rho_\infty=p_\infty=1，速度大小 M∞γM_\infty\sqrt\gamma，能量 p/(γ−1)+12ρ∣𝒖∣2p/(\gamma-1)+\tfrac12\rho|\boldsymbol u|^2）：

Step 1, the free-stream state of Section 1 (ρ∞=p∞=1\rho_\infty=p_\infty=1, speed M∞γM_\infty\sqrt\gamma, energy p/(γ−1)+12ρ∣𝒖∣2p/(\gamma-1)+\tfrac12\rho|\boldsymbol u|^2):

U∞(M∞,θ)=(1,  M∞γcos⁡θ,  M∞γsin⁡θ,  1γ−1+γM∞22)T.U_\infty(M_\infty,\theta)=\Bigl(1,\;M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\cos\theta,\;M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\sin\theta,\;\frac1{\gamma-1}+\frac{\gamma M_\infty^2}2\Bigr)^T.

第二步，逐分量求导（θ\theta 以弧度计）：

Step 2, differentiate component by component (θ\theta in radians):

∂U∞∂M∞=(0,  γcos⁡θ,  γsin⁡θ,  γM∞)T,∂U∞∂θ=(0,  −M∞γsin⁡θ,  M∞γcos⁡θ,  0)T.\frac{\partial U_\infty}{\partial M_\infty}=\bigl(0,\;\sqrt\gamma\cos\theta,\;\sqrt\gamma\sin\theta,\;\gamma M_\infty\bigr)^T,\qquad\frac{\partial U_\infty}{\partial\theta}=\bigl(0,\;-M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\sin\theta,\;M_\infty\sqrt\gamma\cos\theta,\;0\bigr)^T.

第三步，U∞U_\infty 只通过远场边界状态 Ub=G(UL;U∞,𝒏^)U_b=G(U_L;U_\infty,\hat{\boldsymbol n}) 进入残差（入／出流分支已冻结），所以前向方程的右端只在远场控制体的行上非零：

Step 3, U∞U_\infty enters the residual only through the far-field boundary states Ub=G(UL;U∞,𝒏^)U_b=G(U_L;U_\infty,\hat{\boldsymbol n}) (with the inflow/outflow branch frozen), so the tangent right-hand side is nonzero only in the rows of the far-field volumes:

RM∞=∑f∈farℬ⋅f  HUb(f) ∂G∂U∞(f) ∂U∞∂M∞,A dUdM∞=−RM∞.R_{M_\infty}=\sum_{f\in\mathrm{far}}\mathcal B_{\cdot f}\;H_{U_b}(f)\,\frac{\partial G}{\partial U_\infty}(f)\,\frac{\partial U_\infty}{\partial M_\infty},\qquad A\,\frac{dU}{dM_\infty}=-R_{M_\infty}.

第四步，第 7 节已说明 JM∞=0J_{M_\infty}=0，所以 dJ/dM∞=JU dU/dM∞dJ/dM_\infty=J_U\,dU/dM_\infty：导数完全来自状态的响应。图 10.1 画出右端的非零位置，图 10.2 画出解出的 dU/dM∞dU/dM_\infty。

Step 4, Section 7 showed JM∞=0J_{M_\infty}=0, so dJ/dM∞=JU dU/dM∞dJ/dM_\infty=J_U\,dU/dM_\infty: the derivative comes entirely from the state response. Figure 10.1 shows where the right-hand side is nonzero and Figure 10.2 the solution dU/dM∞dU/dM_\infty.

核对：第二步的两个公式与对代码 free() 的四阶中心差分（步长 10−310^{-3}）最大相差 1×10⁻¹³ 与 1×10⁻¹³；RM∞R_{M_\infty} 的非零行恰好是 8 个远场控制体；JU dU/dM∞=0.0469899429J_U\,dU/dM_\infty=0.0469899429，前向求解给出 0.0469899429，伴随给出 0.0469899429（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: the two formulas of Step 2 differ from fourth-order central differences of the code's free() (step 10−310^{-3}) by at most 1×10⁻¹³ and 1×10⁻¹³; the nonzero rows of RM∞R_{M_\infty} are exactly the 8 far-field volumes; JU dU/dM∞=0.0469899429J_U\,dU/dM_\infty=0.0469899429, the tangent solve gives 0.0469899429 and the adjoint 0.0469899429 (computed by this page’s code at build time).

前向模式分三步：以 U˙=0\dot U=0、D˙=ek\dot D=e_k 为种子，面循环求残差的切向量 R˙=RDD˙\dot R=R_D\dot D；用 GMRES 解 AU˙=−RDD˙A\dot U=-R_D\dot D；再求 J˙=JUU˙+JDD˙\dot J=J_U\dot U+J_D\dot D。图 10.3 逐帧演示这三步（可以播放、暂停、单步或拖动滑块）：右端只在少数几个面上不为零，GMRES 却要把它变成整个流场的响应。

The tangent mode has three steps: with the seeds U˙=0\dot U=0 and D˙=ek\dot D=e_k, the face loop computes the residual tangent R˙=RDD˙\dot R=R_D\dot D; GMRES solves AU˙=−RDD˙A\dot U=-R_D\dot D; then J˙=JUU˙+JDD˙\dot J=J_U\dot U+J_D\dot D. Figure 10.3 shows the three steps frame by frame (play, pause, step or drag the slider): the right-hand side is nonzero on only a few faces, yet GMRES turns it into a response of the whole flow.

攻角在所有导数中以弧度为单位；页首用度数显示。几何参数只移动所选节点，其余节点固定，不包含额外的网格弹性变形。下图显示响应场的某个守恒分量，色条给出范围。

Incidence derivatives are per radian, although the header displays degrees. A coordinate parameter moves only that node; other nodes stay fixed, without an additional mesh-deformation model. The plot shows a chosen conserved component of the response, with a colour bar for its range.

图 10.4Figure 10.4

把隐函数求导展开成可求解的系统

Expand implicit differentiation into a solvable system

设原始残差已经收敛，且当前光滑分支上的 AA 非奇异。取设计种子（方向）D˙\dot D，令 D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D；前向求解得到的状态切向量是 𝐔˙=ddt𝐔(D+t D˙)∣t=0\dot{\mathbf U}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf U(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}。对每一个残差分量逐项求导，零残差的切向量仍为零：

Assume the primal residual is converged and AA is nonsingular on the current smooth branch. Choose a design seed (direction) D˙\dot D and set D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D; the state tangent returned by the tangent solve is 𝐔˙=ddt𝐔(D+t D˙)∣t=0\dot{\mathbf U}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf U(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}. Differentiate each residual component: the tangent of a zero residual is zero.

0=R˙r=∑j∂Rr∂UjU˙j0=\dot R_r=\sum_j\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}\dot U_j
+∑k∂Rr∂DkD˙k(1≤r≤nu)+\sum_k\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}\dot D_k\quad(1\le r\le n_u)
⟹A 𝐔˙=−RD D˙.\Longrightarrow\quad A\,\dot{\mathbf U}=-R_D\,\dot D.
J^(D)=J(𝐔(D),D),\widehat{J}(D)=J(\mathbf U(D),D),
J˙=ddtJ^(D+t D˙)∣t=0=JU 𝐔˙+JD D˙.\dot J=\frac{d}{dt}\widehat{J}(D+t\,\dot D)\Big|_{t=0}=J_U\,\dot{\mathbf U}+J_D\,\dot D.

实现分三步：状态种子 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0、设计种子 D˙\dot D，前向求值残差得到 R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D；用精确 AA 的乘积求解 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}；再以 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 和 D˙\dot D 为种子对目标前向求导，得到 J˙\dot J。一次 A 𝐔˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U} 只是算子调用（一次前向扫描），不是求解 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}。稳态导数的对象是收敛残差方程，不是 Newton／GMRES 的迭代次数。在不可微点（如 limiter 的切换或分支判别处）以上普通导数需要另外讨论，不能无条件套用。

Implementation has three steps: seed the state with 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0 and the design with D˙\dot D and evaluate the residual tangent R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D; solve for 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} with exact AA products; then differentiate the objective forward with the seeds 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and D˙\dot D to obtain J˙\dot J. One A 𝐔˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U} is an operator application (one forward sweep), not the solution 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}. The steady derivative concerns the converged residual equation, not the Newton/GMRES iteration count. At nondifferentiable points (a limiter switch or a branch test) these ordinary derivatives need separate treatment.

用面循环的语句来看：右端 RDD˙R_D\dot D 是 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0 时的一次前向扫描，只有 KfD˙K_f\dot D 与源项两条路径起作用；迭代中的每个 A 𝐔˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U} 是 D˙=0\dot D=0 时的一次前向扫描。一次前向求解的全部工作就是这段面循环以不同的种子反复执行。对 nan_a 个设计分量逐个求导，要做 nan_a 次这样的求解。

In terms of the face loop's statements: the right-hand side RDD˙R_D\dot D is one forward sweep with 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0, in which only the paths KfD˙K_f\dot D and the source are active, and every A 𝐔˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U} of the iteration is one forward sweep with D˙=0\dot D=0. All the work of a tangent solve is this face loop run again and again with different seeds, and the derivatives with respect to all nan_a design components take nan_a such solves.

第 11 节Section 11

伴随求解：一次求解得到多个设计导数

Adjoint solve: one solve, many design derivatives

采用与其他页面一致的拉格朗日函数 ℒ=J+ψTR\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR。选择 ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T 后，状态响应 UDU_D 消掉；每个设计分量只需要直接目标导数加残差反传。换一个目标需要重新解一次伴随，但不需要重新求原始流场。

Use the same Lagrangian convention as the other pages: ℒ=J+ψTR\mathcal L=J+\psi^TR. Choosing ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T eliminates UDU_D. Each design derivative then combines the direct objective derivative and a residual reverse product. A new objective needs another adjoint solve, but not another primal flow solve.

ATψ=−JUT,dJdD=JD+ψTRD.A^T\psi=-J_U^T,\qquad \frac{dJ}{dD}=J_D+\psi^TR_D.

用反向模式的记号：以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为残差种子做一次反向扫描，状态的伴随是 Uˉ=ATψ=−JUT\bar U=A^T\psi=-J_U^T；再加上目标自身的种子 Jˉ=1\bar J=1，设计变量的伴随 Dˉ=RDTψ+JDT\bar D=R_D^T\psi+J_D^T 就是梯度 (dJ/dD)T(dJ/dD)^T。代码 sensitivities() 的最后一步正是种子为 (Rˉ,Jˉ)=(ψ,1)(\bar R,\bar J)=(\psi,1) 的一次反向扫描。

In reverse-mode notation: one reverse sweep with the residual seed Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi gives the state adjoint Uˉ=ATψ=−JUT\bar U=A^T\psi=-J_U^T; adding the objective’s own seed Jˉ=1\bar J=1, the design adjoint Dˉ=RDTψ+JDT\bar D=R_D^T\psi+J_D^T is the gradient (dJ/dD)T(dJ/dD)^T. The last step of sensitivities() in the code is exactly one reverse sweep with the seeds (Rˉ,Jˉ)=(ψ,1)(\bar R,\bar J)=(\psi,1).

图 11.1 画出 JyJ_y 的伴随解。

Figure 11.1 shows the adjoint solution for JyJ_y.

逐步推导：伴随解的含义，以及一次求解得到全部导数

Step by step: what the adjoint solution means, and why one solve gives every derivative

第一步，设想给第 kk 条残差方程加一个常数 tt：R(U)+t ek=0R(U)+t\,e_k=0（eke_k 是第 kk 个单位向量），收敛解 UU 与目标 JJ 都随 tt 变化。在 t=0t=0 处对 tt 求导：

Step 1, imagine adding a constant tt to residual equation kk: R(U)+t ek=0R(U)+t\,e_k=0 (eke_k the kk-th unit vector), so that the converged UU and the objective JJ depend on tt. Differentiate with respect to tt at t=0t=0:

A dUdt=−ek,dJdt=JU dUdt=−JUA−1ek.A\,\frac{dU}{dt}=-e_k,\qquad\frac{dJ}{dt}=J_U\,\frac{dU}{dt}=-J_UA^{-1}e_k.

第二步，伴随方程 ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T 转置后就是 ψT=−JUA−1\psi^T=-J_UA^{-1}，代入：

Step 2, the adjoint equation ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T, transposed, reads ψT=−JUA−1\psi^T=-J_UA^{-1}; substitute:

dJdt=ψTek=ψk.\frac{dJ}{dt}=\psi^Te_k=\psi_k.

所以 ψk\psi_k 是目标对第 kk 条方程“残差扰动”的灵敏度，与设计变量无关。第三步，每个设计变量 DjD_j 都只是以 RDjR_{D_j} 的形式扰动残差，于是 dJ/dDj=JDj+ψTRDjdJ/dD_j=J_{D_j}+\psi^TR_{D_j}，这正是本节末尾 Lagrangian 推导得到的公式；右边对全部 jj 只需要一次残差的反向扫描 RDTψR_D^T\psi。第四步，计算量：前向方法每个设计变量解一次 A UDj=−RDjA\,U_{D_j}=-R_{D_j}，伴随方法无论有多少设计变量都只解一次 ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T。

So ψk\psi_k is the sensitivity of the objective to a “residual perturbation” of equation kk, independent of any design variable. Step 3, every design variable DjD_j perturbs the residual only through RDjR_{D_j}, hence dJ/dDj=JDj+ψTRDjdJ/dD_j=J_{D_j}+\psi^TR_{D_j}, the formula the Lagrangian derivation at the end of this section arrives at; for all jj at once the right-hand side needs one reverse sweep of the residual, RDTψR_D^T\psi. Step 4, the cost: the tangent method solves A UDj=−RDjA\,U_{D_j}=-R_{D_j} once per design variable, the adjoint method solves ATψ=−JUTA^T\psi=-J_U^T once, however many design variables there are.

核对：取 ∣ψ∣|\psi| 最大的分量（控制体 23 的 ρ 方程，ψk=−0.75569516\psi_k=−0.75569516），用本页的 forcing 接口取 t=±εt=\pm\varepsilon（ε=1×10−4\varepsilon=1×10⁻⁴）重新求解原始问题，中心差分 (J∣t=ε−J∣t=−ε)/(2ε)=−0.75569517(J|_{t=\varepsilon}-J|_{t=-\varepsilon})/(2\varepsilon)=−0.75569517；全部 50 个设计变量逐个做前向求解，与一次伴随给出的梯度最大相差 1×10⁻¹²（梯度元素最大为 0.252）（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: take the largest component of ∣ψ∣|\psi| (the ρ equation of volume 23, ψk=−0.75569516\psi_k=−0.75569516), set t=±εt=\pm\varepsilon through the page's forcing hook (ε=1×10−4\varepsilon=1×10⁻⁴) and re-solve the primal problem: the central difference (J∣t=ε−J∣t=−ε)/(2ε)=−0.75569517(J|_{t=\varepsilon}-J|_{t=-\varepsilon})/(2\varepsilon)=−0.75569517; one tangent solve for each of the 50 design variables differs from the gradient of the single adjoint solve by at most 1×10⁻¹² (largest gradient entry 0.252) (computed by this page’s code at build time).

图 11.2 把整页的三条计算链放在一起：前向每个设计方向要一次线性求解，伴随只要一次。

Figure 11.2 puts the three computation chains of the whole page side by side: the tangent needs one linear solve per design direction, the adjoint only one.

上面第一、二步给了 ψk\psi_k 一个具体的含义。图 11.3 换成物理的说法：给一个控制体加上质量源或动量源（只加在质量方程或动量方程的右端，能量方程不变），JJ 的变化率就是 −ψ-\psi 的相应分量，所以伴随的密度分量与动量分量可以直接读成“在哪里、朝哪个方向推流体，目标变化最大”，并用重新求解核对。

Steps 1 and 2 above give ψk\psi_k a concrete meaning. Figure 11.3 puts it physically: add a mass source or a momentum source to one control volume (a source on the right-hand side of the mass or of the momentum equations only; the energy equation is unchanged), and JJ changes at the rate of the corresponding component of −ψ-\psi. The density and momentum components of the adjoint can therefore be read as where to push the fluid, and in which direction, to change the objective most, which re-solves confirm.

图 11.4 把第四步所说的代价数出来：前向路线每个设计变量一次线性求解，伴随路线每个目标一次。

Figure 11.4 counts the cost of Step 4: one linear solve per design variable on the tangent route, one per objective on the adjoint route.

右预处理使用 P−TP^{-T}，即前向 GS 三角算子的精确转置逆。它与完整 ATA^T 不同。停止条件检查未预处理的真实残差 ∥ATψ+JUT∥\|A^T\psi+J_U^T\|，避免预处理缩放掩盖误差。图中乘子对应四条积分平衡方程，不是压力或流速。

Right preconditioning uses P−TP^{-T}, the inverse transpose of the forward GS triangular operator. It is distinct from ATA^T. The stopping test uses the true unpreconditioned residual ∥ATψ+JUT∥\|A^T\psi+J_U^T\|, so preconditioner scaling cannot hide error. The four multiplier components correspond to integrated conservation equations, not to pressure or velocity.

图 11.5 逐帧演示这个伴随求解：每一帧是 GMRES 做了 mm 步之后的 ψm\psi_m，右边同时给出真残差，以及用 ψm\psi_m 算出的梯度的误差。

Figure 11.5 shows this adjoint solve frame by frame: each frame is the ψm\psi_m of GMRES after mm steps, with its true residual and the error of the gradient computed from ψm\psi_m on the right.

解出 ψ\psi 之后，梯度只要一次反向扫描。图 11.6 逐个面演示这次扫描：四分量的 Uˉ\bar U 怎样一面一面累加、最后在每个控制体都抵消为零，形状梯度 Xˉ\bar X 又怎样在节点上长出来。

Once ψ\psi is known, the gradient needs one reverse sweep. Figure 11.6 runs this sweep face by face: how the four-component Uˉ\bar U accumulates face after face and finally cancels to zero in every control volume, and how the shape gradient Xˉ\bar X grows at the nodes.

图 11.7Figure 11.7

从有限维 Lagrangian 逐步消去状态敏感度

Eliminate state sensitivity from a finite-dimensional Lagrangian

ℒ(𝐔,D,ψ)=J(𝐔,D)+ψTR(𝐔,D).\mathcal L(\mathbf U,D,\psi)=J(\mathbf U,D)+\psi^TR(\mathbf U,D).

在满足 R=0R=0 的解上 ℒ=J\mathcal L=J。先把 ψ\psi 固定，沿切向量 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}、D˙\dot D 对 ℒ\mathcal L 前向求导，再按 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 和 D˙\dot D 收集系数。即使 ψ\psi 随设计改变，额外的 ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR 项也在收敛解上为零。

At a feasible state R=0R=0, ℒ=J\mathcal L=J. Hold ψ\psi fixed, differentiate ℒ\mathcal L forward along the tangents 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and D˙\dot D, then collect the coefficients of 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and D˙\dot D. Even if ψ\psi varies with the design, the extra ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR term vanishes at the converged state.

ℒ˙=JU𝐔˙+JDD˙+ψT(A𝐔˙+RDD˙)\dot{\mathcal L}=J_U\dot{\mathbf U}+J_D\dot D+\psi^T(A\dot{\mathbf U}+R_D\dot D)
=(JUT+ATψ)T𝐔˙+(JDT+RDTψ)TD˙.=(J_U^T+A^T\psi)^T\dot{\mathbf U}+(J_D^T+R_D^T\psi)^T\dot D.

选择 ψ\psi 使未知的状态敏感度前面的系数为零。于是一个目标只需求解一次伴随线性系统，再进行设计反传；总设计梯度是列向量 ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J。注意符号来自这里的加号约定，并不是因为“伴随一定带负号”。

Choose ψ\psi to cancel the coefficient of the unknown state sensitivity. One objective then requires one adjoint solve followed by design reverse accumulation; the total design gradient ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J is a column. Its sign follows from the plus convention in this Lagrangian, not from a universal negative sign for adjoints.

ATψ=−JUT,∇DJ^=JDT+RDTψ,\boxed{A^T\psi=-J_U^T},\qquad\boxed{\nabla_D\widehat J=J_D^T+R_D^T\psi},
dJ^dDk=∂J∂Dk+∑rψr∂Rr∂Dk.\frac{d\widehat J}{dD_k}=\frac{\partial J}{\partial D_k}+\sum_r\psi_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}.

用反向模式的横线记号：以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为种子运行残差的反向扫描，得到 𝐔ˉ=ATψ=−JUT\bar{\mathbf U}=A^T\psi=-J_U^T，这就是伴随方程。再把目标自己的反向语句（种子 Jˉ=1\bar J=1）累加进同一组横线量：它们给 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 加上 JUTJ_U^T，给 Dˉ\bar D 加上 JDTJ_D^T，于是 𝐔ˉ=JUT+ATψ=0\bar{\mathbf U}=J_U^T+A^T\psi=0。伴随方程说的正是状态的横线量总和为零：状态不再把敏感度往下传，同一次扫描的设计伴随 Dˉ=JDT+RDTψ\bar D=J_D^T+R_D^T\psi 就是梯度 ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J。也可以直接检查与 tangent 的等价性：利用 A 𝐔˙=−RD D˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U}=-R_D\,\dot D，JU 𝐔˙=−ψTA 𝐔˙=ψTRD D˙J_U\,\dot{\mathbf U}=-\psi^TA\,\dot{\mathbf U}=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D，所以两条路线给出同一个 J˙=DˉTD˙\dot J=\bar D^T\dot D。更换为 ℒ=J−λTR\mathcal L=J-\lambda^TR 会得到 λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi，但这只是两个离散乘子的符号约定，不能据此认定连续场 λ(x)\lambda(x) 与离散向量逐点相等。

In the bar notation of reverse mode: the residual's reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi returns 𝐔ˉ=ATψ=−JUT\bar{\mathbf U}=A^T\psi=-J_U^T, which is the adjoint equation. Accumulate the objective's own reverse statements (seeded with Jˉ=1\bar J=1) into the same bars: they add JUTJ_U^T to 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and JDTJ_D^T to Dˉ\bar D, so 𝐔ˉ=JUT+ATψ=0\bar{\mathbf U}=J_U^T+A^T\psi=0. The adjoint equation says exactly that the state's total bar vanishes: the state passes no sensitivity on, and the design adjoint of the same sweep, Dˉ=JDT+RDTψ\bar D=J_D^T+R_D^T\psi, is the gradient ∇DJ^\nabla_D\widehat J. Check equivalence with the tangent: A 𝐔˙=−RD D˙A\,\dot{\mathbf U}=-R_D\,\dot D gives JU 𝐔˙=−ψTA 𝐔˙=ψTRD D˙J_U\,\dot{\mathbf U}=-\psi^TA\,\dot{\mathbf U}=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D, so both routes give the same J˙=DˉTD˙\dot J=\bar D^T\dot D. Changing to ℒ=J−λTR\mathcal L=J-\lambda^TR yields λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi, but that relates two discrete sign conventions; it does not prove pointwise equality with a continuous field λ(x)\lambda(x).

精确算子决定求解哪个方程；Newton 迭代与 GS 预处理 GMRES 决定如何求解。较便宜的近似 Jacobian（例如一阶或冻结部分系数的 Jacobian）可以用于迭代修正或预处理，但不能替代精确转置。应监控真残差 rψ=ATψ+JUTr_\psi=A^T\psi+J_U^T。若其不为零，当前伴随与精确 tangent 的方向导数差为 −rψT𝐔˙-r_\psi^T\dot{\mathbf U}，因此只看迭代次数或预处理残差不够。

The exact operator determines the equation; Newton iterations and GS-preconditioned GMRES determine how it is solved. A cheaper approximate Jacobian (first order, or with some coefficients frozen) may supply corrections or preconditioning, but cannot replace the exact transpose. Monitor the true residual rψ=ATψ+JUTr_\psi=A^T\psi+J_U^T. If it is nonzero, the current adjoint directional derivative minus the exact tangent derivative is −rψT𝐔˙-r_\psi^T\dot{\mathbf U}; an iteration count or a preconditioned residual alone is insufficient.

为什么一次伴随求解能代替 nan_a 次前向求解

Why one adjoint solve replaces nan_a tangent solves

同样的结论也可以不经过 Lagrangian，直接由前向求解的两个关系得到：

The same result follows without a Lagrangian, directly from the two relations of the tangent solve:

J˙=JU𝐔˙+JDD˙,𝐔˙=−A−1RDD˙\dot J=J_U\dot{\mathbf U}+J_D\dot D,\qquad \dot{\mathbf U}=-A^{-1}R_D\dot D
⟹J˙=JDD˙−JU A−1 RDD˙.\Longrightarrow\qquad \dot J=J_D\dot D-J_U\,A^{-1}\,R_D\dot D.

最后一项是三个因子 JUJ_U、A−1A^{-1}、RDD˙R_D\dot D 的乘积，括号可以从两边加。前向路线先算 A−1(RDD˙)A^{-1}(R_D\dot D)：它依赖方向 D˙\dot D，每个设计分量都要解一次以 AA 为系数的方程，全部分量要解 nan_a 次。伴随路线先算行向量 JUA−1J_UA^{-1}：它与 D˙\dot D 无关，只要解一次。把这个行向量记作 −ψT-\psi^T：

The last term is the product of three factors, JUJ_U, A−1A^{-1} and RDD˙R_D\dot D, which can be bracketed from either side. The tangent route computes A−1(RDD˙)A^{-1}(R_D\dot D) first: it depends on the direction D˙\dot D, so every design component needs one solve with AA, nan_a solves for all of them. The adjoint route computes the row JUA−1J_UA^{-1} first: it does not depend on D˙\dot D, so it is solved once. Call this row −ψT-\psi^T:

ψT=−JU A−1⟺ATψ=−JUT,\psi^T=-J_U\,A^{-1}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad A^T\psi=-J_U^T,
J˙=(JDT+RDTψ)TD˙=DˉTD˙.\dot J=\big(J_D^T+R_D^T\psi\big)^T\dot D=\bar D^T\dot D.

这对每个方向 D˙\dot D 都成立，所以梯度就是上面方框里的 ∇DJ^=Dˉ\nabla_D\widehat J=\bar D：一次伴随求解之后，再以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为种子做一次反向扫描，就得到全部分量。两条路线的计算量（本页的 nan_a 与 nun_u 由本页代码数出，与页首路线图相同）：

This holds for every direction D˙\dot D, so the gradient is the boxed ∇DJ^=Dˉ\nabla_D\widehat J=\bar D above: after one adjoint solve, one reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi gives every component. The cost of the two routes (nan_a and nun_u of this page, counted by its code, as in the page roadmap at the top):

求解之后After the solvesnan_a 次前向扫描，各得一个 J˙\dot Jnan_a forward sweeps, one J˙\dot J each1 次反向扫描，得到整个 Dˉ\bar D1 reverse sweep, the whole Dˉ\bar D

nJn_J 个目标时With nJn_J objectives仍是 nan_a 次（UD ekU_D\,e_k 与目标无关）still nan_a (UD ekU_D\,e_k does not depend on the objective)nJn_J 次nJn_J

本页 na=50n_a=50、nu=96n_u=96：前向路线要解 50 个 96 阶的线性方程组，伴随路线只解 1 个。设计变量多而目标少时（形状优化通常如此）伴随路线便宜得多；设计变量少而目标多时，前向路线更合适。

This page has na=50n_a=50 and nu=96n_u=96: the tangent route solves 50 linear systems of order 96, the adjoint route one. With many design variables and few objectives (the usual case in shape optimisation) the adjoint route is far cheaper; with few design variables and many objectives the tangent route is the better choice.

第 12 节Section 12

几何导数：面法向、面长与直接压力载荷

Geometry derivatives: normals, lengths and direct pressure load

二维标量已经展示了移动节点如何改变法向。Euler 还需要把单位法向的变化传入远场特征旋转，把面长变化传入耗散。格点对偶面由边中点和顶点平均中心构造，因此一个节点还会影响相邻对偶分段。所有这些几何计算都进入同一条求导链。

As in the scalar example, moving a node changes face normals. Euler additionally differentiates unit normals in the characteristic rotations and lengths in the dissipation. Node-centred dual segments depend on edge midpoints and vertex-average cell centres, so one coordinate affects neighbouring segments. All these constructions enter the same derivative graph.

𝒏˙=(y˙e−y˙s,  −x˙e+x˙s),ℓ˙=𝒏^⋅𝒏˙,𝒏^˙=𝒏˙−𝒏^ ℓ˙ℓ.\dot{\boldsymbol n}=(\dot y_e-\dot y_s,\;-\dot x_e+\dot x_s),\quad\dot\ell=\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\dot{\boldsymbol n},\quad\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}=\frac{\dot{\boldsymbol n}-\hat{\boldsymbol n}\,\dot\ell}{\ell}.

图 12.1 用一个物面半面说明上面三个公式的几何意义。

Figure 12.1 shows the geometric meaning of the three formulas above on one wall half-face.

逐步推导：面积向量、面长与单位法向对坐标的导数

Step by step: derivatives of area vectors, face lengths and unit normals with respect to the coordinates

第一步，面积向量是端点坐标的线性函数，𝒏f=(𝒙e−𝒙s)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=(\boldsymbol x_e-\boldsymbol x_s)^{\perp}，逐个坐标求导（格点页的物面半面取物面边面积向量的一半，下面的结果都乘 12\tfrac12）：

Step 1, the area vector is a linear function of the endpoint coordinates, 𝒏f=(𝒙e−𝒙s)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=(\boldsymbol x_e-\boldsymbol x_s)^{\perp}; differentiate coordinate by coordinate (a wall half-face of the node page carries half the area vector of its wall edge, so its results carry a factor 12\tfrac12):

∂𝒏f∂xs=(0,1),∂𝒏f∂ys=(−1,0),∂𝒏f∂xe=(0,−1),∂𝒏f∂ye=(1,0).\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial x_s}=(0,1),\quad\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial y_s}=(-1,0),\quad\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial x_e}=(0,-1),\quad\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial y_e}=(1,0).

第二步，面长 ℓ=(nx2+ny2)1/2\ell=(n_x^2+n_y^2)^{1/2}，链式法则给出沿法向的投影；第三步，单位法向 𝒏^=𝒏/ℓ\hat{\boldsymbol n}=\boldsymbol n/\ell，商的求导法则给出垂直部分：

Step 2, the face length ℓ=(nx2+ny2)1/2\ell=(n_x^2+n_y^2)^{1/2}; the chain rule gives the projection on the normal. Step 3, the unit normal 𝒏^=𝒏/ℓ\hat{\boldsymbol n}=\boldsymbol n/\ell; the quotient rule gives the perpendicular part:

ℓ˙=nxn˙x+nyn˙yℓ=𝒏^⋅𝒏˙,𝒏^˙=𝒏˙ℓ−𝒏 ℓ˙ℓ2=𝒏˙−𝒏^ ℓ˙ℓ,𝒏^⋅𝒏^˙=0.\dot\ell=\frac{n_x\dot n_x+n_y\dot n_y}{\ell}=\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\dot{\boldsymbol n},\qquad\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}=\frac{\dot{\boldsymbol n}}{\ell}-\frac{\boldsymbol n\,\dot\ell}{\ell^2}=\frac{\dot{\boldsymbol n}-\hat{\boldsymbol n}\,\dot\ell}{\ell},\qquad\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}=0.

第四步（格点页），对偶面 ff 由若干段 σ\sigma 组成：每段从原始边的中点 𝒙m=12(𝒙s+𝒙e)\boldsymbol x_m=\tfrac12(\boldsymbol x_s+\boldsymbol x_e) 连到一个相邻单元的中心 𝒈σ\boldsymbol g_\sigma（该单元 3 个或 4 个顶点的平均），并带朝向符号 χσ=±1\chi_\sigma=\pm1，于是 𝒏f=∑σ∈fχσ(𝒈σ−𝒙m)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=\sum_{\sigma\in f}\chi_\sigma(\boldsymbol g_\sigma-\boldsymbol x_m)^{\perp}。中点和中心都是节点坐标的线性组合，所以：

Step 4 (node page), a dual face ff consists of segments σ\sigma: each runs from the midpoint 𝒙m=12(𝒙s+𝒙e)\boldsymbol x_m=\tfrac12(\boldsymbol x_s+\boldsymbol x_e) of the original edge to the centre 𝒈σ\boldsymbol g_\sigma of one neighbouring cell (the average of its 3 or 4 vertices) and carries an orientation sign χσ=±1\chi_\sigma=\pm1, so 𝒏f=∑σ∈fχσ(𝒈σ−𝒙m)⊥\boldsymbol n_f=\sum_{\sigma\in f}\chi_\sigma(\boldsymbol g_\sigma-\boldsymbol x_m)^{\perp}. Midpoints and centres are linear combinations of the node coordinates, so:

∂𝒏f∂xj=∑σ∈fχσκjσ (0,−1),∂𝒏f∂yj=∑σ∈fχσκjσ (1,0),𝒈σ−𝒙m=∑jκjσ𝒙j,\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial x_j}=\sum_{\sigma\in f}\chi_\sigma\kappa_{j\sigma}\,(0,-1),\qquad\frac{\partial\boldsymbol n_f}{\partial y_j}=\sum_{\sigma\in f}\chi_\sigma\kappa_{j\sigma}\,(1,0),\qquad\boldsymbol g_\sigma-\boldsymbol x_m=\sum_j\kappa_{j\sigma}\boldsymbol x_j,

其中权重 κjσ\kappa_{j\sigma} 在节点 jj 是该单元的顶点时取顶点数的倒数（13\tfrac13 或 14\tfrac14），在节点 jj 是原始边的端点时再减去 12\tfrac12，其余为 0。一个节点因此会影响所有以它所在单元的中心为端点的对偶段，比格心页的影响范围更大（第 10 节的右端图）。

where the weight κjσ\kappa_{j\sigma} is the reciprocal of that cell’s vertex count (13\tfrac13 or 14\tfrac14) when node jj is one of its vertices, minus 12\tfrac12 when node jj is an endpoint of the original edge, and 0 otherwise. A node therefore affects every dual segment that ends at the centre of one of its cells, a wider reach than on the cell page (the right-hand-side figure of Section 10).

第五步，图 12.2 汇总这些依赖：坐标经面积向量进入每个面的通量与物面目标，经面长进入耗散，经单位法向进入远场的特征旋转；反向时 Xˉ+=(∂𝒏f/∂X)T𝒏ˉf\bar X\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial\boldsymbol n_f/\partial X)^T\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f，对各面收集到的 𝒏ˉf\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f 求和。

Step 5, Figure 12.2 collects these dependencies: the coordinates enter every face flux and the wall objective through the area vectors, the dissipation through the face lengths and the far-field characteristic rotation through the unit normals; in reverse, Xˉ+=(∂𝒏f/∂X)T𝒏ˉf\bar X\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial\boldsymbol n_f/\partial X)^T\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f, summed over the 𝒏ˉf\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f collected on every face.

核对：𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f 对坐标是线性的，所以单位步长的中心差分没有截断误差：对全部面、全部 48 个坐标，它与上面的公式最大相差 3×10⁻¹⁶；ℓ˙\dot\ell 与 𝒏^˙\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}} 的公式与步长 10−610^{-6} 的中心差分最大相差 2×10⁻¹¹ 与 1×10⁻¹⁰（差分本身的误差）（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: 𝒏f\boldsymbol n_f is linear in the coordinates, so a central difference with unit step has no truncation error: over all faces and all 48 coordinates it differs from the formulas above by at most 3×10⁻¹⁶; the formulas for ℓ˙\dot\ell and 𝒏^˙\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}} differ from central differences with step 10−610^{-6} by at most 2×10⁻¹¹ and 1×10⁻¹⁰ (the error of the differences themselves) (computed by this page’s code at build time).

物理通量对面积向量是线性的：Fn(U)=Fx(U) nx+Fy(U) nyF_n(U)=F_x(U)\,n_x+F_y(U)\,n_y。所以状态固定时，面积向量的切向量 𝒏˙\dot{\boldsymbol n} 给出通量的切向量 Fn˙(U):=Fx(U) n˙x+Fy(U) n˙yF_{\dot n}(U):=F_x(U)\,\dot n_x+F_y(U)\,\dot n_y。于是固定状态下面通量的切向量为：

The physical flux is linear in the area vector: Fn(U)=Fx(U) nx+Fy(U) nyF_n(U)=F_x(U)\,n_x+F_y(U)\,n_y. At fixed state a tangent 𝒏˙\dot{\boldsymbol n} of the area vector therefore gives the flux tangent Fn˙(U):=Fx(U) n˙x+Fy(U) n˙yF_{\dot n}(U):=F_x(U)\,\dot n_x+F_y(U)\,\dot n_y. At fixed state the face flux then has the tangent:

H˙∣U=12(Fn˙(UL)+Fn˙(UR))−α2 ℓ˙ (UR−UL)+HUb U˙b∣UL.\left.\dot H\right|_U=\tfrac12\bigl(F_{\dot n}(U_L)+F_{\dot n}(U_R)\bigr)-\tfrac\alpha2\,\dot\ell\,(U_R-U_L)+H_{U_b}\,\dot U_b\big|_{U_L}.

最后一项只在远场出现：Ub=G(UL;U∞,𝒏^)U_b=G(U_L;U_\infty,\hat{\boldsymbol n}) 依赖单位法向（旋转与 r±r_\pm），所以即使 ULU_L 不变，𝒏^˙\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}} 也会给出 U˙b\dot U_b。几何分支、连通性和边界分类在这些微扰中保持不变；不允许跨过翻转单元或切换入流分类后还声称使用同一个导数。积分稳态残差没有体积除法，因此体积导数不出现在当前 RDR_D 中；若加入时间项，它就必须出现。

The last term applies at the far field only: Ub=G(UL;U∞,𝒏^)U_b=G(U_L;U_\infty,\hat{\boldsymbol n}) depends on the unit normal (rotation and r±r_\pm), so 𝒏^˙\dot{\hat{\boldsymbol n}} gives a U˙b\dot U_b even at fixed ULU_L. Connectivity and boundary classification stay fixed under these perturbations. Crossing an inverted cell or changing an inflow branch is outside this linearisation. Integrated steady residuals have no volume division, so volume derivatives do not appear in RDR_D; they would be required for time terms.

逐步推导：几何的伴随语句与一个物面节点的形状导数

Step by step: the adjoint statements of the geometry, and the shape derivative of one wall node

第一步，第 9 节的逆序语句把每个面的几何伴随收集到 𝒏ˉf\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f：内部面与远场面的物理通量给 (FxTFˉ,FyTFˉ)(F_x^T\bar F,F_y^T\bar F)，耗散经 ℓˉ\bar\ell 给 𝒏^ℓˉ\hat{\boldsymbol n}\bar\ell，远场闭合经单位法向给 (𝒏^ˉ−𝒏^(𝒏^⋅𝒏^ˉ))/ℓ(\bar{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}-\hat{\boldsymbol n}(\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\bar{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}))/\ell，物面通量给 p (Hˉρu,Hˉρv)p\,(\bar H_{\rho u},\bar H_{\rho v})，目标给 p Jˉ 𝒆dp\,\bar J\,\boldsymbol e_d。第二步，面积向量对坐标是线性的，上面“逐步推导：面积向量、面长与单位法向对坐标的导数”的第一步给出四个导数，转置后就是节点坐标的伴随语句（格点页的物面半面乘 12\tfrac12；对偶面按那个推导第四步的权重 κjσ\kappa_{j\sigma} 分给各个节点）：

Step 1, the reverse statements of Section 9 collect every face’s geometry adjoint in 𝒏ˉf\bar{\boldsymbol n}_f: the physical fluxes of interior and far-field faces give (FxTFˉ,FyTFˉ)(F_x^T\bar F,F_y^T\bar F), the dissipation gives 𝒏^ℓˉ\hat{\boldsymbol n}\bar\ell through ℓˉ\bar\ell, the far-field closure gives (𝒏^ˉ−𝒏^(𝒏^⋅𝒏^ˉ))/ℓ(\bar{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}-\hat{\boldsymbol n}(\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\bar{\hat{\boldsymbol n}}))/\ell through the unit normal, the wall flux gives p (Hˉρu,Hˉρv)p\,(\bar H_{\rho u},\bar H_{\rho v}) and the objective p Jˉ 𝒆dp\,\bar J\,\boldsymbol e_d. Step 2, the area vector is linear in the coordinates, and the four derivatives that Step 1 of “Step by step: derivatives of area vectors, face lengths and unit normals with respect to the coordinates” above gives, transposed, are the adjoint statements of the node coordinates (a wall half-face of the node page carries a factor 12\tfrac12; a dual face shares its adjoint among the nodes with the weights κjσ\kappa_{j\sigma} of Step 4 of that derivation):

xˉs+=nˉy,yˉs+=−nˉx,xˉe+=−nˉy,yˉe+=nˉx.\bar x_s\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar n_y,\qquad\bar y_s\mathrel{\text{+=}}-\bar n_x,\qquad\bar x_e\mathrel{\text{+=}}-\bar n_y,\qquad\bar y_e\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar n_x.

第 13 节Section 13

有限差分：变量、步长与完整原始重算

Finite differences: variables, steps and full primal reruns

每个差分点都移动同一个设计变量，重新计算几何与边界状态，并把整个 Euler 原始问题重新收敛。不能只在固定 U∗U^* 上差分 JJ，那样只得到直接导数 JDJ_D。表中同时保留正负扰动目标值、原始残差与完整梯度；选择“全部变量”可检查来流与全部物面坐标。

Each difference perturbs the selected parameter, recomputes geometry and boundary states, and reconverges the full Euler problem. Differencing JJ at fixed U∗U^* would recover only the direct derivative JDJ_D. Tables retain both perturbed objectives, the primal residuals and the total gradients. The all-variable option checks the free-stream inputs and every body coordinate.

FDε+=J(D+εek)−J(D)ε,FDε0=J(D+εek)−J(D−εek)2ε.\mathrm{FD}_\varepsilon^+=\frac{J(D+\varepsilon e_k)-J(D)}\varepsilon,\qquad \mathrm{FD}_\varepsilon^0=\frac{J(D+\varepsilon e_k)-J(D-\varepsilon e_k)}{2\varepsilon}.

图 13.1 说明为什么每个差分点都必须重新收敛原始问题：只在固定的 U∗U^* 上差分 JJ，得到的只是直接偏导数 JDJ_D。

Figure 13.1 shows why every difference point must re-converge the primal problem: differencing JJ at the fixed U∗U^* returns only the direct partial derivative JDJ_D.

eke_k 是第 kk 个设计变量的单位方向，ε\varepsilon 是差分步长（与第 15 节的网格尺度 hh 无关）。大步长有截断误差；很小的步长放大舍入和原始求解残差。步长扫描按整数量级 ε=10−2,10−3,…,10−12\varepsilon=10^{-2},10^{-3},\dots,10^{-12} 均匀取点，横轴就是 ε\varepsilon。正确证据是存在合适的步长区间，而不是只挑一个好看的数字。误差可切换绝对值与相对分量误差；当真梯度接近零时，优先查看绝对误差。

eke_k is the unit direction of design variable kk and ε\varepsilon the difference step (unrelated to the mesh size hh of Section 15). Large steps incur truncation error; tiny steps amplify round-off and primal residuals. The step sweep uses every decade ε=10−2,10−3,…,10−12\varepsilon=10^{-2},10^{-3},\dots,10^{-12}, with ε\varepsilon on the horizontal axis. Look for a useful step-size range, not one favourable number. Absolute and component-relative errors are selectable; near a zero gradient the absolute error is more informative.

第 14 节Section 14

复数步长：独立复数残差核的检查

Complex step: checking an independent complex residual kernel

光滑无激波分支没有限幅器或最大波速运算，适合复数步长检查。复数算术与实数求导图分开实现，几何面长使用 nx2+ny2\sqrt{n_x^2+n_y^2} 的解析延拓，不能使用取共轭的复数范数。物理公式和固定边界分支共用。

This smooth branch has no limiter or maximum wave-speed operation, which makes complex-step verification useful. Complex arithmetic is implemented separately from the real derivative tape. Geometry uses the analytic continuation of nx2+ny2\sqrt{n_x^2+n_y^2}, not a conjugating complex norm. Physical formulas and fixed boundary branches are shared.

Dc=D+iεek,dJdDk≈Im⁡J(Uc,Dc)ε,ε=10−25.D_c=D+i\varepsilon e_k,\qquad \frac{dJ}{dD_k}\approx\frac{\operatorname{Im}J(U_c,D_c)}\varepsilon,\qquad \varepsilon=10^{-25}.

逐步推导：方程组的复数步长展开

Step by step: the complex-step expansion for a system

第一步，解析函数在复数步长上的 Taylor 展开，虚部除以 ε\varepsilon 就是导数，误差是 ε2\varepsilon^2 量级，并且没有两个相近数相减：

Step 1, the Taylor expansion of an analytic function at a complex step; the imaginary part divided by ε\varepsilon is the derivative, with an error of order ε2\varepsilon^2 and no subtraction of nearly equal numbers:

f(x+iε)=f(x)+iεf′(x)−ε22f′′(x)−iε36f′′′(x)+…,Im⁡f(x+iε)ε=f′(x)−ε26f′′′(x)+…f(x+i\varepsilon)=f(x)+i\varepsilon f'(x)-\frac{\varepsilon^2}2f''(x)-i\frac{\varepsilon^3}6f'''(x)+\dots,\qquad\frac{\operatorname{Im}f(x+i\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon}=f'(x)-\frac{\varepsilon^2}6f'''(x)+\dots

第二步，残差。代码保持状态的实部等于收敛解 U∗U^*，令 Uc=U∗+iεU~U_c=U^*+i\varepsilon\tilde U、Dc=D+iεekD_c=D+i\varepsilon e_k。展开时实部的零阶项是 R(U∗,D)=0R(U^*,D)=0：

Step 2, the residual. The code keeps the real part of the state at the converged U∗U^* and sets Uc=U∗+iεU~U_c=U^*+i\varepsilon\tilde U, Dc=D+iεekD_c=D+i\varepsilon e_k. In the expansion the zeroth-order real term is R(U∗,D)=0R(U^*,D)=0:

R(Uc,Dc)=R(U∗,D)⏟=0+iε(AU~+RDek)+O(ε2),Im⁡R(Uc,Dc)ε=AU~+RDek+O(ε2).R(U_c,D_c)=\underbrace{R(U^*,D)}_{=0}+i\varepsilon\bigl(A\tilde U+R_D e_k\bigr)+O(\varepsilon^2),\qquad\frac{\operatorname{Im}R(U_c,D_c)}{\varepsilon}=A\tilde U+R_D e_k+O(\varepsilon^2).

第三步，代码用实数的 AA 迭代 U~←U~−A−1Im⁡R/ε\tilde U\leftarrow\tilde U-A^{-1}\operatorname{Im}R/\varepsilon，直到虚部残差收敛；此时 AU~=−RDek+O(ε2)A\tilde U=-R_D e_k+O(\varepsilon^2)，U~\tilde U 就是 D˙=ek\dot D=e_k 的前向解 U˙=UDek=dU/dDk\dot U=U_D e_k=dU/dD_k，误差 O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2)。第四步，目标同样展开：

Step 3, the code iterates U~←U~−A−1Im⁡R/ε\tilde U\leftarrow\tilde U-A^{-1}\operatorname{Im}R/\varepsilon with the real AA until the imaginary residual has converged; then AU~=−RDek+O(ε2)A\tilde U=-R_D e_k+O(\varepsilon^2), so U~\tilde U is the tangent solution U˙=UDek=dU/dDk\dot U=U_D e_k=dU/dD_k for D˙=ek\dot D=e_k, up to O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2). Step 4, expand the objective in the same way:

Im⁡J(Uc,Dc)ε=JUU~+JDek+O(ε2)=dJdDk+O(ε2).\frac{\operatorname{Im}J(U_c,D_c)}{\varepsilon}=J_U\tilde U+J_D e_k+O(\varepsilon^2)=\frac{dJ}{dD_k}+O(\varepsilon^2).

第五步，复数残差的实部等于 −ε22-\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}2 乘以二阶项，并不为零；代码不去修正它，因为它只影响 O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2)，在 ε=10−25\varepsilon=10^{-25} 时远小于舍入误差。复数运算由独立的复数算子集执行，不经过实数计算图，所以它能检出计算图中的错误。

Step 5, the real part of the complex residual equals −ε22-\tfrac{\varepsilon^2}2 times second-order terms and is not zero; the code does not correct it, because it affects only O(ε2)O(\varepsilon^2), far below round-off at ε=10−25\varepsilon=10^{-25}. The complex arithmetic runs on an independent complex operator set, not through the real computation graph, so it can expose errors in that graph.

核对：ε=10−25\varepsilon=10^{-25} 时复数步长给出的 dJy/dM∞dJ_y/dM_\infty 与前向解的相对差为 3×10⁻¹²，最终虚部残差 5×10⁻¹³；ε=10−2\varepsilon=10^{-2} 与 10−310^{-3} 两处的误差之比为 100.00，正是 ε2\varepsilon^2 项所预言的 100（本页代码在构建时计算）。

Check: at ε=10−25\varepsilon=10^{-25} the complex-step dJy/dM∞dJ_y/dM_\infty differs from the tangent solution by 3×10⁻¹² relatively, with a final imaginary residual of 5×10⁻¹³; the errors at ε=10−2\varepsilon=10^{-2} and 10−310^{-3} have the ratio 100.00, the 100 predicted by the ε2\varepsilon^2 term (computed by this page’s code at build time).

图 14.1 把复数步长与第 13 节的差分放在同一张误差–步长图上。

Figure 14.1 puts the complex step and the differences of Section 13 on one error-versus-step plot.

从已收敛实数场出发，直接计算复数残差，用实数 AA 作为虚部修正的迭代算子，直到 Im⁡R/ε\operatorname{Im}R/\varepsilon 收敛。这样独立的复数残差仍能检出错误的 AA；必须检查最终虚部残差，不能只做一次修正就宣称成功。它不是对 Newton 的回退逻辑做复数运算。

Starting from the converged real state, evaluate the complex residual and use the real AA as an iterative correction operator for the imaginary part until Im⁡R/ε\operatorname{Im}R/\varepsilon converges. The independent complex residual can still expose an incorrect AA; its final imaginary residual must be checked. This does not apply complex arithmetic to Newton line-search decisions.

第 15 节Section 15

网格加密：固定多边形上的精度阶与载荷

Mesh refinement: order of accuracy on a fixed polygon, and the loads

伴随给出的是离散格式的精确导数，无论格式的精度阶是多少；精度阶决定离散解、以及由它算出的 JJ 和 dJ/dDdJ/dD 离连续问题有多远。本节先用制造解测量格式的精度阶，再在同一网格族上看物理算例的载荷。

The adjoint gives the exact derivative of the discrete scheme, whatever its order of accuracy; the order decides how far the discrete solution, and the JJ and dJ/dDdJ/dD computed from it, are from the continuous problem. This section first measures the order with a manufactured solution, then looks at the loads of the physical problem on the same mesh family.

网格族：均匀细分，区域不变

The mesh family: uniform subdivision, fixed domain

从第 2 节的 24 单元基础网格出发，每次加密把每个三角形经三条边的中点分成 4 个三角形，把每个四边形经四条边的中点和顶点平均点分成 4 个四边形，每条边界边在中点一分为二。新的边界节点都落在原来的八边形边上，所以物面和远场在每一层都是同一对八边形，区域完全不变，网格尺度逐层减半：hj=h1/2j−1h_j=h_1/2^{j-1}。5 层网格分别有 24、96、384、1536、6144 个单元、24、80、288、1088、4224 个节点。只有这样均匀细分出来的网格族才能拟合精度阶。早先的版本在每层按 8j8j 个角度重新采样物面曲线 r(t)r(t)，每一层的区域都不同，载荷序列把几何变化和离散误差混在一起；本节的全部数据都改在这个固定多边形网格族上重新计算。

Starting from the 24-cell base mesh of Section 2, each refinement splits every triangle into 4 triangles through its edge midpoints, every quadrilateral into 4 quadrilaterals through its edge midpoints and its vertex average, and every boundary edge in two at its midpoint. The new boundary nodes lie on the old octagon edges, so the body and the far field are the same pair of octagons on every level, the domain never changes, and the mesh size halves from level to level: hj=h1/2j−1h_j=h_1/2^{j-1}. The 5 meshes have 24, 96, 384, 1536, 6144 cells and 24, 80, 288, 1088, 4224 nodes. An order may only be fitted on a family refined uniformly like this. An earlier version re-sampled the body curve r(t)r(t) at 8j8j angles on every level, so each level had a different domain and its force sequence mixed geometry changes with discretisation error; every number in this section is recomputed on the fixed-polygon family.

图 15.1 画出这个网格族的前三层。

Figure 15.1 shows the first three levels of this family.

制造解

The manufactured solution

取一个光滑、亚声速、处处为正的场作为精确解（均值沿 +x+x，使远场八边形的每个面都明确是入流或出流）：

Take a smooth, subsonic, everywhere-positive field as the exact solution (its mean flow is along +x+x, so every face of the far-field octagon is clearly inflow or outflow):

ρex=1+0.1 sin⁡(0.8x+0.3) cos⁡(0.6y−0.4),uex=0.3+0.05 cos⁡(0.7x−0.2) sin⁡(0.9y+0.3),\rho_{\mathrm{ex}}=1+0.1\,\sin(0.8x+0.3)\,\cos(0.6y-0.4),\qquad u_{\mathrm{ex}}=0.3+0.05\,\cos(0.7x-0.2)\,\sin(0.9y+0.3),
vex=0.04 sin⁡(0.6x+0.5y+0.2),pex=1+0.1 cos⁡(0.5x−0.7y+0.1).v_{\mathrm{ex}}=0.04\,\sin(0.6x+0.5y+0.2),\qquad p_{\mathrm{ex}}=1+0.1\,\cos(0.5x-0.7y+0.1).

把它代入 Euler 方程得到源项 s=∂xFx(Uex)+∂yFy(Uex)s=\partial_xF_x(U_{\mathrm{ex}})+\partial_yF_y(U_{\mathrm{ex}})。源项由 sympy 对上式做符号求导并直接生成代码，不用差分，也不从离散残差反推；另用前向模式对偶数独立核对（随机点上最大相对差 1×10⁻¹⁶）。每个控制体的源项 Qi=∫Vis dAQ_i=\int_{V_i}s\,dA 在本格式实际的控制体（格心：单元；格点：中位对偶体）上用 6×66\times6 点折叠 Gauss 公式积分，并用散度定理 ∮∂ViFn(Uex) ds\oint_{\partial V_i}F_n(U_{\mathrm{ex}})\,ds 独立核对（最大差 2×10⁻¹³）。离散问题是 Ri(U)−Qi=0R_i(U)-Q_i=0。

Substituting it into the Euler equations gives the source s=∂xFx(Uex)+∂yFy(Uex)s=\partial_xF_x(U_{\mathrm{ex}})+\partial_yF_y(U_{\mathrm{ex}}). The source is differentiated symbolically by sympy and printed directly as code: no differencing, and nothing is reverse-engineered from the discrete residual. Forward-mode dual numbers check it independently (largest relative difference 1×10⁻¹⁶ over random points). Each volume’s source Qi=∫Vis dAQ_i=\int_{V_i}s\,dA is integrated over the scheme’s actual control volumes (cells for the cell scheme, median-dual volumes for the node scheme) with a 6×66\times6-point collapsed Gauss rule, and checked independently against the divergence theorem ∮∂ViFn(Uex) ds\oint_{\partial V_i}F_n(U_{\mathrm{ex}})\,ds (largest difference 2×10⁻¹³). The discrete problem is Ri(U)−Qi=0R_i(U)-Q_i=0.

边界数据只在这个研究里改动，页面的正常边界不变。制造解会穿过物面，所以物面在这里不能是滑移壁面；八边形物面与远场八边形的每个边界面都用第 4 节的特征闭合，只是把 U∞U_\infty 换成面中点的 UexU_{\mathrm{ex}}，入／出流分支由它的法向速度决定。这样每个面从外部得到的条件个数正好等于入域特征的个数：入流面三个，出流面一个。反过来，如果在物面上照搬壁面通量 pL𝒏p_L\boldsymbol n 并把精确解的对流通量整体作为数据，那么在制造解从物面流出的面上，外部条件比入域特征多两个，这个边界就被过定了，所以本研究不这样做。离散问题 Ri(U)−Qi=0R_i(U)-Q_i=0 与连续问题因此只差离散化本身。

Only this study changes the boundary data; the page’s normal boundaries stay as they are. The manufactured field crosses the body, so the body cannot be a slip wall here. Every boundary face, on the body octagon and on the far-field octagon, uses the characteristic closure of Section 4 with UexU_{\mathrm{ex}} at the face midpoint in place of U∞U_\infty, and the branch set by its normal velocity. Each face then receives exactly as many outside conditions as it has incoming characteristics: three at inflow, one at outflow. If instead the wall flux pL𝒏p_L\boldsymbol n were kept and the whole convective flux of the exact solution supplied as data, a face where the manufactured field leaves through the body would receive two conditions more than it has incoming characteristics; that boundary would be over-determined, so this study does not do it. The discrete problem Ri(U)−Qi=0R_i(U)-Q_i=0 therefore differs from the continuous one only by the discretisation.

误差与观测阶

Errors and observed orders

误差在控制体上测量：格心与精确解的单元平均比较，格点与节点处的精确值比较（记为 ΠhUex\Pi_hU_{\mathrm{ex}}）。四个守恒分量一起取按体积加权的 L2L_2 范数和最大范数。相邻两层的网格尺度正好差 2 倍，所以观测阶就是误差比的以 2 为底的对数：

Errors are measured per control volume: cell values against the exact cell averages, node values against the exact nodal values (written ΠhUex\Pi_hU_{\mathrm{ex}}). The four conserved components enter together, in the volume-weighted L2L_2 norm and in the max norm. Neighbouring levels differ in mesh size by exactly a factor of 2, so the observed order is the base-2 logarithm of the error ratio:

err2(h)=(∑i∣Vi∣ ∥Ui−(ΠhUex)i∥2∑i∣Vi∣)1/2,err∞(h)=max⁡i,k∣Ui,k−(ΠhUex)i,k∣,order=log⁡2err(h)err(h/2).\mathrm{err}_2(h)=\Bigl(\frac{\sum_i|V_i|\,\|U_i-(\Pi_hU_{\mathrm{ex}})_i\|^2}{\sum_i|V_i|}\Bigr)^{1/2},\quad \mathrm{err}_\infty(h)=\max_{i,k}\bigl|U_{i,k}-(\Pi_hU_{\mathrm{ex}})_{i,k}\bigr|,\quad \mathrm{order}=\log_2\frac{\mathrm{err}(h)}{\mathrm{err}(h/2)}.

每一层都用本页的 Newton 求解到残差低于 3×10−123\times10^{-12}（离线研究为了速度改用精确 Jacobian 的块 ILU 预处理，它只影响 GMRES 的迭代次数，不改变离散解）。本页格式的 L2L_2 观测阶依次为 0.35、0.52、0.71、0.85，最大范数为 0.33、0.51、0.64、0.69；格心格式的 L2L_2 阶为 0.48、0.61、0.77、0.80，最大范数为 0.34、0.51、0.70、0.78。最细一层的 L2L_2 误差是最粗一层的 0.185 倍。

Every level is solved by this page’s Newton method until the residual is below 3×10−123\times10^{-12} (for speed the offline study preconditions GMRES with a block ILU of the exact Jacobian; it changes only the number of GMRES iterations, not the discrete solution). The L2L_2 orders of this page’s scheme are 0.35, 0.52, 0.71, 0.85, the max-norm orders 0.33, 0.51, 0.64, 0.69; the cell-centred scheme has L2L_2 orders 0.48, 0.61, 0.77, 0.80 and max-norm orders 0.34, 0.51, 0.70, 0.78. The finest-level L2L_2 error is 0.185 times the coarsest.

格式是一阶的：耗散项 αℓ2(UR−UL)\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(U_R-U_L) 相当于数值粘性 νnum≈α∣𝒅∣/2\nu_{\mathrm{num}}\approx\alpha|\boldsymbol d|/2（∣𝒅∣|\boldsymbol d| 为面两侧存储点的距离），随 hh 线性减小，误差也就是 O(h)O(h)。两种格式、两种范数的观测阶都小于 1；L2L_2 阶逐层增大（最细一对网格上本页格式为 0.85）。粗网格的单元尺寸与制造解的变化尺度相比还不小，数值粘性仍然很大，误差还没有进入渐近区，所以观测阶从下方逐步接近 1。

The scheme is first order: the dissipation αℓ2(UR−UL)\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(U_R-U_L) acts like a numerical viscosity νnum≈α∣𝒅∣/2\nu_{\mathrm{num}}\approx\alpha|\boldsymbol d|/2 (∣𝒅∣|\boldsymbol d| the distance between the two stored points of a face), which falls linearly with hh, so the error is O(h)O(h). Both schemes have observed orders below 1 in both norms; the L2L_2 order grows level by level (0.85 for this page’s scheme on the finest pair). On coarse meshes the cells are not yet small compared with the length over which the manufactured field varies, the numerical viscosity is still large, the error has not reached the asymptotic range, and the observed order approaches 1 from below.
