同一网格族上的物理载荷

The physical loads on the same family

同一网格族、页面的正常边界、θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ，三个来流马赫数。内部面上 νnum\nu_{\mathrm{num}} 的中位数从第 1 层的 0.854 降到第 5 层的 0.0495；以物面尺寸 ℓbody=1.232\ell_{\mathrm{body}}=1.232 和来流速度估计的“数值雷诺数” ∣𝒖∞∣ℓbody/νnum|\boldsymbol u_\infty|\ell_{\mathrm{body}}/\nu_{\mathrm{num}}（M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2）只有 0.3、0.7、1.5、2.9、5.9。这只是量级估计，但足以说明：即使在最细一层，离散流动也更像一个强粘性流动，而不是无粘 Euler 流动。

Same family, the page’s normal boundaries, θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ, three free-stream Mach numbers. The median of νnum\nu_{\mathrm{num}} over interior faces falls from 0.854 on level 1 to 0.0495 on level 5; the “numerical Reynolds number” ∣𝒖∞∣ℓbody/νnum|\boldsymbol u_\infty|\ell_{\mathrm{body}}/\nu_{\mathrm{num}} built with the body size ℓbody=1.232\ell_{\mathrm{body}}=1.232 (M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2) is only 0.3, 0.7, 1.5, 2.9, 5.9. It is only an order-of-magnitude estimate, but it makes the point: even on the finest level the discrete flow behaves more like a strongly viscous flow than an inviscid Euler flow.

载荷与此一致（M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2）。沿来流的阻力 J∥J_\parallel 逐层为 0.252、0.311、0.270、0.197、0.136，第 2 层之后逐层下降；最细一层的 J∥/q∞=4.85J_\parallel/q_\infty=4.85，远不是 d'Alembert 的零。x 方向合力 JxJ_x 为 0.254、0.314、0.274、0.201、0.140；y 方向合力 JyJ_y 为 0.0116、0.00958、0.00255、−0.00429、−0.011，数值很小，并且在加密中变号，只有用单独的纵轴才看得清。物面最大 CpC_p 为 5.15、6.15、5.36、4.20、3.33，始终远高于等熵上界 Cp,0=1.010C_{p,0}=1.010；最低的总压比 p0/p0∞p_0/p_{0\infty} 为 0.821、0.775、0.791、0.821、0.843。格心与格点两个离散目标逐渐接近：JxJ_x 的相对差从第 1 层的 23% 降到第 5 层的 9%，JyJ_y 从 39% 降到 6%。

The loads agree (M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2). The drag along the free stream J∥J_\parallel is 0.252, 0.311, 0.270, 0.197, 0.136 level by level, falling after level 2; on the finest level J∥/q∞=4.85J_\parallel/q_\infty=4.85, nowhere near d’Alembert’s zero. The x force JxJ_x is 0.254, 0.314, 0.274, 0.201, 0.140; the y force JyJ_y is 0.0116, 0.00958, 0.00255, −0.00429, −0.011, small and changing sign under refinement, visible only on its own vertical axis. The largest wall CpC_p is 5.15, 6.15, 5.36, 4.20, 3.33, always far above the isentropic bound Cp,0=1.010C_{p,0}=1.010; the lowest total-pressure ratio p0/p0∞p_0/p_{0\infty} is 0.821, 0.775, 0.791, 0.821, 0.843. The cell-centred and node-centred objectives approach each other: their relative difference in JxJ_x falls from 23% on level 1 to 9% on level 5, in JyJ_y from 39% to 6%.

压力偏差怎样随马赫数变化？在第 1 层，三个马赫数下的 M∞⋅max⁡CpM_\infty\cdot\max C_p 只相差 3.4%：物面压力偏差 max⁡(p−p∞)\max(p-p_\infty) 与 M∞M_\infty 成正比，也就是按 ρc∣𝒖∣\rho c|\boldsymbol u| 而不是按动压 12ρ∣𝒖∣2\tfrac12\rho|\boldsymbol u|^2 标度，所以 CpC_p 的偏差约与 1/M∞1/M_\infty 成正比，马赫数越低越大。这是迎风型耗散在低马赫数下的已知行为。加密后这一部分减小，最细一层三者相差 16.6%。

How does the pressure error depend on the Mach number? On level 1 the three values of M∞⋅max⁡CpM_\infty\cdot\max C_p differ by only 3.4%: the wall pressure excess max⁡(p−p∞)\max(p-p_\infty) is proportional to M∞M_\infty, i.e. it scales like ρc∣𝒖∣\rho c|\boldsymbol u| rather than the dynamic pressure 12ρ∣𝒖∣2\tfrac12\rho|\boldsymbol u|^2, so the CpC_p error is roughly proportional to 1/M∞1/M_\infty and grows as the Mach number falls. This is the known low-Mach behaviour of upwind-type dissipation. Refinement shrinks this part; on the finest level the three differ by 16.6%.

所以，在这些网格上载荷主要是离散误差：J∥J_\parallel 既不是物理阻力，也不是激波或粘性阻力。八边形的尖角使连续无粘解在角点附近奇异，这也减慢载荷的收敛；制造解是光滑的，所以它测得的观测阶（从下方接近 1）反映的才是格式本身的精度。所有这些都不影响第 10–14 节的结论：tangent、adjoint、差分与复数步长求的，都是这个离散 JJ 的精确导数。

On these meshes the loads are therefore mostly discretisation error: J∥J_\parallel is neither physical drag nor shock or viscous drag. The corners of the octagon make the continuous inviscid solution singular near them, which further slows the convergence of the loads; the manufactured solution is smooth, so the orders it measures (approaching 1 from below) reflect the scheme’s own accuracy. None of this affects Sections 10–14: the tangent, adjoint, finite differences and complex step all compute exact derivatives of this discrete JJ.

第 16 节Section 16

连续伴随：边界条件与验证范围

Continuous adjoint: boundary conditions and verification scope

本节与附录 A 回到连续问题，δ\delta 表示连续解的变分（第 8 节的记号约定），而不是离散代码的前向导数。对光滑稳态 Euler，令 Fx,U=∂Fx/∂UF_{x,U}=\partial F_x/\partial U、Fy,U=∂Fy/∂UF_{y,U}=\partial F_y/\partial U 为 4×44\times4 通量 Jacobian（与全局残差 Jacobian AA 是不同的对象），线性化为 ∂x(Fx,UδU)+∂y(Fy,UδU)=0\partial_x(F_{x,U}\delta U)+\partial_y(F_{y,U}\delta U)=0。乘以连续乘子 λ\lambda 并分部积分，域内伴随方程是 Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ=0F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda=0；边界上留下 λTFn^,UδU\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\delta U，它必须与目标的变分一起处理，不能把原始的四个边界状态直接复制给 λ\lambda。

This section and Appendix A return to the continuous problem: δ\delta denotes a variation of the continuous solution (the notation of Section 8), not a forward derivative of the discrete code. For smooth steady Euler flow let Fx,U=∂Fx/∂UF_{x,U}=\partial F_x/\partial U and Fy,U=∂Fy/∂UF_{y,U}=\partial F_y/\partial U be the 4×44\times4 flux Jacobians (different objects from the global residual Jacobian AA). Linearisation gives ∂x(Fx,UδU)+∂y(Fy,UδU)=0\partial_x(F_{x,U}\delta U)+\partial_y(F_{y,U}\delta U)=0. Multiplying by a continuous multiplier λ\lambda and integrating by parts gives the interior adjoint equation Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ=0F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda=0, and leaves λTFn^,UδU\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\delta U on the boundary. That term must be combined with the variation of the objective; copying the four primal boundary values to λ\lambda is invalid.

∫ΩλT∇⋅(FUδU) dΩ=∮∂ΩλTFn^,U δU ds−∫ΩδUT(Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ) dΩ.\int_\Omega\lambda^T\nabla\cdot(F_U\delta U)\,d\Omega=\oint_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\delta U\,ds-\int_\Omega\delta U^T\bigl(F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda\bigr)\,d\Omega.

采用本页的加号拉格朗日约定。物面上可容许的变分保持 un=0u_n=0，物理壁面通量的变分是 (0,n^xδp,n^yδp,0)(0,\hat n_x\delta p,\hat n_y\delta p,0)，而 δJ=∫(𝒏^⋅𝒆d) δp ds\delta J=\int(\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)\,\delta p\,ds。消去 δp\delta p 的系数，在物面 Γw\Gamma_w 上得到一个条件：

Use this page’s plus-sign Lagrangian. Admissible wall variations keep un=0u_n=0, the physical wall flux varies by (0,n^xδp,n^yδp,0)(0,\hat n_x\delta p,\hat n_y\delta p,0), and δJ=∫(𝒏^⋅𝒆d) δp ds\delta J=\int(\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)\,\delta p\,ds. Cancelling the coefficient of δp\delta p gives one condition on the wall Γw\Gamma_w:

λρun^x+λρvn^y=−𝒏^⋅𝒆d(𝒙∈Γw).\lambda_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\lambda_{\rho v}\hat n_y=-\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d\qquad(\boldsymbol x\in\Gamma_w).

远场对应第 4 节的特征闭合。可容许的变分只能改变出域的量，也就是 GUG_U 的值域；要求所有这样的 δU\delta U 都使边界项为零，得到（un<0u_n<0 为入流面，un>0u_n>0 为出流面）：

The far field corresponds to the characteristic closure of Section 4. Admissible variations may change only the outgoing quantities, i.e. they lie in the range of GUG_U; requiring the boundary term to vanish for every such δU\delta U gives (un<0u_n<0 at inflow faces, un>0u_n>0 at outflow faces):

GUT Fn^,UT λ=0⟺{λTFn^,U ∂U/∂r+=0,un<0λTFn^,U ∂U/∂r+=λTFn^,U ∂U/∂S=λTFn^,U ∂U/∂ut=0,un>0G_U^T\,F_{\hat n,U}^T\,\lambda=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \begin{cases}\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial r_+=0,&u_n<0\\\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial r_+=\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial S=\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial u_t=0,&u_n>0\end{cases}

入流面一个条件、出流面三个条件：正好等于原始问题出域特征的个数，因为伴随信息沿相反方向传播。代码实际做的是第 4 节的面转置 HULTHˉ+GUTHUbTHˉH_{U_L}^T\bar H+G_U^TH_{U_b}^T\bar H；在边界状态满足闭合的极限下，它的 GUTG_U^T 投影正好是上面的连续条件，其余部分是格式对伴随出域分量的数值闭合（附录 A 推导并实测）。

One condition at an inflow face and three at an outflow face: exactly the number of outgoing primal characteristics, because adjoint information travels the opposite way. What the code actually does is the face transpose HULTHˉ+GUTHUbTHˉH_{U_L}^T\bar H+G_U^TH_{U_b}^T\bar H of Section 4; in the limit where the boundary state satisfies the closure, its GUTG_U^T projection is exactly the continuous condition above, and the remainder is the scheme’s numerical closure for the adjoint’s outgoing components (derived and measured in Appendix A).

一致性检查（附录 A）：在第 15 节的细分网格族上，把离散伴随 ψ\psi 代入物面条件，逐面计算缺陷 ζf=ψρun^x+ψρvn^y+𝒏^f⋅𝒆d\zeta_f=\psi_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\psi_{\rho v}\hat n_y+\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d。积分残差不除体积、目标按面积向量求和，所以 ψ\psi 与 λ\lambda 同量纲，不需要额外按面或体积缩放。结果分两部分：在每条八边形边中间一半的面上（远离角点的固定区域），对 JyJ_y 本页格式的缺陷 L2L_2 范数逐层下降为 0.585、0.354、0.239、0.129、0.055，对 JxJ_x 为 0.556、0.391、0.244、0.118、0.046，离散伴随在这里逐步满足连续物面条件；但整个物面上的最大缺陷为 0.86、0.79、0.92、1.34、2.12，没有下降，它出现在角点旁，那里法向跳变，连续条件本身就不连续。远场条件的检查结果不一致（见附录 A）。因此本页只宣称：远离角点时物面条件的一致性在所测网格上得到数值支持；不宣称离散伴随整体收敛到连续伴随。

Consistency check (Appendix A): on the subdivided family of Section 15, insert the discrete adjoint ψ\psi into the wall condition and compute the defect ζf=ψρun^x+ψρvn^y+𝒏^f⋅𝒆d\zeta_f=\psi_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\psi_{\rho v}\hat n_y+\hat{\boldsymbol n}_f\cdot\boldsymbol e_d face by face. Residuals are integrated, not divided by volume, and the objective sums area vectors, so ψ\psi has the units of λ\lambda and needs no extra scaling per face or volume. The result has two parts. On the middle half of every octagon edge (a fixed region away from the corners), the L2L_2 norm of the defect for this page’s scheme falls level by level: 0.585, 0.354, 0.239, 0.129, 0.055 for JyJ_y and 0.556, 0.391, 0.244, 0.118, 0.046 for JxJ_x; there the discrete adjoint approaches the continuous wall condition. Over the whole wall, however, the largest defect is 0.86, 0.79, 0.92, 1.34, 2.12 and does not fall; it sits next to the corners, where the normal jumps and the continuous condition itself is discontinuous. The far-field check is mixed (Appendix A). This page therefore claims only that the wall condition is numerically supported away from the corners on the tested meshes; it does not claim that the discrete adjoint converges to the continuous adjoint as a whole.

本页没有把同一个离散矩阵的转置再包装成“独立连续伴随”。当前验证对象是完整离散 Euler 的状态、几何和来流导数，它们对离散 JJ 是精确的；连续伴随只给出上面的方程和边界条件，本页没有独立求解它，也没有证明离散伴随在加密下收敛到它。

This page does not relabel a transpose of the same discrete matrix as an independent continuous adjoint. It verifies the discrete state, geometry and free-stream derivatives, which are exact for the discrete JJ. The continuous adjoint appears only through the equations and boundary conditions above; this page neither solves it independently nor proves that the discrete adjoint converges to it under refinement.

离散乘子与连续场为什么不能直接混用

Why a discrete multiplier is not automatically a continuous field

正文使用普通数组点积定义 ATA^T。若另选带权内积，算子的伴随就会改变：状态权矩阵为 MUM_U、残差权矩阵为 MRM_R 时，带权伴随是 MU−1ATMRM_U^{-1}A^TM_R。代码的普通转置不能在没有换元说明的情况下被写成该带权算子。

The main derivation defines ATA^T using ordinary array dot products. A weighted inner product changes the adjoint: with state and residual weights MUM_U and MRM_R it is MU−1ATMRM_U^{-1}A^TM_R. The coded ordinary transpose cannot be relabelled as that weighted operator without a change of variables.

⟨A 𝐔˙,Rˉ⟩MR=𝐔˙TATMRRˉ=⟨𝐔˙,A†Rˉ⟩MU,\langle A\,\dot{\mathbf U},\bar R\rangle_{M_R}=\dot{\mathbf U}^TA^TM_R\bar R=\langle \dot{\mathbf U},A^\dagger \bar R\rangle_{M_U},
A†=MU−1ATMR.A^\dagger=M_U^{-1}A^TM_R.

残差的归一化也会改变乘子的数值。若改为 R𝒩=𝒩−1RR_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}R，𝒩{\mathcal N} 为可逆的行尺度矩阵（例如各控制体的体积），则在收敛解上 A𝒩=𝒩−1AA_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}A，ψ𝒩=𝒩Tψ\psi_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^T\psi；目标总梯度保持不变。即使 𝒩{\mathcal N} 随设计改变，由 𝒩˙\dot {\mathcal N} 产生的项也乘以 RR，在精确收敛时为零。把控制体积分残差改成体积平均残差后，不能仍直接比较原来的乘子曲线。

Residual normalization also changes multiplier values. For R𝒩=𝒩−1RR_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}R with an invertible row-scaling matrix 𝒩{\mathcal N} (for example the control-volume sizes), at convergence A𝒩=𝒩−1AA_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}A and ψ𝒩=𝒩Tψ\psi_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^T\psi, while the total objective gradient is unchanged. Even when 𝒩{\mathcal N} depends on the design, the terms from 𝒩˙\dot {\mathcal N} multiply RR and vanish at exact convergence. Multipliers of integrated and volume-normalized residuals cannot be compared without rescaling.

连续附录从微分方程、积分目标和分部积分出发；正文从实际离散残差及其有限维链式法则出发。两者可以比较同一设计变量的目标总导数与加密极限，但还须匹配符号、变量、积分权重和边界约束。

The continuous appendix starts from differential equations, integral objectives and integration by parts; the main text starts from actual discrete residuals and finite-dimensional chain rules. Compare total derivatives of the same objective and design variable and their refinement limits, after matching signs, variables, weights and boundary constraints.

第 17 节Section 17

总结：从标量面循环到 Euler 方程组

Summary: from scalar face loops to Euler systems

几何、面方向、守恒分发和反向累加沿用二维标量；热力学和多特征边界承接拟一维 Euler。新增的难点是四分量耦合、压力壁面通量、特征状态对法向的依赖，以及多条反传路径。核心仍是同一条链：节点 → 面几何 → 边界状态与通量 → 残差 → 收敛解 → 压力目标。

Geometry, face orientation, conservative scatter and reverse accumulation follow the scalar pages. Thermodynamics and characteristic boundaries extend quasi-one-dimensional Euler. The new issues are four-component coupling, pressure wall fluxes, normal-dependent characteristic states and merged reverse paths. The chain remains nodes → face geometry → boundary states and fluxes → residual → converged state → pressure objective.

首版提供一阶、亚声速分支的原始求解、matrix-free tangent／adjoint、来流与几何梯度、全链路差分和复数残差验证；制造解在固定多边形的均匀细分网格族上给出从下方逐步接近一阶的观测阶。固定耗散 α=2\alpha=2 使这些网格上的压力与载荷主要是离散误差；离散伴随在远离角点处逐步满足连续物面条件，但没有整体验证与连续伴随一致。这些限制都不影响导数对离散目标的精确性。没有加入激波、限制器、二阶重构或湍流闭合。下一步扩展应逐项增加离散算子，并让验证始终针对实际执行的程序。

This first version provides first-order subsonic primal solves, matrix-free tangent/adjoint operators, free-stream and geometry gradients, full-rerun finite differences and complex-residual checks; a manufactured solution on a uniformly subdivided fixed-polygon family gives observed orders approaching first order from below. The fixed dissipation α=2\alpha=2 makes pressures and loads on these meshes mostly discretisation error; the discrete adjoint approaches the continuous wall condition away from the corners, but its consistency with the continuous adjoint as a whole is not verified. Neither limitation affects the exactness of the derivatives of the discrete objective. Shocks, limiters, second-order reconstruction and turbulence closure are not implemented. Each future operator should be added together with verification of the program actually executed.

下面是本页完整的数值核心。它的计算图 tape() 就是前向与反向两种模式：forward() 的数组 d 存放每个运算结果的切向量 x˙\dot x，reverse() 的数组 w 存放伴随 xˉ\bar x（按与记录相反的次序用 += 累加）；jvp、vjp 与 faceVjp 是对应的乘积 R˙=AU˙+RDD˙\dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D、(Uˉ,Dˉ)=(ATRˉ,RDTRˉ)(\bar U,\bar D)=(A^T\bar R,R_D^T\bar R) 与单个面的反向扫描。

Below is this page’s complete numerical core. Its computation graph tape() provides both modes: the array d of forward() holds the tangent x˙\dot x of every operation, and the array w of reverse() holds the adjoint xˉ\bar x (accumulated with += in the reverse order of recording); jvp, vjp and faceVjp are the corresponding products R˙=AU˙+RDD˙\dot R=A\dot U+R_D\dot D, (Uˉ,Dˉ)=(ATRˉ,RDTRˉ)(\bar U,\bar D)=(A^T\bar R,R_D^T\bar R) and the reverse sweep of one face.

展开本页完整数值核心Complete numerical core
/* Smooth 2-D Euler: a scalar-operation tape gives exact matrix-free JVP/VJP.
   Scalar face algebra also runs with independent complex arithmetic. */
(function(root){'use strict';
const gamma=1.4,alpha=2,zeros=n=>Array(n).fill(0),dot=(a,b)=>a.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*b[i],0),norm=a=>Math.sqrt(dot(a,a));
const real={c:x=>x,add:(a,b)=>a+b,sub:(a,b)=>a-b,mul:(a,b)=>a*b,div:(a,b)=>a/b,pow:(a,p)=>a**p,sin:Math.sin,cos:Math.cos};
function tape(){const val=[],pa=[],pb=[],da=[],db=[],inputs=[];function node(v,a=-1,b=-1,x=0,y=0){const i=val.length;val.push(v);pa.push(a);pb.push(b);da.push(x);db.push(y);return i;}const op={c:x=>node(x),input:x=>{const i=node(x);inputs.push(i);return i;},add:(a,b)=>node(val[a]+val[b],a,b,1,1),sub:(a,b)=>node(val[a]-val[b],a,b,1,-1),mul:(a,b)=>node(val[a]*val[b],a,b,val[b],val[a]),div:(a,b)=>node(val[a]/val[b],a,b,1/val[b],-val[a]/val[b]**2),pow:(a,p)=>node(val[a]**p,a,-1,p*val[a]**(p-1)),sin:a=>node(Math.sin(val[a]),a,-1,Math.cos(val[a])),cos:a=>node(Math.cos(val[a]),a,-1,-Math.sin(val[a]))};
function forward(seed){const d=new Float64Array(val.length);inputs.forEach((i,k)=>d[i]=seed[k]||0);for(let i=0;i<val.length;i++){if(pa[i]>=0)d[i]+=da[i]*d[pa[i]];if(pb[i]>=0)d[i]+=db[i]*d[pb[i]];}return d;}
function reverse(outputs,seeds){const w=new Float64Array(val.length);outputs.forEach((i,k)=>w[i]+=seeds[k]);for(let i=val.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(pa[i]>=0)w[pa[i]]+=da[i]*w[i];if(pb[i]>=0)w[pb[i]]+=db[i]*w[i];}return inputs.map(i=>w[i]);}

const complex={c:x=>[x,0],add:(a,b)=>[a[0]+b[0],a[1]+b[1]],sub:(a,b)=>[a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1]],mul:(a,b)=>[a[0]*b[0]-a[1]*b[1],a[0]*b[1]+a[1]*b[0]],div:(a,b)=>{const d=b[0]**2+b[1]**2;return [(a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1])/d,(a[1]*b[0]-a[0]*b[1])/d];},pow:(a,p)=>{const r=Math.hypot(...a)**p,t=p*Math.atan2(a[1],a[0]);return [r*Math.cos(t),r*Math.sin(t)];},sin:a=>[Math.sin(a[0])*Math.cosh(a[1]),Math.cos(a[0])*Math.sinh(a[1])],cos:a=>[Math.cos(a[0])*Math.cosh(a[1]),-Math.sin(a[0])*Math.sinh(a[1])]};
function mesh(level=1){ // level 1 is indexed-identical to the scalar pages
 // Level 1: angles t_j=2*pi*j/8. Ring 0 samples the body curve, ring 2 the circle of radius 1.9, ring 1 blends them.
 // Level l>1 subdivides level l-1 uniformly: every edge is halved at its midpoint, every quadrilateral gains its
 // vertex average and every triangle is split through its edge midpoints. The body and the far boundary therefore
 // stay the two level-1 octagons, the domain never changes, and the mesh size halves from level to level.
 if(!Number.isInteger(level)||level<1||level>6)throw Error('Unsupported mesh level');
 let X=[],L=1;const mid=(a,b)=>[.5*(a[0]+b[0]),.5*(a[1]+b[1])];
 for(let r=0;r<=2;r++){const k=r,z=k<=1?.45*k:.45+.55*(k-1);for(let j=0;j<8;j++){const t=2*Math.PI*j/8,rad=.55*(1+.28*Math.cos(t)+.12*Math.sin(2*t)),b=[.1+rad*Math.cos(t),-.04+rad*Math.sin(t)],o=[1.9*Math.cos(t),1.9*Math.sin(t)];X.push(b.map((x,d)=>(1-z)*x+z*o[d]));}}
 for(let l=1;l<level;l++){const nt=8*L,old=(r,j)=>X[r*nt+(j%nt)],Y=[];
  for(let R=0;R<=4*L;R++)for(let J=0;J<2*nt;J++){const r=R>>1,j=J>>1;
   Y.push(R%2===0&&J%2===0?old(r,j):R%2===0?mid(old(r,j),old(r,j+1)):J%2===0?mid(old(r,j),old(r+1,j))
    :r<L?[0,1].map(d=>.25*(old(r,j)[d]+old(r+1,j)[d]+old(r+1,j+1)[d]+old(r,j+1)[d])):mid(old(r,j),old(r+1,j+1)));}
  X=Y;L*=2;}
 const nt=8*L,C=[],id=(r,j)=>r*nt+(j%nt);for(let r=0;r<2*L;r++)for(let j=0;j<nt;j++){const a=id(r,j),b=id(r,j+1),c=id(r+1,j+1),d=id(r+1,j);if(r<L)C.push([a,d,c,b]);else C.push([a,d,c],[a,c,b]);}return {X,C,nt,level};}

 let faces;if(scheme==='cell')faces=edges.map(e=>({...e,terms:[[e.a,e.b,1]],segs:[[e.a,e.b]]}));
 else{const off=mesh.X.length;faces=edges.map(e=>{const a=Math.min(e.a,e.b),b=Math.max(e.a,e.b),mid=off+mesh.C.length+edges.indexOf(e),terms=[],segs=[];for(const c of [e.L,e.R].filter(i=>i>=0)){const cell=mesh.C[c],s=cell[(cell.indexOf(a)+1)%cell.length]===b?1:-1;terms.push([mid,off+c,s]);segs.push([mid,off+c]);}return {a,b,L:a,R:b,bc:'interior',terms,segs};});for(const e of edges.filter(e=>e.R<0)){const mid=off+mesh.C.length+edges.indexOf(e);for(const a of [e.a,e.b])faces.push({L:a,R:-1,bc:e.bc,terms:[[e.a,e.b,.5]],segs:[[a,mid]]});}}

function model({scheme='cell',level=1,M=.2,angle=10,objective='lift',coords,mms}={}){

附录 A：连续伴随与一致性检查

Appendix A: continuous adjoint and consistency check

A.1 变分与域内伴随方程

A.1 Variation and the interior adjoint equation

连续问题：在 Ω\Omega 内 ∇⋅F(U)=0\nabla\cdot F(U)=0；物面 Γw\Gamma_w 上 un=0u_n=0；远场 Γ∞\Gamma_\infty 上入域特征量取来流值；目标 J=∫Γwp 𝒏^⋅𝒆d dsJ=\int_{\Gamma_w}p\,\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d\,ds（𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} 指向流体域外）。拉格朗日函数 ℒ=J+∫ΩλT∇⋅F(U) dΩ\mathcal L=J+\int_\Omega\lambda^T\nabla\cdot F(U)\,d\Omega，在固定几何与固定来流下变分：

Continuous problem: ∇⋅F(U)=0\nabla\cdot F(U)=0 in Ω\Omega; un=0u_n=0 on the wall Γw\Gamma_w; incoming characteristic quantities take free-stream values on the far field Γ∞\Gamma_\infty; objective J=∫Γwp 𝒏^⋅𝒆d dsJ=\int_{\Gamma_w}p\,\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d\,ds (𝒏^\hat{\boldsymbol n} out of the fluid). With ℒ=J+∫ΩλT∇⋅F(U) dΩ\mathcal L=J+\int_\Omega\lambda^T\nabla\cdot F(U)\,d\Omega, vary at fixed geometry and free stream:

δℒ=δJ+∮∂ΩλTFn^,U δU ds−∫ΩδUT(Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ) dΩ.\delta\mathcal L=\delta J+\oint_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\delta U\,ds-\int_\Omega\delta U^T\bigl(F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda\bigr)\,d\Omega.

域内项对任意 δU\delta U 为零，给出伴随方程 Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ=0F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda=0。边界项只对可容许的 δU\delta U 要求为零，由此得到物面与远场条件。

The interior term vanishes for every δU\delta U, which gives the adjoint equation Fx,UT∂xλ+Fy,UT∂yλ=0F_{x,U}^T\partial_x\lambda+F_{y,U}^T\partial_y\lambda=0. The boundary terms need to vanish only for admissible δU\delta U, which gives the wall and far-field conditions.

A.2 物面条件

A.2 The wall condition

在物面上 un=0u_n=0，并且可容许变分保持 δun=0\delta u_n=0。由第 1 节的 Fn^F_{\hat n}，Fn^,UδU=(0,n^xδp,n^yδp,0)TF_{\hat n,U}\delta U=(0,\hat n_x\delta p,\hat n_y\delta p,0)^T，于是物面上的边界项与目标变分合并为 ∫Γw(λρun^x+λρvn^y+𝒏^⋅𝒆d) δp ds\int_{\Gamma_w}(\lambda_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\lambda_{\rho v}\hat n_y+\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)\,\delta p\,ds。δp\delta p 任意，所以得到第 16 节的物面条件。它只约束 λ\lambda 的一个组合，与滑移壁面只有一个入域特征相对应。

On the wall un=0u_n=0, and admissible variations keep δun=0\delta u_n=0. From Fn^F_{\hat n} of Section 1, Fn^,UδU=(0,n^xδp,n^yδp,0)TF_{\hat n,U}\delta U=(0,\hat n_x\delta p,\hat n_y\delta p,0)^T, so the wall boundary term and the objective variation combine into ∫Γw(λρun^x+λρvn^y+𝒏^⋅𝒆d) δp ds\int_{\Gamma_w}(\lambda_{\rho u}\hat n_x+\lambda_{\rho v}\hat n_y+\hat{\boldsymbol n}\cdot\boldsymbol e_d)\,\delta p\,ds. Since δp\delta p is arbitrary, the wall condition of Section 16 follows. It constrains only one combination of λ\lambda, matching the single incoming characteristic of a slip wall.

A.3 远场条件：连续形式与代码中的离散形式

A.3 The far-field condition: continuous form and the discrete form in the code

用 Riemann 坐标 W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t) 表示，闭合是 Wb=IoutWL+(I−Iout)W∞W_b=I_{\mathrm{out}}W_L+(I-I_{\mathrm{out}})W_\infty，所以对任意 ULU_L 都有 GU=∂U∂W∣Ub Iout ∂W∂U∣ULG_U=\frac{\partial U}{\partial W}\big|_{U_b}\,I_{\mathrm{out}}\,\frac{\partial W}{\partial U}\big|_{U_L}（∂U/∂W=(∂W/∂U)−1\partial U/\partial W=(\partial W/\partial U)^{-1}）。GG 满足 G(G(U))=G(U)G(G(U))=G(U)，在满足闭合的状态（Ub=ULU_b=U_L）上 GUG_U 是投影：GU2=GUG_U^2=G_U，秩等于出域特征个数（入流 1、出流 3）。连续问题的可容许变分正是 GUG_U 的值域，于是远场条件是 λTFn^,UGU=0\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}G_U=0，即第 16 节的 GUTFn^,UTλ=0G_U^TF_{\hat n,U}^T\lambda=0；由 ∂W/∂U\partial W/\partial U 可逆，它等价于对每个出域坐标 kk 有 λTFn^,U ∂U/∂Wk=0\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial W_k=0。

In the Riemann coordinates W=(r+,r−,S,ut)W=(r_+,r_-,S,u_t) the closure reads Wb=IoutWL+(I−Iout)W∞W_b=I_{\mathrm{out}}W_L+(I-I_{\mathrm{out}})W_\infty, so GU=∂U∂W∣Ub Iout ∂W∂U∣ULG_U=\frac{\partial U}{\partial W}\big|_{U_b}\,I_{\mathrm{out}}\,\frac{\partial W}{\partial U}\big|_{U_L} for every ULU_L (∂U/∂W=(∂W/∂U)−1\partial U/\partial W=(\partial W/\partial U)^{-1}). GG satisfies G(G(U))=G(U)G(G(U))=G(U), and at a state that satisfies the closure (Ub=ULU_b=U_L) GUG_U is a projection: GU2=GUG_U^2=G_U, with rank equal to the number of outgoing characteristics (1 at inflow, 3 at outflow). The admissible variations of the continuous problem are exactly the range of GUG_U, so the far-field condition is λTFn^,UGU=0\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}G_U=0, i.e. the GUTFn^,UTλ=0G_U^TF_{\hat n,U}^T\lambda=0 of Section 16; since ∂W/∂U\partial W/\partial U is invertible, it is equivalent to λTFn^,U ∂U/∂Wk=0\lambda^TF_{\hat n,U}\,\partial U/\partial W_k=0 for every outgoing coordinate kk.

代码中远场面对其控制体伴随方程的贡献是第 4 节给出的：

In the code a far-field face contributes the following to its volume’s adjoint equation (Section 4):

[12Fn,U(UL)T+αℓ2I]Hˉ+GUT[12Fn,U(Ub)T−αℓ2I]Hˉ.\bigl[\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_L)^T+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I\bigr]\bar H+G_U^T\bigl[\tfrac12F_{n,U}(U_b)^T-\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2I\bigr]\bar H.

在 Ub=ULU_b=U_L 的极限下它等于 12(I+GUT)Fn,UTHˉ+αℓ2(I−GUT)Hˉ\tfrac12(I+G_U^T)F_{n,U}^T\bar H+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(I-G_U^T)\bar H；左乘投影 GUTG_U^T 得到 GUTFn,UTHˉG_U^TF_{n,U}^T\bar H，正是连续远场条件的表达式，而 (I−GUT)(I-G_U^T) 部分是格式自己给伴随出域分量加的迎风型数值闭合。

In the limit Ub=ULU_b=U_L this equals 12(I+GUT)Fn,UTHˉ+αℓ2(I−GUT)Hˉ\tfrac12(I+G_U^T)F_{n,U}^T\bar H+\tfrac{\alpha\ell}2(I-G_U^T)\bar H. Multiplying by the projection GUTG_U^T leaves GUTFn,UTHˉG_U^TF_{n,U}^T\bar H, exactly the expression of the continuous far-field condition, while the (I−GUT)(I-G_U^T) part is the scheme’s own upwind-type numerical closure for the adjoint’s outgoing components.

这些结论在本页第 1 层网格的收敛解上实测（M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2、θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ，全部远场面）：GUG_U 与 (∂U/∂W) Iout (∂W/∂U)(\partial U/\partial W)\,I_{\mathrm{out}}\,(\partial W/\partial U) 最大差 8×10⁻¹⁵（GUG_U 元素最大为 4.33）；G(G(U))−G(U)G(G(U))-G(U) 最大 4×10⁻¹⁵；闭合状态上 GU2−GUG_U^2-G_U 最大 1×10⁻¹⁴，迹在入流面为 1、出流面为 3（偏差小于 3×10⁻¹⁵）；上面的面转置公式与计算图逆序结果最大差 2×10⁻¹⁵。

These statements are measured on this page’s level-1 converged solution (M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2, θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ, every far-field face): GUG_U and (∂U/∂W) Iout (∂W/∂U)(\partial U/\partial W)\,I_{\mathrm{out}}\,(\partial W/\partial U) differ by at most 8×10⁻¹⁵ (largest entry of GUG_U: 4.33); G(G(U))−G(U)G(G(U))-G(U) is at most 4×10⁻¹⁵; at the closure state GU2−GUG_U^2-G_U is at most 1×10⁻¹⁴ and the trace is 1 on inflow faces and 3 on outflow faces (deviation below 3×10⁻¹⁵); the face transpose formula above and the reversed computation graph differ by at most 2×10⁻¹⁵.

A.4 一致性检查

A.4 The consistency check

在第 15 节的 5 层细分网格上（M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2、θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ，正常边界），对两个目标求离散伴随，并计算：物面缺陷 ζf\zeta_f（第 16 节）的面长加权 L2L_2 范数与最大值；只取每条八边形边中间一半的面（固定区域，远离角点）的 L2L_2 范数；远场的比值：

On the 5 subdivided levels of Section 15 (M∞=0.2M_\infty=0.2, θ=10∘\theta=10^\circ, normal boundaries), solve the discrete adjoint for both objectives and compute: the length-weighted L2L_2 norm and the maximum of the wall defect ζf\zeta_f (Section 16); its L2L_2 norm over only the middle half of every octagon edge (a fixed region away from the corners); the far-field ratio:

ζfar=(∑f∥GUTFn^,UTψL∥2/∑f∥Fn^,UTψL∥2)1/2;\zeta_{\mathrm{far}}=\bigl(\sum_f\|G_U^TF_{\hat n,U}^T\psi_L\|^2/\sum_f\|F_{\hat n,U}^T\psi_L\|^2\bigr)^{1/2};

以及 max⁡i∥ψi∥\max_i\|\psi_i\|。若离散伴随收敛到满足这些条件的连续伴随，中间一半的缺陷和 ζfar\zeta_{\mathrm{far}} 都应随 hh 趋于零，max⁡∣ψ∣\max|\psi| 应保持有界；角点处连续条件本身跳变，所以整个物面上的最大缺陷不必趋于零。

and max⁡i∥ψi∥\max_i\|\psi_i\|. If the discrete adjoint converged to a continuous adjoint satisfying these conditions, the middle-half defect and ζfar\zeta_{\mathrm{far}} would tend to zero with hh and max⁡∣ψ∣\max|\psi| would stay bounded; at the corners the continuous condition itself jumps, so the largest defect over the whole wall need not tend to zero.

结果（本页格式）。整个物面上缺陷的 L2L_2 范数对 JyJ_y 为 0.57、0.41、0.34、0.34、0.38，对 JxJ_x 为 0.61、0.44、0.32、0.26、0.21；最大缺陷对 JyJ_y 为 0.86、0.79、0.92、1.34、2.12，出现在角点旁（最细一层在 359.5°，最近的角点在 0°）。只取每条边中间一半的面，L2L_2 缺陷对 JyJ_y 为 0.585、0.354、0.239、0.129、0.055，对 JxJ_x 为 0.556、0.391、0.244、0.118、0.046，逐层下降，最细一对网格上的观测阶分别为 1.22 与 1.36；格心格式的对应值（JyJ_y）为 0.641、0.499、0.346、0.214、0.105。远场比值 ζfar\zeta_{\mathrm{far}} 对 JyJ_y 为 1.47、1.20、0.81、0.54、0.42，逐层下降；对 JxJ_x 为 0.48、0.30、0.36、0.40、0.39，没有逐层下降，最细一层是第 1 层的 0.81 倍。max⁡i∥ψi∥\max_i\|\psi_i\| 对 JyJ_y 为 0.79、1.66、2.54、3.13、3.48，最细一层出现在 (0.59, −1.66)，靠近下方的远场边。

Results (this page’s scheme). Over the whole wall the L2L_2 norm of the defect is 0.57, 0.41, 0.34, 0.34, 0.38 for JyJ_y and 0.61, 0.44, 0.32, 0.26, 0.21 for JxJ_x; the largest defect for JyJ_y is 0.86, 0.79, 0.92, 1.34, 2.12 and sits next to a corner (at 359.5° on the finest level, nearest corner 0°). Restricted to the middle half of every edge, the L2L_2 defect is 0.585, 0.354, 0.239, 0.129, 0.055 for JyJ_y and 0.556, 0.391, 0.244, 0.118, 0.046 for JxJ_x, falling level by level, with observed orders 1.22 and 1.36 on the finest pair; the cell-centred scheme gives 0.641, 0.499, 0.346, 0.214, 0.105 (JyJ_y). The far-field ratio ζfar\zeta_{\mathrm{far}} is 1.47, 1.20, 0.81, 0.54, 0.42 for JyJ_y, falling level by level, and 0.48, 0.30, 0.36, 0.40, 0.39 for JxJ_x, not falling level by level; its finest value is 0.81 times the first. max⁡i∥ψi∥\max_i\|\psi_i\| is 0.79, 1.66, 2.54, 3.13, 3.48 for JyJ_y; on the finest level it sits at (0.59, −1.66), next to the lower far-field edge.

结论：远离角点时，离散伴随在所测网格上逐步满足连续物面条件，这是本页能给出的一致性证据。角点旁的缺陷不下降，符合连续条件在角点处不连续、连续伴随在角点附近奇异的预期；JxJ_x 的远场比值没有逐层下降，原因本页没有查明。所以本页不宣称离散伴随整体收敛到连续伴随。

Conclusion: away from the corners the discrete adjoint approaches the continuous wall condition on the tested meshes; this is the consistency evidence this page can offer. The defect next to the corners does not fall, as expected where the continuous condition is discontinuous and the continuous adjoint is singular; the far-field ratio for JxJ_x does not fall level by level, for reasons this page has not established. The page therefore does not claim that the discrete adjoint converges to the continuous adjoint as a whole.

A.5 验证范围

A.5 Scope of the verification

已验证：离散残差、目标与它们的全部导数（状态、来流、几何）彼此一致，tangent 与 adjoint 在舍入误差内相同，完整重算差分与独立复数步长在截断误差与线性求解容差之内与它们一致；远场闭合的 GUG_U 结构与面转置公式；制造解的观测阶从下方逐步接近一阶；远离角点时物面伴随条件的缺陷逐层下降。未验证：离散伴随在角点附近和远场（JxJ_x）上与连续伴随一致；离散载荷收敛到物理载荷。要检验这些，可能需要更弱的耗散（例如随状态变化的波速或二阶重构）、光滑物面和更远的远场；它们属于后续工作，而不是本页离散求导的缺陷。

Verified: the discrete residual and objective and all their derivatives (state, free stream, geometry) agree, with the tangent and the adjoint equal to round-off, and the full-rerun differences and the independent complex step agreeing with them within truncation error and the linear-solver tolerance; the structure of GUG_U and the face transpose of the far-field closure; observed orders of the manufactured solution approaching first order from below; a wall-condition defect that falls level by level away from the corners. Not verified: consistency of the discrete adjoint with the continuous adjoint next to the corners and at the far field (JxJ_x); convergence of the discrete loads to physical loads. Checking these would likely need weaker dissipation (for example a state-dependent wave speed or second-order reconstruction), a smooth body and a more distant far field; they are future work, not defects of this page’s discrete differentiation.
